Abstract: This paper describes the fifth edition of the Shared Task on Multilingual Coreference Resolution, held in conjunction with the CODI-CRAC 2026 workshop. Building on previous iterations, the task required participants to develop systems capable of mention identification and identity-based coreference clustering.
  The 2026 edition specifically emphasizes long-range entities, defined as coreferential chains spanning significant distances, across many words and sentences.
  The task expanded its linguistic scope by incorporating five new datasets and two additional languages. These additions leverage version 1.4 of CorefUD, a harmonized multilingual collection comprising 27 datasets in 19 languages.
  In total, ten systems participated, including four LLM-based approaches (three fine-tuned models and one few-shot approach). While traditional systems still maintained their lead, LLMs demonstrated significant potential, suggesting they may soon challenge established approaches in future editions.

</details>


### [81] [Post-Hoc Understanding of Metaphor Processing in Decoder-Only Language Models via Conditional Scale Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21391)
*Lawhori Chakrabarti,Jennifer Johnson-Leung,Bert Baumgaertner,Aleksandar Vakanski,Min Xian,Boyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"条件尺度熵"（CSE），一种基于连续小波变换（CWT）的度量，用于刻画 Transformer 残差流轨迹在各层位置上"跨频率尺度参与计算的广度"。两个定理证明 CSE 对更新幅度不变（只反映结构而非强度），并由归一化尺度分布的优超序（majorization）给出熵序充分条件。实验覆盖 GPT-2 系列（124M–774M）、LLaMA-2 7B、GPT-oss 20B（MoE）五个仅解码器架构，发现隐喻词元在连续的"活跃区"（早期到中段相对深度）上 CSE 显著高于字面词元，且在所有模型上通过基于簇的置换检验；在 200 对自然语言 VUA 数据上收敛复现同一深度区间，并显示效应量随隐喻新颖度递减；特异性对照表明该效应源自隐喻表达方式而非语义复杂度或命题内容。CSE 是所检验光谱量中唯一在架构、刺激集规模与刺激类型间都保持方向与显著性稳定的量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 虽能流畅处理隐喻，但内部机制不明：模型处理"The lawyer is a shark"时目标词元需从字面所指重新解释为比喻谓词，而中间计算跨层如何组织是机制可解释性的开放问题。现有可解释性手段（激活修补、稀疏自编码器、电路追踪）聚焦单个组件，缺少刻画"跨深度计算组织方式"的宏观诊断；同时谱域/小波方法虽已用于训练谱偏置、ViT 注意力图消融等，但从未应用于语言模型隐藏状态轨迹的事后分析。因此需要一个能把"隐喻处理与字面处理的差异"转化为可测量的、层分辨率的量，并能与隐喻的认知理论（如显著等级假说）建立联系。

Method: （1）残差轨迹：把目标词元的隐藏状态序列 (x_0,…,x_L) 作为以层深为索引的离散信号，更新 Δ_l = Attn_l + MLP_l。（2）对比方向：跨 K 个最小对与所有层求 (隐喻−字面)更新的均值差并 L2 归一化得到单位向量 v*；投影 s(l)=v*ᵀx_l 与 δ_l=v*ᵀΔ_l 构成标量深度信号；用留一法、投影分离、跨子集余弦相似度验证 v* 的稳定性。（3）小波分解：将 s(l) 分段线性插值为连续信号并常数延拓，用实 Morlet 小波（ω0=5，|ψ̂(0)|≈9.3e-6）做 CWT（pywt.cwt,"morl"），尺度 a_j=j，j=1..S，S=L+1（受锥形影响域限制）；在固定位置 b 处 scalogram 能量关于 δ 线性，存在小波响应算子 Φ_b∈R^{S×L} 使 z=Φ_b δ。（4）条件尺度熵：跨尺度归一化 p(a_j|b)=z_j²/‖z‖²，取 Shannon 熵 H(scale|b)。定理3.1：(i) 分布形式；(ii) H=log S 当且仅当 |z_j| 全相等；(iii) H=0 当且仅当仅一个 z_j≠0；(iv) δ↦cδ 时 H 不变（幅度不变性）。定理3.2：归一化尺度分布被优超序且非置换时，H 严格更大（Shannon 熵严格 Schur-凹），仅单向蕴含。（5）"多尺度参与假说"：隐喻在活跃区 A_M 内 H(scale|b)^met > H(scale|b)^lit，活跃区由 25 对受控最小对在簇级置换校正下定位，再在 VUA 与其他架构上独立复现。（6）统计：受控集用 10,000 次 Monte Carlo 符号翻转检验，VUA 用配对 t 检验与 Cohen's d，多重比较用基于簇的置换检验（5,000 次，α=0.05），簇统计量为超过阈值的最大连续簇内统计量之和。

Result: GPT-2 Medium（25 对）中隐喻在位置 5–13 上 CSE 持续更高，13/25 位置 p<0.05，峰值在位置 9（p=0.0008，18/25 为正），簇检验 p_cluster=0.007；绝对熵在两条件间几乎相同（差异在小数第二位）。跨架构：GPT-2 Small 2–8、GPT-2 Medium 5–13、GPT-2 Large 0–12、LLaMA-2 7B 5–11、GPT-oss 20B 0–13，全部 p_cluster<0.001（GPT-2 Medium 为 0.007），相对深度均在 0–67% 的早期到中段区间；Rényi-2 熵给出相同显著位置。对照：CWT 能量抑制仅在 GPT-2 Medium 显著，在 LLaMA-2 7B 与 GPT-oss 20B 消失；更新能量熵 H(q) 在刺激从 10 对扩到 25 对时符号反转（met<lit → met>lit），故不可靠。VUA（200 对，GPT-2 Medium）：用受控对 v* 投影分离仅 107/200 为正（p=0.19，不显著），簇落在位置 0–4（p=0.013）；在 VUA 上重新估计 v*（与受控方向余弦 0.964）后簇移至 5–10（p=0.003），完全落在 A_M 内；效应量 d≈0.17（VUA 常规化隐喻）约为受控鲜明隐喻 d≈0.34 的一半，符合显著等级假说。特异性控制：10 对字面–字面语义复杂度对比无任何位置显著，活跃区内均值 ΔH=−0.0005（隐喻对比为 0.017）；10 组同义匹配三元组中两隐喻合并对字面在位置 4–16 显著（p_cluster=0.003），两隐喻彼此对比零显著位置（|ΔH|<0.001）。

Conclusion: 条件尺度熵是把"隐喻处理的计算组织方式"与"计算强度"分离的有效工具：隐喻处理表现为跨频率尺度的多尺度协调增强，而非任何单层上更大的更新幅度。这一签名在五个 124M–20B 的仅解码器架构上稳健出现，位于早—中段相对深度的连续活跃区，并在 200 对自然语言 VUA 隐喻上以独立估计的对比方向收敛复现，效应量随隐喻常规化程度递减。CSE 是所测光谱量中唯一跨架构、跨刺激规模、跨刺激类型都稳定的方向与显著性来源，因此可作为刻画 Transformer 跨深度结构的原则性分析工具，与组件级可解释性互补。局限与展望：受控集仅 25 对、特异性对照各 10 对；尚缺连续新颖度评级刺激；尚需基于小波响应算子的尺度通道抑制等因果干预以验证多尺度协调的功能必要性；可扩展到多义词、反讽、转喻与多步推理，以判断该签名是否隐喻特有。

Abstract: Metaphor requires a language model to resolve a token whose contextual meaning diverges from its basic literal sense. Understanding how transformer models organize this reinterpretation across depth remains an open problem in mechanistic interpretability. We introduce conditional scale entropy (CSE), a wavelet-derived measure of how broadly transformer computation engages across frequency scales at each layer position. Two theorems establish that CSE is invariant to update magnitude, isolating the structural pattern of updates from their intensity. Using CSE, we find that metaphorical tokens produce significantly higher spectral breadth than literal tokens at contiguous layer positions on every decoder-only architecture tested, from 124M to 20B parameters (GPT-2 family, LLaMA-2 7B, GPT-oss 20B). The effect survives cluster-based permutation correction, recurs in the early-to-mid relative depth range across models, and converges with an independent analysis of 200 naturalistic VUA pairs. Specificity controls further show that the effect is not explained by semantic complexity or by matched propositional content. These results identify multi-scale coordination as a consistent signature of metaphorical language processing in the decoder-only architectures examined, and establish CSE as a principled tool for characterizing cross-depth structure in transformers.

</details>


### [82] [Quantifying the cross-linguistic effects of syncretism on agreement attraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21403)
*Utku Turk,Eva Neu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用大语言模型（LLM）的意外度（surprisal）与注意力熵（attention entropy）作为跨语言一致的处理代理指标，量化形态合并（syncretism）对主谓一致吸引效应（agreement attraction）的调节作用。结果在英语、德语中复现了行为学的合并效应（syncretism 增强吸引），在土耳其语中复现了零效应，在俄语中仅部分复现（伪复数/与主格复数同形的属格单数吸引子所引发的"反转"吸引未被捕捉）。总体上 LLM 措施在 4 种语言中的 3 种与人类行为一致，surprisal 信号比注意力熵更可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主谓一致吸引（agreement attraction）指动词错误地与插入名词（attractor）而非语法中心语保持一致。已有行为学研究显示，形态合并（syncretism，即同一表层形态承载不同语法/语义特征）会在英语、德语、俄语中放大吸引错误，但在土耳其语、亚美尼亚语中不产生效应，法语甚至呈相反模式（更多错误），捷克语、斯洛伐克语则为增强效应。这一跨语言差异至今缺乏有原则的理论解释：一种可能的假说（Dillon & Keshev, 2025）认为各语言在追踪一致依存关系时对形态线索的依赖程度不同，但缺乏实证检验。既有 LLM 研究（Ryu & Lewis, 2021）只用英语，且主要对应在线阅读时间范式，而实验研究常使用产出/可接受性判断等离线范式，二者关联尚未打通。因此需要一个跨语言、跨范式统一的技术手段来量化该差异。

Method: 1）指标：以 GPT-2 类自回归模型提取一致动词位置（限定词/助动词/主要动词）的 surprisal（负对数概率），surprisal 越低表示模型越"被"复数吸引子误导而误判句为合法；以 BERT 类双向模型提取动词到候选名词（中心语与吸引子）的注意力分布，跨头平均后计算注意力熵，熵越高表示检索竞争越强。2）注意力层选择：用 Leipzig 语料库每语言 100 万句、基于 Universal Dependencies 解析后做 probing，选出主语最常出现在动词 top-5 受注意 token 中的层（英 6、德 9、俄 8、土 8），采用层内聚合而非最后一层。3）实验材料：德语取自 Hartsuiker et al. (2003)（die 与 den 对比），英语取自 Nicol et al. (2016) 与 Wagers et al. (2009)（与主格同形的属格/与宾格同形的复数吸引子对比），俄语取自 Slioussar (2018)（宾格同形与属格单数/复数，含伪复数现象），土耳其语取自 Türk & Logačev (2024)（辅音结尾 -I 与元音结尾 -sI 属格吸引子）。模型：GPT2-small/BERT（英）、dbmdz/german-gpt2 与 bert-base-german-cased（德）、ai-forever rugpt3small 与 deepvk/bert-base-uncased（俄）、gpt2-turkish-cased 与 dbmdz/bert-base-turkish-128k-cased（土）。4）关键对比量 Δ = μ(复数吸引子) − μ(单数吸引子)，分别在合并/非合并条件下计算；非语法句中 Δ 更负（surprisal）表示吸引更强，Δ 更正（熵）表示竞争更强。5）统计：R + brms 贝叶斯混合效应模型（Gaussian），固定效应含 Syncretism、Grammaticality、Attractor Number 的全部主效应与交互，条目随机截距及 Grammaticality、Attractor、其交互的随机斜率（不相关），处理编码以合并/语法/单数为参照；报告 P(effect>0)，关键项为二阶 G×A（吸引）与三阶 S×G×A（合并的调节）；俄语另拟合仅非合并（GEN）条件的附加模型以检验反转效应。

Result: 英语：非语法句中复数吸引子降低 surprisal 幅度在合并条件下更大（Δ=−2.009, SE=0.286）而非合并条件（Δ=−0.541, SE=0.235）；G×A 强负（P<0.01），S×G×A 强正（P>0.99）。注意力熵同向：合并 Δ=0.095 (SE=0.042)，非合并 ≈0.002 (SE=0.049)，S×G×A 偏负（P=0.090）。德语：吸引效应存在但合并调节很弱——surprisal 非合并 Δ=−0.66 (SE=0.35) vs 合并 Δ=−0.60 (SE=0.32)，三阶 P=0.822；熵 Δ=0.008/0.007，三阶 P=0.250（即低估了合并 vs 非合并对比）。俄语：合并（ACC）条件下吸引明确（Δ=−0.541, SE=0.329，G×A=−0.730, P<0.01），非合并（GEN）条件对比极弱且接近反转（Δ=−0.039）；三阶交互强正（0.568, P>0.99），GEN-only 模型出现反转方向的二阶交互（−0.159, P<0.01）但幅度远小于行为学数据；熵结果不显著（两/三阶 P=0.183/0.352）。土耳其语：复数吸引子在两条件下均降低 surprisal（Δ=−0.691 vs −0.590）与提高熵（0.017 vs 0.016），但无任何交互证据（三阶 P=0.332，熵 P=0.550），与行为学零效应一致。总体上 surprisal 比注意力熵更一致、更具判别力；唯一明确失配是俄语伪复数反转现象。

Conclusion: LLM 派生的 surprisal 与注意力熵可作为跨语言一致的记忆检索竞争代理指标：在 3/4 种语言中成功复现了人行为上关于 syncretism 调节一致吸引的结论（英、德增强，土零效应，俄部分成立），说明模型与人类对驱动吸引的形态合并敏感，尽管底层机制可能不同。唯一失败案例是俄语"伪复数"反转（与主格复数同形但特征完全不重叠的属格单数吸引子），作者推测人类比 LLM 更易受表面形态相似性误导，而 LLM 更依赖句法语境消歧形态标记；需进一步 probing 检验模型如何表征"有/无特征重叠的合并"。总体讨论提出：形态区分稀疏但信息量大（英语、德语）或格标记特征密集的屈折语（俄语、捷克语）中合并效应最强，而在形态透明、组合性强的黏着语（土耳其语、亚美尼亚语）中说话者与模型可能较少依赖特定形态重叠的存在，故出现零效应。局限与展望：注意力熵较间接、判别力弱，需改进主语追踪注意力的提取与解释；LLM 措施主要对应理解侧而部分行为数据来自产出范式，未来需配合自 pace 阅读与可接受性判断实验以补全跨范式图景；土/德等语料中吸引子位置（先于或居中）差异也需控制。代码与数据见 github.com/utkuturk/scil_TurkNeu2026。

Abstract: Agreement attraction errors, in which a verb erroneously agrees with an intervening noun rather than its grammatical head, are amplified by morphological syncretism in some languages (English, German, Russian) but not others (Turkish, Armenian), a cross-linguistic pattern without a principled account. We use surprisal and attention entropy from large language models as processing proxies to investigate this variation across four languages. LLM-derived measures replicate behavioral findings in English and German (syncretism modulates attraction), align with Turkish null results (no modulation), and partially capture Russian patterns. We discuss further directions for better understanding why syncretism affects agreement attraction differently across languages.

</details>


### [83] [Mem-$π$: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21463)
*Xiaoqiang Wang,Chao Wang,Hadi Nekoei,Christopher Pal,Alexandre Lacoste,Spandana Gella,Bang Liu,Perouz Taslakian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mem-π 将 LLM 智能体的"记忆"从"检索外部存储条目"重构为"参数化的生成策略"：一个独立于下游智能体的记忆模型 π_mem（文本 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct / 视觉 Qwen2.5-VL-7B），在给定任务上下文时同时决定**何时**生成指导（[GENERATE] / [ABSTAIN]）与**生成什么**指导。训练分两阶段：经验蒸馏（对 JEF-Hinter 离线经验库做 SFT）＋适应蒸馏（基于 GRPO 的"决策—内容解耦"目标，通过结构化反事实 rollout 把优势分解为决策级与内容级信号）。在 WebArena、WorkArena、LifelongAgentBench、ALFWorld 四个基准上全面超越 RAG、Mem0、Memory-R1、MemRL 等检索式与 RL 记忆基线：WebArena 43.1%（基座 27.1%）、WorkArena 50.3%（42.0%）、ALFWorld 91.6%（85.3%）、LAB 36.7%（26.8%），平均相对提升超 20%，WebArena 相对增益接近 50%–59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 无状态 LLM 无法跨交互累积可复用经验，现有记忆增强智能体多依赖相似度检索（top-k 记忆库／技能库），返回的静态条目常与当前上下文错位：包含无关信息、只部分对齐、或过度具体（如把来源任务的"top-2"数字照搬到"top-3"查询）。2) 生成式记忆的已有尝试（ParaMem、SEAM 等）要么不条件于当前上下文，要么把生成当作"always-on"辅助步骤，带来可靠性风险：记忆是对下游智能体的干预而非最终输出，在歧义／弱 grounding／OOD 上下文下，幻觉式指导会直接污染智能体动作。3) 关键未解问题是"何时生成"与"生成什么"应联合学习：决策由一个短 token 前缀编码，内容是长序列，扁平策略梯度下内容梯度会淹没决策梯度；且从 SFT 初始化的策略偏好生成，i.i.d. 采样易出现整组无 abstain 分支，导致无法比较生成与弃权。认知科学（Bartlett 的"记忆是建构性重构"而非回放）也支持把记忆看作生成性过程。

Method: **建模**：记忆 = 参数化生成策略 π_mem(θ)，输入 x=(q, o)（任务指令＋环境观测，含截图/视觉 grounding），输出 y = d ⊕ m，d∈{[GENERATE],[ABSTAIN]}，m∈M∪{∅}；GENERATE 时把 m 前置注入智能体上下文 x⊕m，ABSTAIN 时用原上下文。记忆体量由模型大小界定而非经验条数，无需合并／遗忘，且可把多段经验融合成一条上下文相关提示，并实现"小私有模型 + 大前沿智能体"的职责分离。

**阶段一 经验蒸馏**：在离线经验库 E（由 JEF-Hinter 从轨迹中提炼的 context–guidance 对，每任务采 5 条 hint）上做自回归 SFT，J_mem^(1)=E[Σ log π(m_t|x,m_<t)]，把显式经验内化为参数化知识。超参：AdamW lr 2e-5、cosine＋5% warmup、batch 32、wd 0.01、grad clip 1.0、max len 2048、3 epochs、FSDP 8×H100-80G。

**阶段二 适应蒸馏**：以 GRPO 为基础（无需 value model，组内相对优势），奖励 R(x,y) = 二值下游任务奖励 + 长度正则 R_m(m)=−λ_len|m|/L_max（λ_len=0.1，L_max=256，仅作用在 GENERATE 分支，惩罚量级远小于 0/1 任务奖励）。关键设计：
- **对称初始化**：[ABSTAIN]/[GENERATE] 两个新 special token 的嵌入分别取语义相关词（skip/bypass、recall/retrieve）的均值后共享，使初始弃权概率≈50%，保证冷启动可探索（消融显示非对称初始化下 abstain 概率仅缓慢回升至约 21%）。
- **结构化反事实 rollout**：每组 G=4 条，1 条强制 [ABSTAIN]、3 条 [GENERATE]（温度 1.0、top_p 0.95、最长 256 token），保证每组同时含两种决策。
- **优势分解**：Δ = V_abs − V_gen（弃权与生成的平均奖励差）；决策优势 A_d：abstain 分支取 +Δ、generate 分支取 −Δ；内容优势 A_c：generate 分支内组归一化 (R−V_gen)/(std+ε)，abstain 为 0。
- **token 级信用分配**：决策 token（t≤T_d）只收 A_d；内容 token（t>T_d）仅在 Δ<0（生成确实优于弃权）时才收 A_c，即"Δ-门控"，避免在应弃权语境下更新劣质生成内容。
- **目标**：在 GRPO 目标中把标量组优势 Â^j 替换为逐 token 优势 A_t^j，其余（clip 0.2、KL β=0.01 对齐阶段一 π_ref、重要性比 π_old）不变。DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 + vLLM 共置，200 优化步，lr 1e-6，batch 8 任务/步。

**实验设计**：四个基准——WebArena（812 任务/5 域，647/165 划分）、WorkArena（ServiceNow，33 模板，20 seed 训练/10 seed 评测）、LAB（DB 22 技能、OS 29 Bash 技能，各 500 任务 7:3）、ALFWorld（3553 训练 / 134 unseen 测试）；奖励统一用任务成功率。基线：无记忆基座、RAG（BM25 top-1）、Mem0、Memory-R1、MemRL。记忆模型与下游智能体参数独立（基座 GPT-5.4-mini；另测 Qwen2.5-7B），训练与评测严格按划分隔离，仅用训练集 hint。

Result: **主结果（基座 GPT-5.4-mini，SR%）**：WebArena 43.1（基座 27.1 / RAG 31.4 / Mem0 31.9 / Memory-R1 33.2 / MemRL 34.0），子域全面领先（CMS 42.8 vs 基座 14.6，+28.2pp；Reddit 52.6，+23.8pp）；WorkArena 50.3 vs 42.0（Form +14.9pp）；ALFWorld 91.6 vs 85.3（+6.3pp）；LAB 36.7 vs 26.8（DB 38.4 / OS 35.0）；四基准均值 55.4 vs 基座 45.3、MemRL 50.0，平均相对增益超 20%，WebArena 相对增益近 50%（摘要称超 30%）。
**阶段增益**：阶段一（仅 SFT）WebArena 35.0，已可匹敌 Memory-R1(33.2)/MemRL(34.0)；阶段二再 +8.1pp（CMS +25.4pp），ALFWorld 仅 +1.6pp（基座已近饱和）。
**消融**：去阶段一初始化 −5.2pp(WA)/−4.7pp(ALF)；统一单阶段（加 BERTScore 相似度奖励 R_sim）−6.8pp/−5.9pp（模仿信号与任务信号梯度冲突）；去结构化 rollout −4.8pp/−4.5pp（最大单项损失）；去 Δ-门控 −1.8pp/−2.0pp；去长度正则 −1.2pp/−1.1pp。
**弃权校准**：按基座难度分箱，弃权率从易任务 71% 降到最难任务 13%，SR 增益从 +1.3pp 升到 +9.7pp——即"该弃权时弃权、该生成时生成"。最终弃权率：LAB 39%、WebArena 34%、WorkArena 28%、ALFWorld 21%，约 100 步内收敛。
**Token 效率**：平均 138 memory token/任务，比阶段一（200）少 31%、比 Memory-R1（225）少 38%，同时成功率最高——说明"总是生成"既低效又可能有害。
**跨智能体泛化**：不重训即迁移到未见过的 GPT-5.4-mini，Qwen2.5-7B 上 WA 27.9→46.1（+18.2pp，RAG 仅 +4.2）、ALF 72.9→84.7（+11.8）；GPT-5.4-mini 上 WA +16.0pp、ALF +6.3pp，整体增益为 RAG 的 3–5 倍，说明从弱智能体学到的记忆对强智能体仍可用。
**视觉变体**：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 记忆模型在 WebArena 全面优于纯文本版，+2.7pp（CMS +3.8、Shopping +3.3、GitLab 仅 +0.9）。
**案例分析**：成功集 Venn 显示 Mem-π 独有成功 19 项、基座+Mem-π 共同成功而 RAG 失败 10 项；两类胜因——① 生成会依据当前查询改写数字/键值/格式（"取前三行"而非照抄"前两行"）；② 弃权丢弃带偏的检索提示（不被"游戏卡盒"窄化搜索）。反向区域（110/010/100 共 13 项）显示生成也可能重排错误步骤或引入不必要冗长计划。

Conclusion: Mem-π 证明"生成式记忆"是检索中心式记忆系统的有效替代：把经验编码进参数并以任务奖励对齐，既省去外部记忆的合并/遗忘开销与 top-k 截断损失，又能按当前上下文改写细节并自主决定是否介入，且记忆 token 更少。方法论要点是把"是否生成"与"生成什么"在目标层面解耦（结构化反事实 rollout + Δ-门控的逐 token 信用分配），并依赖对称 token 初始化保证冷启动探索。局限：Stage 2 依赖下游任务的成功/失败二值奖励，对更弱智能体可能稀疏；生成会继承经验库中的偏差、偶发重排错误（相对检索失去"已验证流程"的保真）；尚无闭环经验更新与可溯源的归因记忆。作者给出的未来方向为闭环记忆学习与"grounded and attributable parametric memory"。

Abstract: We present Mem-$π$, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-$π$ uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the downstream agent, to generate context-specific guidance for complex tasks. Conditioned on the current agent context, the model jointly decides when to produce guidance and what guidance to produce. We train it with a decision-content decoupled reinforcement learning (RL) objective, enabling it to abstain when generation would not help and otherwise produce concise, useful guidance. Across diverse agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction, Mem-$π$ consistently outperforms retrieval-based and prior RL-optimized memory baselines, achieving over 30% relative improvement on web navigation tasks.

</details>

### [84] [Hypergraph Partitioning on GPU with Distinct Incident Hyperedges and Size Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20497)
*Marco Ronzani,Cristina Silvano*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对有限规模和独特入站超边约束下的超图划分问题，设计了充分利用GPU分层并行性的中心算法，通过在共享内存中批量处理节点对得分和链式节点移动验证实现高效并行，平均达到380倍加速，k=2时5倍加速且质量损失仅约5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图划分是工程领域中的NP难问题，其在大规模场景下的高效求解依赖于并行化计算；现有方法难以充分利用GPU的分层并行架构，且在特定约束条件（有限规模和每个分区的独特入站超边）下缺乏有效支持。

Method: 提出一种GPU中心的多级超图划分算法，关键设计包括：(1) 在划分形成阶段，将超图关联结构和唯一邻域存储于内存，以利用集合稀疏性并在共享内存中批量计算节点对得分；(2) 在划分细化阶段，将节点移动链接为改善路径和循环，通过并行约简检查累积集合大小变化的合法性；(3) 主要内核的执行跨度与局部超图参数呈线性关系。

Result: 实验结果表明：相比串行多级划分器平均实现380倍加速且连接度降低1.2-2.0倍；在k=2平衡划分中运行速度提升5倍，质量损失仅约5%；在可比运行时间下性能优于现有GPU划分器，且新增约束处理逻辑无明显开销。

Conclusion: 提出的GPU算法在运行时实现380倍加速，同时连接度降低1.2-2.0倍；k=2时仅损失约5%质量即可达到5倍加速，且无明显的约束处理开销，证明了在特定问题约束下GPU加速的有效性。

Abstract: Hypergraph partitioning is a recurring NP-hard problem in engineering; its efficient solution at scale hinges on parallelism. This work proposes a GPU-centric algorithm for multi-level hypergraph partitioning aimed at a specific set of problem constraints: limited size and distinct inbound hyperedges per partition. Manipulating hypergraphs requires deeply nested traversals and concurrent decision-making; our constraints impose further set operations amidst that. In turn, we design algorithms around the GPU's hierarchical parallelism and our problem's specifics. When forming partitions, we materialize the hypergraph's incidence structure and unique neighborhoods in memory to exploit set sparsity and batch node-pairing scores in shared memory. Upon refining partitions, we chain node moves into improving paths and cycles, checking their validity via cumulative set size variations reduced in parallel over moves. Thus, our dominant kernels exhibit a span linear in local hypergraph parameters. Results show an average 380x speedup and a 1.2-2.0x reduction in connectivity compared to a sequential multi-level partitioner. With minor changes, we also support k-way balanced partitioning, running 5x faster than CPU methods with a ~5% quality loss for k=2, outperforming an existing GPU partitioner at comparable runtime, with no measurable overhead from the added constraints handling logic.

</details>


### [85] [Hybrid Edge-HPC Systems for Low-Latency Data-Driven Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20532)
*Liubov Kurafeeva,Ryan Hartung,Benjamin Carter,Alan Subedi,Avhishek Biswas,Michael Fay,Shantenu Jha,Chandra Krintz,Andre Merzky,Douglas Thainand Memet Can Vuran,Rich Wolski*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 RBF（Reverse Backfill）混合边缘-HPC 架构：在边缘节点用轻量级代理模型（surrogate model）持续低延迟推理，同时把高保真仿真与训练作为异步、机会式的"模型改进引擎"部署在专用集群与共享HPC（批调度队列）上，通过分布式日志实现数据与模型的版本化分发与编排。在真实数字农业场景（4英亩柑橘防虫网棚 CUPS，用 OpenFOAM CFD 仿真气流并训练 PINN/FNO/PCR 代理模型，模型部署到树莓派）上的实测表明：专用流水线周期约134.8±58.0分钟，系统性能由仿真延迟主导，网络与边缘推理开销可忽略；叠加 NERSC 机会式 HPC 计算后平均模型发布间隔降至50.0分钟（2.7×降低陈旧度），有效模型年龄保持在2小时以内，误差低于0.88 m/s 传感器测量误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴网络物理系统（CPS，如环境监测、能源系统、数字农业）需要对流式传感数据做低延迟推理，同时模型要反映复杂且演化的物理过程。但高保真模型更新依赖昂贵的高保真仿真与训练，必须在远程 HPC 上以批调度方式执行，这导致"边缘侧要求的响应性"与"仿真驱动更新的成本、吞吐与可用性"之间存在根本性错配：模型更新天然延迟且不规则，系统只能在陈旧模型下运行，又无法直接从流式观测中学习（区别于数据驱动的持续学习系统）。因此需要一个显式支持异步、不规则模型刷新的系统架构。

Method: 1) 架构：RBF 分为三层——边缘推理层（数据采集、摄取、低延迟推理，支持异构网络含私有5G与网络切片）、专用集群层（定期执行仿真+训练）、HPC层（批调度下的机会式额外仿真产能），三层通过容错分布式日志（CSPOT）交换数据与模型制品。2) 核心机制：推理与仿真/训练解耦；代理模型与仿真框架可插拔（PINN、FNO、PCR）；把"反向回填（reverse backfill）"重新解释为用机会式计算提升模型精度而非提升资源利用率；模型制品带训练截止日期（training cutoff date），边缘侧比较截止日期、仅当严格更新才部署，保证模型新鲜度单调不减，支持版本化/替换/回滚。3) 数据搬运：扩展 CSPOT 实现 RBFDM（基于日志的版本化文件推/拉协议，支持轮询通知、CI/CD 软件更新、基于 CAPlets 的安全通信）。4) 通信：srsRAN + Open5GS 构建 5G SA 私有网络（Band n78, 40MHz, TDD），两条数据路径（传感器遥测低延迟路径 vs 模型分发高吞吐路径），用网络切片隔离。5) 仿真：72 个并行 OpenFOAM（SnappyHexMesh + PorousSimpleFOAM）仿真，约700万厘米级不规则网格；专用CPU/GPU上 sim+train 约2小时。6) 评估：15次运行统计流水线时延与方差、模型精度随时间衰减曲线（不同历史窗口 6/12/24/48 h）、多站点（专用集群 + NERSC Perlmutter）实时实验的模型发布事件时间线、模型传输 P-95 延迟与5G切片下吞吐/竞争退化、边缘推理时延。

Result: 专用流水线 134.8±58.0 分钟（sim≈52分钟CFD + 14分钟数据转换 + train≈55分钟：PINN 50.0±21.6、FNO 54.8±18.2、PCR 15.9±3.4），方差源于数据暂存/模型传输同步开销与训练迭代次数变化。模型精度随时延衰减，PINN 在生成后0–6小时用6h或24h历史最准，6小时后48h历史更优。NERSC 队列等待17–19小时（72-CPU任务）、11–38分钟（2-GPU任务）。FNO 发布间隔：专用集群 平均134.8/最小113.4分钟，NERSC 平均80.0/最小47.9分钟，组合 平均50.0/最小3.3分钟，平均节奏降低2.7倍，有效模型年龄<2小时，三类模型均低于0.88 m/s 传感器误差界。模型体积 PINN 290KB、FNO 9.1MB、PCR 1.1MB；无切片时竞争致吞吐下降20–23%（FNO 4.92→3.88 MB/s），启用切片后仅2%退化（4.72→4.62 MB/s）。边缘推理均在数秒内，PCR为亚秒级。结论：端到端性能由仿真/训练延迟主导，网络传输与边缘推理开销可忽略。

Conclusion: RBF 证明可把 HPC 资源以"异步模型改进引擎"的形式集成进运行中的网络物理系统：在模型更新受高保真仿真约束的条件下，仍能维持连续的低延迟推理，并通过机会式反向回填持续降低模型陈旧度（部署中平均陈旧度降低2.7倍）。系统架构具备跨模型、跨网络配置的灵活实验能力。局限与未来工作：当前仅依赖"数据暂存+模型传输"的文件式数据搬运（RBFDM）；历史窗口长度作为超参需按每次计算动态自动调优（会延长流水线周期）；由于物理上限（每5分钟新数据、测量误差±0.44~0.87 m/s），模型生成快于5分钟或误差低于0.44 m/s 已无收益；边缘推理时延数据未在正文展开。

Abstract: Emerging cyber-physical systems increasingly require low-latency inference from streaming sensor data while maintaining models that reflect complex and evolving physical processes. In many domains, however, model updates depend on high-fidelity simulations and training executed on remote high-performance computing (HPC) systems under batch scheduling. This creates a fundamental mismatch between the responsiveness required at the edge and the cost, throughput, and availability of simulation-driven model updates.
  We present RBF (Reverse Backfill), a hybrid edge-HPC learning and inference architecture that integrates low-latency edge inference with asynchronous, simulation-driven model improvement. RBF targets simulation-bounded settings in which model updates are constrained by simulation throughput and HPC scheduling delays, and reinterprets HPC backfilling by using opportunistic computation to improve model accuracy rather than system utilization. RBF decouples inference from simulation and training by deploying lightweight surrogate models at the edge while incorporating improved models asynchronously as they become available. The architecture supports pluggable surrogate models and orchestrates computation across heterogeneous infrastructure spanning edge devices, private 5G, cloud, and HPC resources.
  We instantiate RBF using a real-world digital agriculture deployment that couples edge sensing with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations to infer airflow patterns in a large agricultural screenhouse. Our evaluation characterizes end-to-end system behavior under realistic constraints, quantifying simulation latency, training cost, inference throughput, and the impact of delayed model updates on prediction accuracy. Results demonstrate that RBF enables continuous, low-latency inference while improving model fidelity over time despite delayed and irregular model updates.

</details>


### [86] [Llamas on the Web: Memory-Efficient, Performance-Portable, and Multi-Precision LLM Inference with WebGPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20706)
*Reese Levine,Rithik Sharma,Nikhil Jain,Abhijit Ramesh,Zheyuan Chen,Neha Abbas,James Contini,Tyler Sorensen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: LlamaWeb is a WebGPU backend for llama.cpp that enables memory-efficient, performance-portable LLM inference in the browser through static memory planning, tunable kernels, and templated quantization kernels. It reduces memory by 29-33% and improves throughput by 45-69% compared to existing browser-based frameworks, while remaining competitive with native backends.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Running LLMs in the browser offers compelling advantages (efficiency, privacy, portability), but is fundamentally limited by constrained browser memory and heterogeneous hardware — existing solutions fail to adequately address both challenges simultaneously.

Method: Three core technical strategies: (1) Static memory planning and efficient model loading to reduce memory overhead; (2) A tunable kernel library to handle cross-device hardware variability; (3) Templated GPU kernels supporting diverse quantization formats for broad model support and extensibility.

Result: Memory reduction: 29-33% less memory across device/browser/OS combinations; Throughput: 45-69% decode throughput increase on four GPUs from separate vendors; Compatibility: competitive with or superior to vendor-specific backends on certain devices; Evaluated across 16 devices, 8 vendors, 10 language models, and 4 quantization formats.

Conclusion: LlamaWeb is a practical and effective solution for browser-based LLM inference, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both memory efficiency (29-33% reduction) and throughput (45-69% improvement) while maintaining broad model compatibility and competitive performance against native backends.

Abstract: Running language models in the browser presents a unique opportunity to build efficient, private, and portable AI applications, but requires contending with constrained memory availability and heterogeneous hardware targets. To realize this opportunity, we present Llamas on the Web (LlamaWeb), a WebGPU backend for llama.cpp that enables memory-efficient and performance-portable LLM inference across a wide range of model weight formats in the browser. Our design significantly reduces memory overhead through static memory planning and efficient model loading, addresses cross-device variability through a tunable kernel library, and introduces templated GPU kernels that support performant implementations of numerous quantization formats, enabling broad model support and extensibility to new formats.
  We evaluate LlamaWeb on 16 devices from 8 vendors, collecting data from 10 language models and four model weight formats. We compare LlamaWeb against existing browser-based LLM frameworks and find that LlamaWeb requires 29-33% less memory across several combinations of device, browser, and operating system. We also evaluate LlamaWeb's performance against these frameworks and find that it increases decode throughput by 45-69% across four GPUs from separate vendors. In addition, we compare LlamaWeb's performance against other llama.cpp backends, where it is competitive with and even beats vendor-specific backend performance on some devices.

</details>


### [87] [Instant GPU Efficiency Visibility at Fleet Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20799)
*Connor Pedersen,Dong H. Ahn,Michel Migdal,Collin Neale,Nik Konyuchenko*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文提出 Overall FLOP Utilization (OFU)：仅用 DCGM 暴露的两个片上性能计数器——Tensor Pipe Activity（PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE）与 SM 时钟频率——相乘（再除以 Tensor Core 峰值频率）即可估算 GPU 浮点利用率，作为无需应用插桩、精度无关、跨 GPU 代的 MFU 代理指标。在 H100/GB200 上经 GEMM 受控实验标定误差来源（tile 量化、cuBLAS 内核选择、时钟采样噪声、Tensor Core 时钟域、非张量欠计），tile 量化校正后与真实 MFU 误差 ≤2 个百分点；在 608 个生产训练任务上相关性 r=0.78（剔除 82 个 FLOPs 误算任务后），并已部署于大规模机队，检出 2.5× 的效率回退与混合精度利用率变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 AI HPC 投资（到 2029 年累计超 2.8 万亿美元）使 GPU 利用率的每个百分点都直接对应数百万美元收益。现有三类测量手段均无法满足“全机队、免插桩、连续监控”的需求：(1) 用户级性能分析工具（Nsight Compute/Systems、PyTorch Profiler、DeepSpeed Flops Profiler、HPCToolkit）保真度高但需逐任务插桩、有开销、面向定点剖析；(2) 框架级 MFU 估算（Megatron-LM、NeMo、PyTorch Lightning）需逐框架集成、FLOPs 公式随新架构（MoE、latent-space 路由、多模态）演进而失效、覆盖碎片化；(3) 硬件性能计数器（DCGM）虽非侵入，但缺乏系统性精度刻画与跨代验证。文中给出的内部审查实例极具说服力：两周窗口内实测训练 MFU 仅约 20%（健康区间 35–50%），只有约 20% 机队负载接入了 MFU 上报，80% GPU 小时完全不可见；且一个 288-GPU 的 DeepSeek 风格 MoE 任务报告 MFU 54.27%，硬件计数器实测仅 25.58%（相对偏差 112.2%），原因是框架 FLOPs 公式未计入潜空间投影、虚高约 3 倍。因此需要一种只依赖硬件已暴露信号、具备可界定精度、可直接嵌入机队弹性与 goodput 服务的利用率指标。

Method: 1) 推导：从 GPU 浮点执行模型出发——现代 NVIDIA GPU 每 SM 含 128 个 FP32 CUDA core（Volta/Ampere 为 64）与专用 Tensor Core 流水线，H100 每 SM 每周期 Tensor Core 可产出 4096 FP16 FLOPs（CUDA core 仅 256，比值 16×，再加上 2× 位宽差），故 Tensor Core 活动在现代 AI 负载中占绝对主导（Transformer encoder 层中矩阵乘占 99.8% FLOPs）。TPA 本身是硬件平均的“执行张量指令周期/总周期”，近似每周期 FLOPs 比例；乘以时钟比 f_SM/f_max 即从周期域映射到时间域，得到 OFU = TPA × f_SM/f_max。峰值 TFLOP/s = SM 数 × 每 SM 每周期 FLOPs × f_max；H100 SXM 上张量精度最高仅 1830 MHz（SM boost 为 1980 MHz），故 FP16 峰值 = 132×4096×1830 MHz = 989.4 TFLOP/s，与官方规格一致；GB200 用 2062 MHz 得 148×8192×2062 = 2499.9 TFLOP/s，与 2500 一致。2) 五项误差特性刻画：(a) tile 量化与 cuBLAS 内核选择——GEMM 理论 FLOPs 恰为 2MNK，但输出按 T_M×T_N×T_K 分块、末块零填充，且现代内核引入 CGA 集群构成两级 tile 层级（双重向上取整），实际执行 FLOPs ≥ 2MNK；nvJet 内核名（nvjet_sm90_hsh_256x160_64x4_2x1）编码了 tile/CGA 参数，可做闭式 FLOPs 预测并与 NCU 误差 <1000 FLOPs；TF32 因 cuBLAS 选择 XMMA/CUTLASS 而偏离 nvJet，开销最高（小区尺寸可达 33%），对齐良好且 N≥4096 时各精度开销均值 2–3%、最大约 9%，非对齐最高约 12%。(b) 精度可移植性：在 GB200 上验证 BF16/FP8/NVFP4 相对 TF32 的加速比，OFU 导出 1.85×/3.51×/6.75× 与实测 1.78×/3.27×/6.10× 一致，并解释了块缩放 SF 记账开销（FP8 每 128×128 tile 需 1 个 512B SF 块；NVFP4 每 128×64 一个，典型 tile 下 SF 块数从 3 增至 12）导致的低精度小尺寸加速比衰减。(c) 时钟采样噪声：TPA 是窗口平均而 SM 时钟（DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK）是瞬时点采样；H100 上 16384×16384 BF16 GEMM 期间时钟在 1201–1558 MHz 间波动（均值 1352、标准差 32 MHz）；用 nvidia-smi dmon 1 s 间隔采集 3000 s 后重采样至 5–30 s，30 s 间隔下 95% 置信区间仍 <±0.22 个百分点（OFU 本身约 55%）；但 DCGM 的张量计数器最长只平均 30 s 窗口，故采样间隔须 ≤30 s。(d) Tensor Core 时钟域与理论峰值差异（见上）。(e) 非张量欠计（可忽略，且与 PaLM/Megatron/OpenAI 缩放定律的 MFU 约定一致）。3) 精度评估：每 GPU×精度 500 个随机 (M,K,N) GEMM，各持续 5 分钟，用 Nsight Systems 以 10 kHz 采集计数器与吞吐，另用一次 NCU pass 获取真实 FLOPs 数以做 tile 量化校正（OFU_adj = OFU × 2MNK/FLOPs_NCU）。4) 生产验证：608 个 H100 生产训练任务（2025-08-27 至 09-10，8–5888 GPU，80 种配置、26 名用户，Megatron-LM），MFU 由 OneLogger 给出（train_tflop×gpu_count/989），OFU 由 Prometheus 抓取的 30 s 间隔 DCGM 遥测按 mean(PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE × SM_CLOCK/1830) 计算。5) 运维部署：接入 Osmo（Kubernetes 原生编排平台）做作业级时序看板，接入 NVIDIA Mission Control Autonomous Job Recovery Service 做集群级弹性与 goodput 监控。

Result: 受控 GEMM：原始 OFU 系统性高估 1–2 个百分点（H100 FP16 MAE 1.90 pp、TF32 3.46 pp、FP8 1.58 pp；GB200 FP16 1.08、TF32 2.10、FP8 0.64、NVFP4 1.21 pp）；经 tile 量化校正后 H100 上 99–100% 的 GEMM 误差 ≤2 pp、MAE <0.6 pp，GB200 上 95–100% 误差 ≤2 pp 且 100% ≤5 pp，仅残留约 1 pp 的系统性低估（疑为 10 kHz 采样开销）。生产任务：608 个作业整体 Pearson r=0.53，平均 MFU 25.1%±10.9% vs 平均 OFU 25.0%±8.3%，MAE 6.2%，79.4% 作业绝对误差 ≤10%；规模越大一致性越好，≥768 GPU 的作业绝对误差稳定在 5% 以内（如 768 GPU 组 1.2%±0.7%、1536 GPU 组 0.3%±0.2%），而 288 GPU 组 MAE 达 18.0%。剔除两处框架 FLOPs 误算涉及的 82 个作业后相关性由 0.53 升至 r=0.78，超过 10% 误差的作业比例由 21.8% 降至 16.7%。三类生产 FLOPs 误算被定位：(1) 16B DeepSeek 风格 MoE（288 GPU）在路由前把激活从 hidden 2048 降投影到 latent 512，框架仍按 2048 计 FLOPs，虚高约 3×，报告 54.27% vs OFU 25.58%（相对误差 112.2%），修正后 MFU 降至 18.45%（相对误差 27.9%）；(2) 8B 混合 MoE（attention+Mamba+dense MLP+sparse MoE，300B tokens）所用 Megatron-LM 分支不支持混合架构，所有层按自注意力+稠密 MLP 计价，MFU 24.51% vs OFU 15.56%（相对误差 57.5%），按层类型分别计数后 1536 GPU 相似任务 MFU 17.8–18.0% vs OFU 18.5–18.7%（相对误差 3–4%）；(3) 8B 世界基础模型（256 GB200）报告 MFU 26% vs OFU 34%，原因是 FLOPs 公式未计入激活检查点带来的前向重算（每步 4F 而非 3F，+33%），修正后 MFU 升至 33%，与 OFU 相差 1 pp 内。运维：256 H100 具身智能体训练中 OFU 立即暴露低利用率，PyTorch Profiler trace 显示环境变量 TORCH_DISTRIBUTED_DEBUG=DETAIL 被误合入主干，导致每次 NCCL 集合通信都注入 gloo:all_gather 校验（trace 中 15360 次 gloo:send、7560 次 gloo:recv、240 次 all_gather，CPU Gloo 传输序列化 all-reduce），移除后 OFU 提升 2.5×。6,144 GPU GB200 混合精度（Mamba-Transformer MoE，BF16/FP8/NVFP4）预训练 711 小时：因多精度需用 FLOPs 加权调和平均有效峰值 P_eff = ΣF_i/Σ(F_i/P_i)，逐点相关 r=0.718，按作业平均后 174 个作业相关升至 r=0.977，两种模式平均差异 <1 个百分点，并准确跟踪了切回纯 BF16 时期有效峰值下降导致的 MFU 上升。

Conclusion: OFU 通过 DCGM 已有的两个计数器（TPA 与 SM 时钟）即可对任意 NVIDIA GPU 代际与任意数值精度给出“即时”的浮点利用率视图，是应用级 MFU 的可行补充而非替代：它精度更不易出错、可直接指出存在显著优化空间的工作负载，在超大规模与混合/低精度训练中无需任何代码插桩即可忠实跟踪，并能把“即时全机队可见性”转化为性能缺陷的快速诊断（案例中最大收益 2.5×）。同时论文明确了方法边界：OFU 是粗粒度信号，只回答“是否低效及严重程度”，定位原因仍需剖析（如 PyTorch Profiler）；其精度依赖正确的 Tensor Core 峰值频率与 tile 量化校正（nvJet 可闭式预测，XMMA/CUTLASS 需运行时内省），并残留约 1 pp 系统性低估与非张量路径的忽略；采集间隔须 ≤30 s（DCGM 张量计数器窗口上限）。整体表明：经过严谨验证与工程化运营的硬件性能计数器，是实现全机队级 GPU 利用率可观测性的一条实用路径，可显著降低挖掘 AI HPC 计算低效的门槛。

Abstract: We present Overall FLOP Utilization (OFU), a hardware-level, precision-agnostic GPU efficiency metric for AI workloads on HPC systems, derived from two on-chip performance counters: Tensor Pipe Activity and SM clock frequency. OFU requires no application instrumentation and works across GPU generations and numeric precisions. We characterize five properties of the OFU approximation -- tile quantization, floating-point precision scaling, clock sampling noise, Tensor Core clock domains, and non-tensor undercounting -- through controlled GEMM experiments on H100 and GB200 across FP16, TF32, FP8, and NVFP4. After tile-quantization correction, OFU predicts application-level MFU to within <=2 percentage points. Against 608 production training jobs, OFU achieves r = 0.78 correlation with application-level MFU and surfaces two framework-level FLOPs miscalculations. Deployed across large-scale GPU fleets, OFU has detected a 2.5x efficiency regression and tracked precision-dependent utilization changes in mixed-precision pretraining. Our evaluation and operational experience suggest OFU is a practical, deployment-ready complement to application-level MFU for continuous fleet-wide efficiency monitoring.

</details>


### [88] [PlexRL: Cluster-Level Orchestration of Serviceized LLM Execution for RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20863)
*Yiqi Zhang,Fangzheng Jiao,Tian Tang,Boyu Tian,Hangyu Wang,Qiaoling Chen,Guoteng Wang,Zhen Jiang,Peng Sun,Ping Zhang,Xiaohe Hu,Ziming Liu,Menghao Zhang,Yanmin Jia,Yang You,Siyuan Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PlexRL提出了一个集群级运行时系统，通过在RLVR任务间时分复用统一的大语言模型服务来填充空闲周期，从而将GPU小时成本降低最多37.58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR training suffers from structural inefficiency due to long-tailed rollouts, tool-induced stalls, and asymmetric resource requirements, causing unavoidable idle time that job-local optimizations cannot eliminate.

Method: PlexRL uses a centralized cluster-level runtime that time-slices unified LLM services across RLVR jobs, managing model placement, state transitions, and function-level scheduling under strict affinity constraints to fill idle periods without expensive model migration.

Result: PlexRL significantly improves effective cluster capacity and reduces user GPU hour cost by up to 37.58% while preserving algorithmic flexibility and introducing minimal per-job overhead.

Conclusion: Cluster-level multiplexing via PlexRL represents a promising direction for improving RLVR training efficiency, effectively reducing GPU costs by up to 37.58% without sacrificing algorithmic flexibility.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently unlocked strong reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), triggering rapid exploration of new algorithms and data. However, RLVR training is notoriously inefficient: long-tailed rollouts, tool-induced stalls, and asymmetric resource requirements between rollout and training introduce substantial idle time that cannot be eliminated by job-local optimizations such as synchronous pipelining, asynchronous rollout, or colocated execution.
  We argue that this inefficiency is structural. While idle gaps are unavoidable within individual RLVR jobs, they are largely anti-correlated across jobs and therefore exploitable at the cluster level. Leveraging this observation, we present PlexRL, a cluster-level runtime for multiplexing unified LLM services across RLVR jobs. By centrally managing model placement, state transitions, and function-level scheduling under strict affinity constraints, PlexRL time-slices LLM execution across jobs to fill otherwise idle periods without expensive model migration. Our implementation and evaluations demonstrate that PlexRL significantly improves effective cluster capacity and reduces user GPU hour cost by maximum 37.58% while preserving algorithmic flexibility and introducing minimal per-job overhead.

</details>


### [89] [Ark: Offchain Transaction Batching in Bitcoin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20952)
*Pim Keer,Matteo Maffei,Marco Argentieri,Andrew Camilleri,Zeta Avarikioti*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Ark是首个比特币兼容的commit-chain方案，通过VTXO和不受信任操作员实现链下支付，用户无需预锁资金即可接收链下转账，仅相关用户参与即可更新状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比特币的大规模采用受限于其共识算法的可扩展性（需链上确认每笔交易），现有Layer-2方案存在部署困难（需锁定资金、复杂辅助协议）或因比特币脚本能力有限无法实现非托管方式。

Method: 采用VTXO（虚拟UTXO）模型，通过不受信任的操作员聚合交易为简洁的链上承诺，仅需相关用户参与状态更新。

Result: 提出首个比特币兼容的commit-chain协议Ark，定义形式化安全模型并证明其安全性；发现并修复了测试网实现中的两个安全漏洞；实验评估显示可实现约200 vB的常量级链上足迹。

Conclusion: Ark通过引入VTXO和无需信任的操作员，实现了比特币上可部署的轻量级Layer-2方案，仅需约200 vB的常量级链上足迹，合作退出每用户增加一个输出，单边退出需O(log n)笔交易。

Abstract: Bitcoin is the cryptocurrency with the largest market capitalisation, but its widespread adoption is fundamentally limited by the scalability constraints of its consensus algorithm, which requires every transaction to be confirmed onchain. To address this, several Layer-2 scalability solutions have been proposed to move payments offchain -- most notably, the Lightning Network. However, their deployment remains hindered by cumbersome setup requirements: users must lock funds onchain to participate and engage in complex auxiliary protocols (e.g., for channel rebalancing, top-ups, and routing). Other solutions, like payment pools, sidechains and rollups, cannot be implemented in a non-custodial way on Bitcoin due to its limited scripting capabilities, or require all protocol participants to update the offchain state.
  In this work, we present Ark, the first Bitcoin-compatible commit-chain. Ark enables offchain transactions of virtual UTXOs (VTXOs), through an untrusted operator who aggregates them into succinct onchain commitments. A distinctive feature of Ark is its ease of deployment: users can receive offchain payments without locking any funds beforehand and Ark state updates can be performed only requiring the users involved in that update.
  We formally define the Ark protocol and prove its security. During this process, we identified two attacks affecting the testnet implementation, which we responsibly disclosed and proposed fixes for, which have been now integrated into the mainnet implementation. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates that Ark can commit onchain to batches of arbitrarily many VTXOs with a constant-sized footprint of approximately 200 vB. Cooperative exits add one output per user, while unilateral exits require $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$ transactions of roughly 150 vB per VTXO for a batch of $n$ VTXOs.

</details>


### [90] [Diagnosing Overhead in Dispatch Operations: Cross-architecture Observatory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20982)
*Bole Ma,Jan Eitzinger,Harald Koestler,Gerhard Wellein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DODOCO通过系统性实验验证了当前AlltoAll dispatch优化所依赖的两个假设均不成立：路由失衡由模型固有决定而非系统可纠正，且模拟token基准严重失真。研究意外发现五种MoE架构可稳定分为"数据弹性"和"持续集中"两个类别，这对未来互连和调度设计具有重要指导价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前针对MoE专家并行的AlltoAll通信瓶颈缓解方案（预测性样本放置、自适应专家重布局、分层集合通信、EP感知拓扑）基于两个关键假设：路由失衡可由系统层纠正，以及模拟token基准能真实反映生产路由。该研究旨在验证这两个假设的有效性。

Method: 在H100集群上，对5种MoE检查点（涵盖5种序列混合器设计：DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA、DeepSeek-MoE-16B MHA、Qwen3-30B GQA、Nemotron-30B Mamba-2、Qwen3.5-35B GDN）进行系统性评估；在5×6数据条件矩阵下测试，并在4到32 ranks范围内执行匹配的EP扫描。

Result: 两个假设均不成立：(1)EP扩展仅使per-expert max/mean token ratio变化不超过5%，路由失衡由模型路由决策固有决定；(2)模拟token高估路由基尼系数达2.35倍，并虚构了batch-size扩展趋势；(3)意外发现五种架构稳定分为两组：MHA和Mamba-2（数据弹性型）在wikitext上基尼系数降至0.105和0.150；MLA和GDN（持续集中型）在所有真实文本条件下保持0.24以上，模拟数据下达到0.29-0.38；GQA居中。

Conclusion: AlltoAll dispatch优化应基于架构分类（数据弹性组vs持续集中组）而非EP度或模拟数据特征。该研究揭示MoE路由失衡是模型层固有属性，系统层无法纠正，这对未来互联和调度设计具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: AlltoAll dispatch is the dominant bottleneck of MoE expert parallelism, and the interconnect community has responded with four families of mitigations: predictive sample placement, adaptive expert relayout, hierarchical collectives, and EP-aware topology. All four rest on two assumptions about the workload. The first is that routing imbalance is correctable by the system layer. The second is that the mock-token benchmarks evaluating them faithfully represent production routing. We introduce DODOCO to test both assumptions.
  We instrument five MoE checkpoints spanning five sequence-mixer designs (DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA, DeepSeek-MoE-16B MHA, Qwen3-30B GQA, Nemotron-30B Mamba-2, Qwen3.5-35B GDN) under a 5 by 6 grid of data conditions plus a matched EP scan from 4 to 32 ranks on H100s; both assumptions fail. Scaling EP changes the per-expert max/mean token ratio by at most 5% within every architecture's measurable range: the straggler is intrinsic to the routing decision the model makes, not to how its experts land on ranks. Mock tokens overestimate routing Gini by up to a factor of 2.35 and fabricate a batch-size scaling trend that vanishes the moment real text replaces random IDs.
  A third pattern, unexpected, emerges from the same matrix: the five architectures cleave into two stable bands. MHA and Mamba-2 (data-resilient) drop to Gini 0.105 and 0.150 on wikitext. MLA and GDN (persistently concentrated) stay above 0.24 on every real-text condition and reach 0.29 to 0.38 on mock. GQA is the intermediate case. These bands, not the EP degree or the mock-data profile, are the right workload input to AlltoAll-aware interconnect and dispatch design.

</details>


### [91] [NanoCP: Request-Level Dynamic Context Parallelism for Data-Expert Parallel Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21100)
*Jiefei Chen,Binbin Lin,Jinming Ma,Jiangfei Duan,Haojie Duanmu,Hao Liu,Qinxiu Cheng,Xiuhong Li,Zhilin Pei,Hui Wang,Xingcheng Zhang,Dahua Lin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出DCP（动态上下文并行）系统，通过将MoE通信与KV缓存放置解耦，并根据请求的KV占用动态调整上下文并行度，解决MoE模型服务系统中注意力延迟与MoE通信延迟之间的负载不平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE服务系统将请求的注意力、MoE通信和KV缓存绑定到单个实例，但注意力延迟随KV缓存大小增长，MoE通信延迟随批大小增长，这种绑定无法同时平衡两者，导致EP straggler和长上下文下的尾延迟增加。现有的上下文并行虽能缓解这些问题，但其均匀的并行度会带来高昂的通信和注意力开销。

Method: 提出动态上下文并行（DCP）：根据每个请求的KV占用为其分配上下文并行度——长请求将注意力分配到多个实例，短请求保留本地处理。通过AOT图引擎和自定义基于路由的通信后端实现与静态执行的桥接。

Result: 在严格TPOT SLO下，DCP实现1.88×-3.27×的请求率提升，P99尾延迟降低1.79×-2.12×。

Conclusion: DCP通过将KV缓存"液化"到集群中，有效平衡了各实例的KV缓存占用和批大小，在保持高请求率的同时显著缓解了straggler问题。

Abstract: Modern serving systems for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models adopt hybrid data-expert parallelism: expert parallelism (EP) shards experts across GPUs to scale capacity, while data parallelism (DP) replicates attention layers across instances to process independent requests. Existing systems bind each request's attention, MoE communication, and KV cache to a single instance. Because attention latency scales with KV cache size while MoE communication latency scales with batch size, this binding cannot balance both simultaneously, producing EP stragglers; it also fragments KV memory across instances, inflating tail latency under long contexts. While existing context parallelism (CP) mitigates these constraints, its uniform parallelism degree incurs prohibitive communication and attention-side overheads.
  We present \work, which decouples MoE communication from KV cache placement and achieves dual balance through dynamic context parallelism (DCP). DCP assigns each request a context-parallel degree sized to its KV footprint: long requests distribute attention across multiple instances; short requests remain local.
  This dynamic parallelism effectively liquefies the KV cache across the cluster, balancing both the per-instance KV cache occupancy and batch sizes without unnecessary load-balancing costs. To bridge DCP with static execution, \work introduces an ahead-of-time (AOT) graph engine paired with a custom routing-based communication backend. Experimental results show that \work maintains up to $1.88\times$--$3.27\times$ higher request rates under strict time-per-output-token (TPOT) service level objectives (SLOs). Furthermore, \work significantly mitigates stragglers, reducing P99 tail latency by up to $1.79\times$--$2.12\times$.

</details>


### [92] [Automated Byzantine-Resilient Clustered Decentralized Federated Learning for Battery Intelligence in Connected EVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21115)
*Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha,Abdelaziz Amara Korba,Yacine Ghamri-Doudane*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: This paper proposes ABC-DFL, a Byzantine-resilient clustered decentralized federated learning framework for connected EVs, replacing centralized servers with blockchain-based aggregation. The FLECA protocol uses adaptive threshold filtering and robust clustering to mitigate Byzantine attacks, achieving superior defense performance while maintaining convergence and system practicality.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing federated learning frameworks for EV battery data management rely on centralized aggregation schemes, which pose critical limitations in security and trust for intelligent transportation systems.

Method: ABC-DFL replaces central servers with an open-permissioned blockchain featuring dynamic QBFT protocol and oracle-based aggregation. The core FLECA protocol employs hierarchical aggregation where each EV filters malicious updates using adaptive thresholds based on deviation from reference model updates, while oracle nodes perform inter-group aggregation through robust clustering to isolate trustworthy EV groups.

Result: FLECA achieves convergence performance matching FedProx under benign conditions, outperforms existing defenses with attack impact scores below 0.10 in adaptive adversarial scenarios, and multitask learning experiments confirm the effectiveness and fairness of the incentive mechanism. On-chain and off-chain benchmarks validate system practicality.

Conclusion: The proposed ABC-DFL framework effectively addresses security and trust limitations in centralized FL systems for EV battery data management. FLECA demonstrates robust Byzantine resilience while maintaining convergence performance, with practical on-chain/off-chain validation confirming system feasibility.

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for managing electric vehicle (EV) battery data in intelligent transportation systems (ITS), enabling privacy-preserving tasks such as anomaly detection and capacity estimation. However, most existing frameworks rely on centralized aggregation schemes, which pose critical limitations in terms of security and trust. To address these challenges, we propose ABC-DFL, an automated Byzantine-resilient clustered decentralized federated learning (C-DFL) framework for connected EVs. The proposed incentive-driven C-DFL system replaces the central server with an open-permissioned blockchain, featuring a new dynamic Quorum Byzantine Fault Tolerance (QBFT) protocol and an oracle-based aggregation layer, to enhance trust, security, and automation. At the core of ABC-DFL lies FLECA (Filtered Layered Enhanced Clustering Aggregation), a robust hierarchical aggregation protocol that mitigates Byzantine attacks by having each EV filter malicious updates using an adaptive threshold based on deviations from its reference model update. Oracle nodes, responsible for inter-group aggregation, employ robust clustering to isolate and aggregate model updates from trustworthy EV groups. Comprehensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that FLECA matches FedProx convergence under benign conditions and significantly outperforms existing defenses with attack impact scores below 0.10 in adaptive adversarial scenarios. Furthermore, several learning experiments with multitask models confirm the effectiveness and fairness of the incentive mechanism. Finally, on-chain and off-chain benchmarks validate the practicality of ABC-DFL.

</details>


### [93] [Cloud-Native Operation of Roadside Infrastructure Enabling Demand-Driven Collective Perception via V2X](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21145)
*Lukas Zanger,Fabian Thomsen,Guido Linden,Jean-Pierre Busch,Lennart Reiher,Lutz Eckstein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Kubernetes的云原生架构，用于C-ITS中分布式路边基础设施的需求驱动运营。通过动态按需部署路边服务（如V2X集体感知应用），在不必要时保持服务休眠以降低能耗和资源消耗。亚琛测试场的实车验证表明该方案可行且具有能效提升潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着路边单元数量增长和功能范围扩展，协同智能交通系统（C-ITS）的可扩展且高效的运营面临挑战。传统的路边基础设施部署方式缺乏灵活性和资源优化能力。

Method: 1. 构建基于Kubernetes集群的云原生架构，跨越路边单元与云服务器；2. 实现需求驱动的编排方法，动态部署资源密集型服务；3. 以V2X集体感知应用为例进行按需部署验证；4. 在亚琛测试场进行真实道路实验，并对V2X数据进行能耗节约潜力分析。

Result: 实验验证表明，集体感知应用能够在联网车辆到达前及时启动，使其受益；在无需求时应用保持非活跃状态，有效降低了能耗、通道拥塞和硬件损耗。基于实测数据的分析表明需求驱动运营具有显著的节能潜力。

Conclusion: 所提出的云原生、按需驱动的路边基础设施运营方案在实际测试中得到验证，证明了其在提升未来C-ITS部署的可扩展性和能效方面的可行性。

Abstract: Intelligent roadside infrastructure is a key enabler for cooperative intelligent transport systems (C-ITS), supporting vehicles equipped with automated driving systems (ADS), e.g., through enhanced environment perception. With a growing number and an expanding functional scope of roadside units, scalable and efficient operation becomes a challenge. This paper presents a cloud-native architecture for the operation of distributed roadside infrastructure based on a Kubernetes cluster spanning roadside units and a cloud server. Building on this architecture, a demand-driven orchestration approach is implemented to dynamically deploy resource-intensive services only when required. As a representative use case, a V2X-based collective perception application is deployed on-demand when a connected vehicle is nearby. The approach is validated in a real-world experiment in our test field in Aachen, demonstrating that the collective perception application starts in time for the vehicle to benefit from it. Without any demand, the application remains inactive, reducing energy consumption, channel congestion, and hardware wear. Beyond the primary evaluation, V2X recordings from the test field are analyzed to estimate the energy-saving potential of demand-driven operation. In summary, the results demonstrate the practical feasibility of cloud-native, demand-driven operation of roadside infrastructure and indicate its potential to improve scalability and (energy) efficiency in future C-ITS deployments.

</details>


### [94] [Frontier: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate LLM Inference Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21312)
*Yicheng Feng,Xin Tan,Yangtao Deng,Yimin Jiang,Yibo Zhu,Hong Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Frontier是一个面向现代LLM推理服务系统的离散事件模拟器，通过解聚抽象建模捕获现代服务系统的结构和动态，包括PDD、AFD解聚、运行时优化和有状态请求，在16-H800 GPU测试台上达到平均吞吐量误差<4%，端到端延迟误差从44.9%降至6.4%（共置场景）和51.7%降至2.6%（解聚场景），可扩展至1000+ GPU，并支持SLA帕累托前沿探索、异构解聚分配、智能体推理调度验证和RL后训练重配置等应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务模拟器存在两大核心问题：1）基于单体副本的抽象架构无法适配现代解聚式服务系统；2）使用平均情况分析模型导致SLA预测失真，甚至可能得出相反的优化结论。这些局限性阻碍了对现代LLM服务设计空间的探索。

Method: 提出离散事件模拟框架，采用解聚式抽象建模：1）建模共置(co-location)、PDD和AFD解聚架构，引入角色特定的集群工作器；2）在调度器-批处理引擎循环中集成CUDA Graphs、投机解码等关键运行时优化；3）支持有状态请求以处理推理、智能体和RL rollout等新兴工作负载；4）跨多样化服务场景提供计算、通信和内存成本的准确可泛化预测。

Result: 在16-H800 GPU测试台上，平均吞吐量误差<4%；与SOTA模拟器相比，共置场景延迟误差从44.9%降至6.4%，解聚场景从51.7%降至2.6%；可扩展至1000+ GPU且仅需普通CPU资源。

Conclusion: Frontier实现了决策级的准确性和可扩展性，使能多种新用例：SLA依赖的帕累托前沿探索、异构解聚分配优化、智能体推理调度验证、以及RL后训练重新配置，为现代LLM服务系统的设计空间探索提供了可靠工具。

Abstract: Modern LLM serving is no longer homogeneous or monolithic. Production systems now combine disaggregated execution, complex parallelism, runtime optimizations, and stateful workloads such as reasoning, agents, and RL rollouts. Simulation is attractive for exploring this growing design space, yet existing simulators lack the architectural completeness and decision-grade fidelity it demands. Their monolithic-replica abstractions are ill-suited to disaggregated serving, while average-case analytical proxies can distort SLA predictions and even reverse optimization conclusions.
  We present Frontier, a discrete-event simulator for modern LLM inference serving. Frontier features a disaggregated abstraction. It captures the structure and dynamics of modern serving systems by modeling co-location, Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (PDD), and Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) with role-specific cluster workers, incorporating key runtime optimizations (e.g., CUDA Graphs, speculative decoding) within the scheduler-batch-engine loop, and supporting stateful requests for emerging workloads. It further provides accurate and generalizable predictions of computation, communication, and memory costs across diverse serving scenarios with complex workload compositions. On 16-H800 GPU testbed, Frontier achieves an average throughput error below 4%. Compared with state-of-the-art simulators, it reduces end-to-end latency error from 44.9% to 6.4% under co-location and from 51.7% to 2.6% under disaggregation. It scales to over 1K GPUs on commodity CPUs and enables new use cases such as SLA-dependent Pareto frontier exploration, heterogeneous disaggregated allocation, agentic reasoning scheduling validation, and RL post-training reconfiguration.

</details>

### [95] [Fifty Years of Transaction Processing Research (extended)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20466)
*Philip A. Bernstein*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向SIGMOD 2025 Companion的短文（扩展版），回顾数据库事务（transaction）研究的早期发展历程（含作者本人的工作），并探讨为何这一看似已被"解决"的问题至今仍持续被研究，最后对事务研究的未来进行展望。（依据所提供内容仅为摘要/引言式说明，具体技术细节未给出。）


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者指出，事务（transaction）研究看似已是数据库领域一个"已解决的问题"，但相关研究至今仍在持续推进，因此有必要梳理其早期历史脉络并反思该领域持续存在的理由；作为会议短文，兼具个人回顾与前瞻讨论的双重目的。此外，SIGMOD Companion 的定位也决定了本文兼具教育性综述与个人观点表达的性质。

Method: 采用历史叙事与个人经历回顾相结合的方式：先追溯事务研究的早期历史（包括作者自身参与的工作），再从问题本身的开放性角度论证事务研究延续至今的合理性，最后对事务方向的未来发展做出推测性讨论。整体属于叙述性/回顾性短文，而非提出新算法或新系统。

Result: （依据摘要信息）本文完成了对事务研究早期历史的梳理，给出了该领域持续被研究的原因解释，并提出了关于未来方向的若干推测性观点。文中未报告新的基准测试、实验数据或性能改进结果。

Conclusion: 事务研究虽常被视为已有成熟解决方案的"老问题"，但通过回溯其历史可以看出其中仍存有待解难题与新的演进动力；作者据此判断事务研究将延续下去，并对未来走向给出展望。文章为会议 Companion 论文，非完整技术报告。

Abstract: In this short paper, I recount some early history of transaction research (including some of my own), explain why transaction research continues to this day (even though it seems to be a solved problem), and speculate about its future. This is an extended version of the paper that appeared in the Companion of the 2025 International Conference on Management of Data (SIGMOD-Companion '25).

</details>
