### [118] [What Do Agents Communicate? Characterizing Information Exchange in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20548)
*Yong Jin Chun,Iftekhar Ahmed*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型多智能体系统中错误传播的问题，通过系统分析智能体间通信，发现推理和验证信息的缺失会显著降低系统性能。基于此提出了类别感知恢复增强（CARA）技术，通过强制在通信中保留关键信息，可恢复86.2%的失败案例，证明了信息质量在有效多智能体协作中的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent (MA) systems are vulnerable to error propagation, where early-stage information degrades downstream reasoning.

Method: Through systematic analysis of inter-agent communication, they identify which information drives multi-agent performance, and propose Category-Aware Recovery Augmentation (CARA) that enforces the presence of critical information during communication.

Result: The absence of reasoning and verification in inter-agent communication significantly degrades performance. CARA recovers up to 86.2% of failed cases.

Conclusion: Category-Aware Recovery Augmentation (CARA) can recover up to 86.2% of failed cases, and results highlight the key role of information quality in effective multi-agent collaboration.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled collaborative Multi-Agent (MA) systems, where interacting agents improve performance through diverse reasoning and iterative refinement. However, these systems remain vulnerable to error propagation, where early-stage information degrades downstream reasoning. To address this, we conduct a systematic analysis of inter-agent communication to identify which information drives MA performance. We find that the absence of reasoning and verification in inter-agent communication significantly degrades performance. Based on these insights, we propose Category-Aware Recovery Augmentation (technique), which enforces the presence of critical information during communication. recovers up to 86.2% of failed cases. Our results highlight the key role of information quality in effective MA collaboration. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cara_mas

</details>


### [119] [Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20563)
*Mengyang Liu,Taozhi Chen,Zhenhua Xu,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体协作框架 STORM（STate-ORiented Management），核心思想是把"多智能体共享代码库的并发冲突"重新定义为**状态管理问题**：智能体只需保证其"已读文件在推理期间未被他人修改"（局部状态一致性，local state consistency），无需全局快照。STORM 让所有智能体共享同一工作区，通过一个中介层（STORM manager）在**写入时**做乐观并发控制校验：若目标文件或其上下文依赖已被其他智能体改动，则拒绝写入、返回最新内容与 unified diff、给出版本增量，让智能体刷新上下文后重试；同时配合"意图注解（intent annotations）"结构化注释传递语义意图，缓解版本追踪无法覆盖的语义冲突。在 Commit0-Lite 与 PaperBench Code-Dev 上、跨 Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Qwen 3.6 Plus / DeepSeek V4 Pro 三种模型验证：Commit0-Lite 上 STORM 达 82.5% 宏平均 / 46.2% 加权通过率，显著优于单智能体（66.4/20.7）与 GitWorktree（63.8/24.6）；PaperBench 上 74.1，高于 GitWorktree 72.7 与单智能体 68.7；与单智能体取并集（Combined）后取得最高分 87.6 与 78.2。工程数量从 2 扩到 8 时分数单调上升、墙钟时间基本不变（约 13 小时）、成本线性增长且性价比稳定。结论：显式的状态管理比工作区隔离（git worktree）更适合作为多智能体协作的基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个 LLM 智能体并行编辑同一代码库时，其推理前提会被彼此的写入破坏，导致"静默冲突"与集成失败。现有主流做法是给每个智能体一个独立的 git worktree 做物理隔离，把冲突全部推迟到事后 merge：文本冲突易发现，但语义冲突（双方各自可编译、合并后失效，如接口签名不一致）几乎无法自动解决，且此时智能体已基于不兼容设计完成实现，恢复代价高昂。已有工作（Git Worktree、CORAL、StatsClaw、CodeCRDT 等）只提供低层工作区隔离，不解决任务分解、依赖追踪、语义冲突与合并选择；且已有研究表明随智能体数量增加，worktree 隔离下的分支耦合与合并冲突会组合式恶化，性能反而下降。因此需要一种把冲突在"写入时刻"就地暴露、且不依赖工作区隔离的协调机制。

Method: 1) 形式化：工作区 W 为带版本号文件集；每个智能体 a_i 维护读快照 S_i={(g, v_g^obs)}；写入 (a_i, f, c') 有效当且仅当 ∀(g,v_g^obs)∈S_i: v_g^obs = v_g^cur（式3）。违反即为冲突，分"直接冲突"（目标文件被改）与"陈旧依赖"（上下文文件被改）两类。
2) 写入时冲突控制（借鉴 OCC）：每文件维护单调递增版本号 v_f；read 返回内容与版本，write 必须声明期望版本；校验通过则原子提交并 v_f←v_f+1，否则拒绝。拒绝时返回三样信息：目标文件当前内容、自上次读取以来的 unified diff、陈旧依赖列表及版本增量，使智能体无需重读全部文件即可重规划。拒绝后给该智能体一个短时"保留（reservation）"以避免两个智能体互相反复作废的活锁。冲突只在文件级重叠边界处介入，其余工作完全并行。
3) 意图注解：为降低语义冲突，工程师在改动块上方写 `# engineer_id: <意图>` 注释，并保留他人注解；该约定自动注入工程师 system prompt，形成轻量语义协调通道（无需显式通信）。
4) 架构：manager 读取仓库、分解任务为不相交文件集的主文件集合并派发给并行工程师，审查 diff、跑测试、仅由 manager 提交；工程师只通过被中介的 file_editor 访问工作区，彼此不直接通信。STORM 架构无关，可即插即用到任何多智能体系统。
5) 实验设置：基于 OpenHands SDK + Docker；配置 5 种（Single-Agent / GitWorktree / GitWorktree-Combined / STORM / STORM-Combined）× 3 模型；Commit0-Lite 16 仓库 4 工程师（pytest 评估，报告加权 Score_w 与宏平均 Score），PaperBench 仅 Code-Dev 子集（20 篇，Sonnet 4.6 作裁判），并报告 Cost_eff 与 Time_eff。

Result: 主要结果（Sonnet 4.6）：Commit0-Lite 上 STORM Score_w=46.2 / Score=82.5，显著优于单智能体 20.7/66.4 与 GitWorktree 24.6/63.8（GitWorktree 在此甚至比单智能体低至多 18 分）；PaperBench Code-Dev 上 STORM 74.1 > GitWorktree 72.7 > 单智能体 68.7。STORM-Combined（逐任务取单智能体与多智能体较优者）在两个基准均取得最高分 87.6 与 78.2；Qwen 上 STORM-Combined 达 88.2/76.2，DeepSeek 上 77.7/68.3，跨模型趋势一致。成本效率上单智能体最优（零协调开销），但 STORM 的 Time_eff 在所有模型上优于 GitWorktree（冲突增量化解而非事后 merge）。消融：意图注解使 Score_w 从 26.6→46.2、Score 从 70.9→82.5；隔离策略对比中 Soft Isolation（24.0/65.4）与 GitWorktree（24.6/63.8）几乎等价，均逊于 STORM，说明收益主要来自写入时校验而非隔离形式。扩展性：最大工程师数 2→8 时整体通过率 38.2%→69.7%（+31.5）、宏平均 71.3%→87.1%（+15.8），≥99% 通过仓库数 7→10/16；成本线性（$199→$292→$429），墙钟时间基本恒定（约 13 小时），每分性价比稳定在 $5–6。机制分析：STORM 把冲突从"事后 merge"前移到"写前"（GitWorktree 冲突多在提交后才暴露）；写接受率 GitWorktree 3.81 次/91.8%，STORM k=4 为 6.00 次/81.2%、k=8 为 10.25 次/67.1%（低接受率源于更严的一致性过滤而非工程质量下降）。按耦合度分层：STORM 相对 GitWorktree 优势在低/中/高耦合子集分别为 +15.6/+5.4/+34.6 分，高耦合下 GitWorktree 崩溃至 36.3% 而 STORM 保持 70.9%；如 marshmallow 0.0%→82.3%、imapclient 9.7%→89.1%。瓶颈来自任务分解质量：k=8 时 85.1% 任务为单文件但首轮文件范围重叠升至 35.1%，与拒绝率相关（r=0.78）。jinja 配对案例显示：GitWorktree 在 merge 边界才暴露 utils.py 耦合并需重做，STORM 在分解阶段就把耦合文件同任务打包/排序，首轮即通过。失败分析（附录D）：残余失败以断言/语义不匹配、缺失 API、类型/契约错误为主，多发生在写入已被接受之后，说明文件级一致性不能保证任务边界语义正确、编辑可组合或预算充足。局限：仅中介 file_editor，bash 直接改文件（sed/echo>）可绕过（只能事后 diff 检测）；并发 shell 命令未串行化；文件级粒度导致同文件不同函数的误拒与共享文件（如 __init__.py）成为串行瓶颈。

Conclusion: STORM 用"局部状态一致性 + 写入时冲突控制 + 意图注解"取代了工作区隔离，证明显式的状态管理是多智能体协作更有效的基础：冲突在智能体推理上下文尚新鲜时被廉价发现并就地解决，避免了事后 merge 的语义灾难，使多智能体在高耦合仓库上不退化，并使智能体数量可扩展（分数单调上升、墙钟时间不变）。同时作者强调 STORM 的作用是"把延迟且脆弱的集成替换为即时一致性检查"，而非消除一切冲突或降低算力成本；其有效性上限受任务分解质量、文件级粒度与终端旁路写入限制，未来方向包括行/hunk 级追踪与对终端副作用的并发控制。

Abstract: Recent advances in multi-agent systems have shown great potential for solving complex tasks. However, when multiple agents edit a shared codebase concurrently, their changes can silently conflict and inconsistent views lead to integration failures. Existing multi-agent systems address this through workspace isolation (e.g., one git worktree per agent), but this defers conflict resolution to a post-hoc merge step where recovery is expensive. In this paper, we propose STORM, i.e., STate-ORiented Management for multi-agent collaboration. Specifically, STORM manages agent states by mediating their interactions with the shared workspace, ensuring that each agent operates on a consistent view of the codebase and that conflicting edits are detected and resolved at write time. We evaluate STORM on Commit0 and PaperBench across multiple LLMs. STORM outperforms the git-worktree-based multi-agent baseline by +18.7 on Commit0-Lite and +1.4 on PaperBench, while achieving comparable or better cost efficiency. Combined with single-agent runs, STORM reaches highest scores of 87.6 and 78.2 on the two benchmarks respectively, suggesting that explicit state management is a more effective foundation for multi-agent collaboration than workspace isolation. STORM can also be plugged into any multi-agent system seamlessly.

</details>


### [120] [ProCrit: Self-Elicited Multi-Perspective Reasoning with Critic-Guided Revision for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20867)
*Yingjia Xu,Jiulong Wu,Bowen Zhang,Baokui Guo,Siyuan Chai,Min Cao*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出 ProCrit 框架，通过提议-批评双智能体架构实现自驱动的多视角推理，采用动态角色智能体 rollout 合成过程级标注，结合草稿-批评-修订范式提升推理可靠性，并通过双阶段强化学习联合优化推理和反馈机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仍依赖固定的预定义视角和手工设计的路由规则进行独立操作，无法灵活适应不同样本中 sarcastic 机制的多样性。跨模态讽刺检测需要针对每个样本自主生成所需的分析视角，并将它们逐步整合为连贯分析，而非使用固定视角。

Method: ProCrit采用Proposal-Critic双智能体框架：1）通过动态角色智能体 rollout 合成过程级推理标注，利用强视觉-语言模型在共享上下文中顺序生成分析角色，将多角色轨迹展平为保持跨视角依赖的序列；2）采用draft-critique-revise范式，独立批评智能体识别推理缺陷并提供针对性的自然语言反馈用于定向修订；3）开发双向精炼训练框架，通过双阶段强化学习联合优化提案生成和反馈引导修订，同时根据反馈实际效果改进批评智能体。

Result: 实验在三个广泛使用的基准数据集上验证了 ProCrit 的有效性。

Conclusion: ProCrit framework (Proposal-Critic two-agent system) demonstrates effectiveness across three multimodal sarcasm detection benchmarks, with dynamic-role agentic rollout enabling process-level annotation synthesis, draft-critique-revise paradigm improving reasoning reliability, and dual-stage RL training jointly optimizing proposal drafting and feedback-guided revision.

Abstract: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires reasoning over cross-modal incongruities between literal expression and intended meaning, yet the specific analytical perspectives needed vary across samples due to the diversity of sarcastic mechanisms. While recent methods make this analytical process explicit, they still rely on fixed, predefined perspectives that operate independently under hand-crafted routing rules. We argue that multimodal sarcasm detection instead calls for self-elicited multi-perspective reasoning, where a model autonomously generates the perspectives needed for each sample and progressively integrates them into a coherent analysis. To realize this goal, we propose ProCrit, a Proposal-Critic two-agent framework with a proposal agent for multi-perspective reasoning and a critic agent for external evaluation and targeted revision guidance. First, to overcome the lack of process-level supervision in existing sarcasm datasets, ProCrit synthesizes process-level reasoning annotations through a dynamic-role agentic rollout: a strong vision-language model sequentially spawns analytical roles within a shared context, and the resulting multi-role trajectories are flattened into sequences that preserve cross-perspective dependencies while enabling efficient autoregressive generation. Second, to improve reasoning reliability, ProCrit adopts a draft-critique-revise paradigm in which an independent critic identifies reasoning deficiencies and provides targeted natural-language feedback for directed revision. Finally, we develop a mutual-refinement training framework that jointly optimizes proposal drafting and feedback-guided revision via dual-stage reinforcement learning, while refining the critic agent according to the actual effectiveness of its feedback. Experiments on three widely used benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProCrit.

</details>


### [121] [Decoupling Communication from Policy: Robust MARL under Bandwidth Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21085)
*Alexi Canesse,Benoît Goupil,Jesse Read,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 针对多智能体强化学习中严重带宽限制场景，本文提出归一化带宽预算β和SLIM解耦架构，通过将通信路径与策略潜空间分离，解决现有架构中消息压缩与策略容量之间的耦合瓶颈问题，实现有限通信条件下仍保持优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通信架构中，共享潜表征同时承担策略执行和智能体间通信功能，形成耦合瓶颈。压缩消息大小直接限制了策略潜空间，导致性能显著下降。

Method: 本文提出两个核心贡献：(1) β——归一化单智能体带宽预算，将稀疏度、通信轮次和消息维度统一为单一可比较约束；(2) SLIM架构——将通信路径与策略潜表征解耦，使带宽限制与策略容量效应分离，同时受益于步内通信。

Result: SLIM在多个部分可观测MARL基准测试中达到最优性能，在严重带宽限制下仅表现出边际性能退化。

Conclusion: SLIM在有限通信条件下展现出色的可扩展性和鲁棒性，带宽降低时性能损失极小，验证了将通信路径与策略潜空间解耦的有效性。

Abstract: Communication enables coordination in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), but many real-world applications, e.g., search-and-rescue with drone swarms, operate under severe bandwidth constraints. Many communication architectures still expose a coupled bottleneck in which a shared latent representation is used for both policy execution and inter-agent communication. Consequently, reducing message size directly limits the policy's latent space, often leading to significant performance degradation. We address this with two contributions. First, we introduce $β$, a normalised per-agent bandwidth budget that unifies sparsity, rounds, and message dimension into a single comparable constraint. Second, we provide SLIM, a minimal architecture that decouples the communication pathway from the policy's latent representation, allowing us to isolate the effect of bandwidth from the effect of policy capacity while benefiting from in-step communication. We evaluate our method on several partially-observable MARL benchmarks, where communication is essential. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibits scalability and robustness under limited communication, with only marginal degradation as bandwidth is reduced.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

### [122] [Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20254)
*Amritansh Maurya,Navjot Singh,Mohammed Javed,Omar Moured*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出两种无需训练的表格问答提示框架TGN和PIP，通过结构化行列导航和渐进式推理提升LLM的表格问答能力，并可作为监督信号微调小模型，实现成本高效的表格问答解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在NLP任务表现优异，但在表格数据上仍需研究关注。表格问答需要精确的单元格检索和多步结构化推理。现有工作通过微调或训练LLM处理表格数据，但往往缺乏对模型如何导航表格和推导答案的可控验证。

Method: 提出两种结构化提示框架：1) TableGrid Navigation (TGN)：通过三模块循环迭代导航行列以定位证据并精炼答案；2) Progressive Inference Prompting (PIP)：强制列识别以实现显式渐进式行选择约束。两者均可作为微调小模型的监督模板。

Result: 在TableBench上TGN比最强基线提升3.8分；在FeTaQA上PIP超越ReAct和Chain-of-Thought达到SOTA。两者可作为监督模板微调小模型，缩小资源受限场景下与大型架构的性能差距。

Conclusion: 论文提出的TGN和PIP框架为表格问答提供了无需训练的灵活高效解决方案，不仅可用于推理时提升性能，还可作为监督模板微调小模型，在资源受限场景中缩小与大型模型的性能差距。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising results on NLP tasks, however, their performance on tabular data still needs research attention, because Table Question-Answering (TQA) requires precise cell retrieval and multi-step structured reasoning. Existing work improves TQA either by fine-tuning or training LLMs on task-specific tabular data, but often lacks verifiable control over how the model navigates tables and derives answers. In this work, we propose a training-free TQA approach with two structured prompting frameworks: TableGrid Navigation (TGN), which iteratively navigates rows and columns via a three-module loop to locate evidence and refine answers, and Progressive Inference Prompting (PIP), which enforces columns identification for explicit progressive row selection constraint according to the query. We evaluate 17 LLMs against 6 baselines on TableBench and FeTaQa dataset. On TableBench, TGN improves over the strongest baseline by 3.8 points, and on FeTaQa, PIP achieves SOTA performance over ReAct and Chain-of-Thought. Beyond inference-time gains, PIP and TGN can also serve as supervision templates to fine-tune small models, narrowing the performance gap to much larger architectures in resource-constrained settings, offering versatile and cost-efficient solution for TQA.

</details>


### [123] [Layer-wise Token Compression for Efficient Document Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20683)
*Shengyao Zhuang,zhichao Xu,Ivano Lauriola*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出层间Token压缩（LTC）方法，通过在Transformer中间层应用自适应池化提升交叉编码器重排序效率，在保持排序质量的同时实现最高116%的QPS提升，且压缩可作为有益正则化手段增强模型的长文档泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的文档交叉编码器重排序模型在推理时需处理长查询-文档序列，计算成本高昂。已有的Token压缩方法（如初始嵌入层聚合）对交叉编码器效果不佳，需要探索新的效率优化方案。

Method: Layer-wise Token Compression (LTC)：在中间Transformer层应用自适应Token池化，对Token序列进行分层压缩。通过在多个中间层逐步聚合Token，减少有效Token数量，从而降低计算成本。

Result: 在MS MARCO段落和文档排序任务中，LTC在中层进行压缩可保持排序质量：段落排序推理QPS提升达25%，文档排序QPS提升达116%。此外，LTC可扩展至长上下文列表式LLM重排序，收益更为显著。更有趣的是，使用短段落训练的压缩模型在长文档排序任务上优于未压缩模型，表明压缩可能作为一种有益的正则化手段，促进长度无关表示的学习。

Conclusion: LTC provides an effective solution for improving cross-encoder efficiency, with compression potentially acting as a beneficial regularizer for length-invariant representations. The method is scalable to LLM-based listwise reranking scenarios.

Abstract: Transformer-based document cross-encoder rerankers are a central component of modern information retrieval systems. Despite their success, these models suffer from high computational costs due to processing long query-document sequences at inference time. A known approach to improve efficiency is token compression, which consists of aggregating groups of tokens together in the initial embedding layer, reducing the effective number of tokens, and making the computation faster. While token compression has proven to be successful for bi-encoder retrievers, we empirically observed that this approach may be ineffective for cross-encoder rerankers. In this paper, we propose Layer-wise Token Compression (LTC), which applies adaptive token pooling at intermediate transformer layers. Through extensive ablation studies on MS MARCO passage and document ranking tasks, we demonstrate that compression at middle layers preserves ranking quality while increasing inference QPS by up to 25% for passage ranking and up to 116% for document ranking. We also extend LTC to listwise LLM rerankers and show that the same approach can be easily applied to long-context listwise reranking, where the QPS improvements are even greater. More surprisingly, when applying rerankers trained on short passages to long-document ranking tasks, models trained with compression outperform their uncompressed counterparts, suggesting that compression may act as a beneficial regularizer that encourages length-invariant representations.

</details>


### [124] [CALMem : Application-Layer Dual Memory for Conversational AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20724)
*Rajendra Narayan Jena,Rajan Padmanabhan,Sankar Arumugam*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: CALMem 是一个纯应用层的"双记忆"架构：把对话记忆完全放在宿主应用侧（Rust 进程内），用「情节记忆（滑动窗口向量嵌入检索）+ 语义记忆（Agent 可写的结构化键值事实）」两套互补存储，配合按 token 预算自适应的 MOIM（注入记忆消息）机制，在不修改底层 LLM、不改提示结构、无需微调的前提下，为对话助手提供近似无限的"有效上下文"；其关键创新是 intra-session retrieval——被 compaction 丢弃的当前会话轮次仍可被检索到，从而弥补既有系统的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 的固定上下文窗口造成两个结构性缺陷：(1) 窗口有限，长周期任务（软件工程、跨天项目）即使百万 token 也会耗尽；(2) 每次新会话都从零开始，与窗口大小无关。同时 compaction（压缩摘要）会不可逆地丢弃具体事实、决策与工作细节，且朴素使用最大窗口会带来 1~2 个数量级的 token 成本放大。现有方案各有缺陷：更大上下文窗口不解决跨会话问题；RAG 针对静态知识库，直接套用到对话历史会丢失时间顺序与会话结构；MemGPT/Letta 等需自定义提示与模型自主决策的函数调用，存在供应商锁定且不区分情节/语义记忆；RAPTOR、HippoRAG、GraphRAG 面向语料级静态知识，与会话式、仅追加的记忆结构不匹配；Mem0、Zep 等外部记忆服务引入网络延迟、隐私与供应商依赖。作者主张：能否由应用层智能补偿，而非继续扩大窗口。

Method: 三层架构：(1) LLM Provider Layer——未修改的任意供应商模型，仅要求消息式对话接口；(2) Context Management Layer（宿主应用）——管理活跃窗口、执行 compaction，通过消息持久化路径上的钩子触发后台索引，每轮运行 MOIM 注入器；(3) Memory Layer——CALMem 核心。情节记忆：对每条消息做滑动窗口切分（size=1000 字符≈250 token、overlap=200、step=800，按空白对齐避免切断词，按 Unicode 标量而非字节处理多字节文本，≤1000 字符走单块快路径），用 fastembed 加载的 all-MiniLM-L6-v2（384 维，ONNX 纯 Rust，无需 Python，约 23MB，CPU 上约 3ms，MTEB 语义相似度表现良好）生成嵌入，索引存于 SQLite 的 rag_chunks 表（INSERT OR IGNORE）。检索时查询向量与全部嵌入做精确余弦相似度暴力扫描（非 ANN），阈值 0.4，top-k 默认 5。intra-session 过滤谓词：当前会话中已在活跃上下文里的 message_id 被排除，被压缩掉的当前会话块则参与打分，从而形成"活跃上下文 → 被压缩的当前会话历史 → 跨会话历史"的无缝记忆链。语义记忆：memory_facts 关系表（session_id、category 默认 'general'、key、value、created_at、外键指向 session），由 Agent 显式写入、系统自动读取，用以保证精确事实（如用户偏好语言）100% 精准召回。索引流水线采用非阻塞：tx.commit() 先确保消息在 SQLite 中持久化，再 tokio::spawn 后台任务执行切分→嵌入→写入→更新缓存；不变量是"对话库始终为唯一真相来源，记忆索引为可重建的派生结构"。MOIM 机制：每轮把两类记忆检索到的最相关内容组成结构化文本块前置到系统提示中，模型无需显式调用检索；注入深度与规模随上下文余量自适应 inversely scaling，避免"注入记忆反而加速了它本要缓解的 compaction"这一自我拆台问题。系统完全进程内、供应商无关，关闭时零开销零回归地退化回原生 LLM 行为。

Result: （据论文正文已披露内容）架构层面给出了具体实现与性能参数：嵌入模型 384 维、23MB、CPU 约 3ms/条；目标部署规模约 100K chunk 下精确暴力检索计算上可接受，因而避免 HNSW 等 ANN 的近似误差与冷启动代价；每轮仅注入约 750 token 相关历史，相比"使用最大窗口"可降低 1~2 个数量级的每轮 API 成本。表 1 的对比显示，CALMem 是唯一同时具备"纯应用层、情节+语义双记忆、预算感知、intra-session 检索、供应商无关"全部属性的方案（RAG 仅情节、MemGPT 为提示/Agent 层且不预算感知、Gen. Agents/RAPTOR/HippoRAG 均无预算感知与 intra-session、长上下文模型属模型层）。需要说明的是，提供的全文在第 5.2 节（memory_facts 建表语句）处被截断，第 6–11 节（token 预算自适应注入、性能优化、实现细节、评估结果、局限与未来工作）缺失，因此论文报告的具体基准测试数值、延迟/召回指标与消融实验结果在所给材料中不可见。

Conclusion: CALMem 的核心主张是：记忆问题不必在模型层解决，而可由应用层以"provider-agnostic、零侵入、可关闭即零开销"的方式补偿。整体定位为现有工作的互补而非替代——compaction 照常运行以压缩上下文，检索层负责在需要时按需找回被压缩的具体细节（细节保真优于摘要换压缩）；刻意避免 RAPTOR 式递归抽象，以保留逐字细节并省去每条消息一次额外 LLM 调用。其独特生态位是：既感知 compaction 状态与会话边界，又区分情节/语义两类记忆，且具备 token 预算自适应能力。局限与未来工作（因原文截断未完整呈现）大致包括：精确检索的规模上限、语义记忆写入依赖 Agent 行为、embedding 模型替换与多语言表现、以及质量评估方法仍需更系统的实验支撑。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) operate within fixed context windows that fundamentally limit conversational continuity. When context fills, compaction discards history irreversibly; when sessions end, all memory resets to zero. Existing solutions-larger context windows, retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge bases, and memory-augmented architectures such as MemGPT-either require model modification, impose provider lock-in, or do not address the compaction continuity problem. We present CALMem (Conversational Application-Layer Memory), an application-layer dual memory architecture that gives LLM-based conversational assistants virtually unbounded effective context without any modification to the underlying model. CALMem combines two complementary memory subsystems: an episodic memory layer built on sliding-window vector embeddings of conversation history, and a semantic memory layer of agent-writable structured facts. A token-budget-adaptive injection mechanism, called the MOIM (Message of Injected Memory), automatically retrieves and injects relevant past context each turn, scaling injection depth inversely with context pressure. A key contribution is intra-session retrieval: compacted away turns from the current session remain searchable, closing a gap unaddressed by prior work. The system is implemented as a pure application layer in a production Rust codebase, is provider-agnostic, and degrades to original LLM behaviour with zero overhead when disabled. We describe the architecture, design decisions, and performance characteristics, and analyse the trade-offs that guided each implementation choice.

</details>


### [125] [MemConflict: Evaluating Long-Term Memory Systems Under Memory Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20926)
*Zhen Tao,Jinxiang Zhao,Peng Liu,Dinghao Xi,Yanfang Chen,Wei Xu,Zhiyu Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MemConflict是一个诊断框架，通过形式化记忆冲突类型（动态/静态/条件冲突）、模拟长时域历史和注入干扰项，创建了可评估长期记忆系统检索与排序能力的多会话对话基准，推动了冲突感知可靠性评估的发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统评估主要关注结果级性能或时序更新，对系统如何在冲突情境下检索和排序时间有效、事实正确、上下文适用的记忆证据缺乏深入洞察。

Method: 提出MemConflict诊断框架，将记忆有效性形式化为查询条件下的适用性 fitness-for-use 问题；形式化了动态冲突、静态冲突和条件冲突；基于结构化用户档案模拟受控的长时域历史；引入跨会话冲突；注入语义相似的干扰项以在记忆候选间制造竞争。支持黑盒评估（最终答案）和白盒分析（支撑记忆检索与排序）。

Result: 在六个代表性长期记忆系统上的实验表明：不同冲突类型表现不均衡；答案正确性常与记忆检索排序结果不一致；较长历史、干扰项、隐式查询和较大冲突距离会降低性能；诊断发现失败源于支撑记忆缺失和检索记忆利用不当。

Conclusion: MemConflict推进了基于检索感知和冲突感知的可靠性评估的原则性长期记忆治理框架，为评估和改进LLM对话系统的记忆能力提供了系统化的诊断工具。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems enable conversational agents based on large language models (LLMs) to retain, retrieve, and apply user-specific information across multi-session interactions. However, existing evaluations mainly assess outcome-level performance or temporal updating, providing limited insight into how systems retrieve and rank temporally valid, factually correct, and contextually applicable memory evidence under conflicting alternatives. To address this gap, we propose MemConflict, a diagnostic framework that treats memory validity as a query-conditioned fitness-for-use problem. MemConflict formalizes dynamic, static, and conditional conflicts over temporal validity, factual correctness, and contextual applicability. It simulates controlled long-horizon histories from structured user profiles, introduces cross-session conflicts, and injects semantically similar distractors to create competition among memory candidates. The resulting multi-session dialogue benchmark supports black-box evaluation of final answers and white-box analysis of supporting-memory retrieval and ranking. Experiments on six representative long-term memory systems show uneven strengths across conflict types, with answer correctness often diverging from memory retrieval and ranking. Sensitivity analyses reveal that longer histories, distractors, implicit queries, and larger conflict distances degrade performance. Diagnostics show failures from missing supporting memories and ineffective use of retrieved memories. Collectively, MemConflict advances principled long-term memory governance through retrieval-aware, conflict-aware reliability assessment.

</details>


### [126] [SG-LegalCite: A Principle-Augmented Benchmark for Legal Citation Retrieval in Singapore Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21057)
*Shannon Lee Yueh Ern,Kaidong Feng,Yingpeng Du,Chloe Lee En Jia,Zhu Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This paper addresses the limitation of existing legal citation retrieval benchmarks that lack explicit legal principles. The authors propose a new retrieval paradigm integrating case facts with explicit legal principles, supported by SG-LegalCite, a large dataset of 100,890 case-principle pairs from Singapore Supreme Court judgments. Experiments validate that explicit legal principles significantly improve retrieval accuracy.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing legal citation retrieval benchmarks miss or only implicitly express governing legal principles, leading to retrieval of factually similar but doctrinally irrelevant precedents. This is particularly problematic in Singapore's unique legal system where only domestic precedents are binding.

Method: Introduced SG-LegalCite dataset (100,890 case-principle pairs from 8,523 Singapore Supreme Court judgments 2000-2025) and proposed a new retrieval paradigm that ranks cited cases using queries integrating case facts and explicit legal principles.

Result: Experiments across 11 baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of principle-augmented retrieval, with explicit legal principles providing strong discriminative signals for legal citation retrieval.

Conclusion: The proposed principle-augmented retrieval paradigm, supported by the SG-LegalCite dataset, effectively improves legal citation retrieval by leveraging explicit legal principles as discriminative signals.

Abstract: Legal citation in common-law systems depends not only on factual similarity, but also on the legal principle for which a precedent is invoked. However, existing benchmarks for legal citation retrieval use case facts, citation context, or full judgments as inputs, where the governing legal principle is often missing or only implicitly expressed and entangled with broader context. As a result, models may retrieve precedents that are factually similar yet doctrinally irrelevant. This limitation is particularly consequential in Singapore, where the legal system has evolved independently: only domestic precedents are binding, while foreign authorities serve merely as persuasive references. Thus, we propose a new retrieval paradigm that ranks cited cases based on queries integrating case facts and explicit legal principles, inspired by real-world legal reasoning workflows. To support this paradigm, we introduce SG-LegalCite, a dataset of 100,890 case-principle pairs extracted from 8,523 Singapore Supreme Court judgments spanning from 2000 to 2025. Experiments across 11 baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of our principle-augmented retrieval paradigm, showing that explicit legal principles provide strong discriminative signals for legal citation retrieval.

</details>

### [127] [Neural Estimation of Pairwise Mutual Information in Masked Discrete Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20187)
*Jai Sharma,Yifan Wang,Bryan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在预训练掩码扩散模型（MDM）上挂载一个轻量级"MI预测头"，用模型自身条件分布算出的成对条件互信息作为监督信号，一次前向即可预测整个 N×N 的互信息矩阵；该矩阵既可解释模型内部依赖结构（自动还原数独行列宫约束），又能指导"条件独立子集"的并行解码，在数独与蛋白质（ESM-C）任务上将推理前向次数降低约3–5倍且质量优于基于熵的并行方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）只暴露边缘条件分布 p(x_i|x_t)，无法显式刻画变量间的依赖结构；而在高度结构化数据（如数独、蛋白质）上，并行解码若仅按置信度/熵选取 token，会在互相关联的变量之间产生全局不一致。经典互信息估计（MINE、INFO-NCE、CLUB 等）需要密度估计或成对采样，难以在高维离散序列上在线计算；已有依赖感知方法（如 EB-Sampler）用边缘熵界松弛联合依赖，丢失了成对、高阶、条件且非对称的依赖结构。因此需要一个可从 MDM 隐状态直接、廉价预测成对条件互信息 I(X_i;X_j|C) 的工具，既服务于可解释性，也服务于并行采样加速。

Method: （1）真值 MI 计算：对给定的已解掩上下文 C，先做一次 base pass 得到所有边缘 P(X_i|C) 与熵 H(X_i|C)；再对每个位置 i 和每个候选 token v∈V 固定 X_i=v 做条件前向，得到 P(X_j|X_i=v,C)，累加得条件熵 H(X_j|X_i,C)；以熵降 I(X_i;X_j|C)=H(X_j|C)−H(X_j|X_i,C) 构造真值矩阵 M_GT∈R^{N×N}，代价为 1+N·|V| 次前向。（2）神经估计器：冻结 MDM 主干，取其隐状态 h∈R^{N×D}，用轻量 MLP 头 f_φ 输出对称矩阵 Î=f_φ(MDM(X_t))；训练时随机采样噪声级 t~U[0,1]，生成掩码输入 X_t，在掩码位置对 M_GT 与 Î 采用均方误差损失 L_MI=||M_GT−Î||_F²。（3）MI 引导并行采样（Algorithm 1，预算化贪心）：对掩码位置按熵升序排序，定义依赖代价 d(i|U)=Σ_{j∈U}Î_{i,j}，总代价 cost=h_i+λ·d(i|U)，当 cost≤预算 B（初始 γ）时把 i 加入并行集合 U 并扣减预算，否则顺序处理；高 MI 的变量对被强制分步，从而保证一致性。实验设置：数独用 415.8 万参数 MDM（10 万随机谜题）+ 9.99 万参数预测头；蛋白质用 ESM-Cambrian 300M + ~81 万参数头（1 万条蛋白、5 epoch）。

Result: 数独（1000 个未见难例）：MI 引导 γ=0.3 时平均 15.2 次前向、求解率 63.6%，优于顺序解码（53.9 次、61.6%）、EB-Sampler（γ=0.2：15.3 次、61.0%）、naive(k=4: 14.9 次、52.4%)；γ=0.6 时 9.7 次、56.2%，仍优于 naive(k=7: 9.0 次、36.8%) 与 EB-Sampler(γ=0.5: 9.9 次、51.2%)。蛋白质（ESM-C，500 条 50–100 长随机序列 + 500 条 UniRef50 参考，k-means k=15 后计算 JSD）：MI 引导 (γ=2,λ=1) 15.3 次前向、JSD 0.136；(γ=4,λ=1) 10.0 次、0.174，均优于 naive(k=4: 19.1/0.185；k=8: 9.8/0.196；k=12: 6.2/0.218) 与顺序解码（74.8 次、0.093）。MI 图可清晰恢复数独的行/列/宫约束（如"1"须位于底行两格，对应高 MI 0.44 nats）。

Conclusion: 互信息引导的并行化在 MDM 中实现了显著的推理加速（约一个数量级、3–5 倍前向次数削减），同时在结构化逻辑任务上解出率反超顺序基线，在蛋白质生成上给出明显更好的速度—质量折中，且 MI 矩阵本身提供了对模型内部依赖信念的可解释视图，说明离散扩散模型无需显式编程即可习得刚性约束。局限在于预测头精度不足、需大量准备与训练、真值 MI 需在线计算成本高；未来方向包括更优的预测头架构、改进的训练课程/数据生成策略。该工作表明显式建模变量依赖是释放离散扩散模型潜力的关键，可弥合顺序采样质量与并行解码效率之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Understanding dependencies between variables is critical for interpretability and efficient generation in masked diffusion models (MDMs), yet these models primarily expose marginal conditional distributions and do not explicitly represent inter-variable dependence. We propose a neural framework for estimating pairwise conditional mutual information (MI) directly from the hidden states of a pretrained MDM, using ground-truth MI computed from the model's own conditional distributions for supervision. The resulting estimator captures the model's internal belief about dependency structure and predicts the full MI matrix in a single forward pass, enabling MI-guided parallel decoding by identifying conditionally independent subsets of variables. We evaluate our approach on Sudoku and protein sequence generation with ESM-C, where the MI maps recover known structural constraints and enable a 3-5x magnitude reduction in inference-time forward passes compared to sequential decoding, while preserving generative quality and outperforming entropy-based parallelization methods.

</details>


### [128] [Efficient Banzhaf-Based Data Valuation for $k$-Nearest Neighbors Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21033)
*Guangyi Zhang,Lutz Oettershagen,Lixu Wang,Aristides Gionis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对kNN分类器中的Banzhaf值计算难题，证明其#P难解性，并利用kNN局部性特征提出动态规划框架，实现加权场景O(Wkn²)和非加权场景O(nk²)的高效算法，同时提供蒙特卡洛估计方法，实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据估值是机器学习中的基础问题，博弈论方法（如Banzhaf值）虽然提供公平的数据估值原则框架，但存在指数级计算复杂度，难以应用于实际。

Method: 利用kNN分类器的局部性特征，设计动态规划框架：加权kNN的伪多项式算法O(Wkn²)，以及针对非加权kNN的O(nk²)线性算法，并提供蒙特卡洛估计方法。

Result: 加权kNN伪多项式算法复杂度O(Wkn²)，非加权kNN达线性复杂度O(nk²)，显著优于传统指数级方法。

Conclusion: 提出了高效的动态规划框架，为kNN分类器提供了实用的精确计算算法和蒙特卡洛估计方法，在真实数据集上验证了计算效率和有效性。

Abstract: Data valuation, the task of quantifying the contribution of individual data points to model performance, has emerged as a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Game-theoretic approaches, such as the Banzhaf value, offer principled frameworks for fair data valuation; however, they suffer from exponential computational complexity. We address this challenge by developing efficient algorithms specifically tailored for computing Banzhaf values in $k$-nearest neighbor ($k$NN) classifiers. We first establish the theoretical hardness of the problem by proving that it is \#P-hard. Despite this intractability, we exploit the locality properties of $k$NN classifiers to develop practical exact algorithms. Our main contribution is a dynamic programming framework that achieves significant computational improvements: we present a pseudo-polynomial algorithm with $O(Wkn^2)$ time complexity for weighted $k$NN classifiers, where $W$ is the maximum sum of top-$k$ weights, and a specialized algorithm for unweighted $k$NN that achieves $O(nk^2)$ time complexity, that is, linear in the number of data points. We also offer efficient Monte Carlo estimation methods. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the practical efficiency of our approach and its effectiveness in data valuation applications.

</details>


### [129] [Dynamic Shapley Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20620)
*Xuan Yang,Hsi-Wen Chen,Ming-Syan Chen,Jian Pei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D-Shap通过将Shapley值表示为矩阵并利用数据中的局部性结构，将动态数据估值转化为高效的矩阵维护问题，实现了毫秒级任务更新和三个数量级的玩家更新加速，同时通过self-valuation消除了对预定义任务的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Shapley数据估值方法将计算视为一次性过程，产生聚合分数而非可复用结构，无法应对动态场景中任务和训练玩家的变化，导致每次变更都需完全重算，计算成本过高。

Method: 提出D-Shap框架，将Shapley值表示为玩家×任务矩阵，利用utility locality（相似任务产生相似估值）和coalition locality（每任务仅依赖少量训练玩家）实现增量更新：新增任务通过结构感知插值推断，新增玩家仅影响局部矩阵块。同时引入self-valuation机制，基于可扩展子集复用和覆盖感知锚点选择直接从训练数据构建初始矩阵，避免预定义评估任务。

Result: D-Shap在多种模型上验证：任务更新达到毫秒级，玩家更新成本降低最高三个数量级，同时估值质量与完整重计算相当。

Conclusion: D-Shap将动态Shapley数据估值问题转化为结构化矩阵维护问题，通过利用utility locality和coalition locality实现了高效的增量更新。Self-valuation机制进一步消除了对预定义评估任务的依赖，使框架可直接从训练数据构建初始矩阵。实验表明该方法在保持估值质量与完整重计算相当的同时，任务更新达到毫秒级，玩家更新成本降低三个数量级。

Abstract: Shapley-based data valuation provides a principled way to quantify the contribution of training data, but its high computational cost makes it impractical in dynamic settings where tasks and training players evolve. Existing methods treat Shapley computation as a one-shot process and collapse contributions into aggregated scores, preventing reuse and requiring recomputation under any change. We introduce a new perspective that represents Shapley values as a player-by-task matrix and formulates dynamic valuation as a structured matrix maintenance problem. We exploit the fact that each task depends on a small subset of training players and that similar tasks yield similar valuations, leading to utility locality and coalition locality. Based on these insights, we propose D-Shap, a dynamic valuation framework that enables efficient updates by modifying only a small portion of the matrix: new task valuations are inferred via structure-aware interpolation, while updates induced by new players are confined to affected local matrix blocks. To eliminate the need for pre-specified evaluation tasks, we introduce self-valuation, which constructs the initial matrix directly from training data, supported by scalable subset reuse and coverage-aware anchor selection. Experiments across diverse models show that D-Shap performs task updates in milliseconds and reduces the cost of player updates by up to three orders of magnitude, while achieving valuation quality competitive with full recomputation.

</details>


### [130] [GraphDiffMed: Knowledge-Constrained Differential Attention with Pharmacological Graph Priors for Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20188)
*Krati Saxena,Tomohiro Shibata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphDiffMed是一种知识约束的药物推荐框架，采用双重尺度差分注意力机制在就诊内和就诊间层级过滤噪声，并整合药理学约束。实验证明该方法能生成更可靠、临床意义更强的药物推荐，同时在安全性和有效性之间取得更好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法通常在时序建模或药理学知识整合方面表现良好，但难以同时兼顾两者并有效抑制电子健康记录中的噪声干扰。患者轨迹具有长时序、高噪声和临床异质性的特点，增加了推荐难度。

Method: GraphDiffMed采用双重尺度差分注意力（Differential Attention v2）机制，分别在就诊内（intra-visit）和就诊间（inter-visit）层级过滤噪声信号，同时在学习过程中整合药理学约束（如药物-药物相互作用，DDI）。框架基于知识约束构建。

Result: 实验结果表明，该设计在MIMIC-III数据集和消融实验中持续提升推荐质量与排序性能，同时实现了更优的安全性平衡。最佳配置仅使用人口统计学辅助特征即可达到最优表现。

Conclusion: GraphDiffMed通过将噪声感知注意机制与药理学约束相结合，验证了该方法能够产生更可靠且具有临床意义的药物推荐。该框架在MIMIC-III数据集上的实验表明其在推荐质量、排序性能和安全性方面均优于强基线模型，且仅使用人口统计学辅助特征时表现最佳。

Abstract: Recommending safe and effective medication combinations from electronic health records (EHRs) is a core clinical AI problem, yet it remains difficult because patient trajectories are long, noisy, and clinically heterogeneous. Existing methods typically excel at either temporal modeling across visits or pharmacological knowledge integration (e.g., drug-drug interactions, DDIs), but rarely achieve both while robustly suppressing noise. We present GraphDiffMed, a knowledge-constrained medication recommendation framework built on dual-scale Differential Attention v2. Differential attention is applied at both intra-visit and inter-visit levels to filter spurious signals within encounters and across longitudinal history, while pharmacological constraints are incorporated during learning. Experiments on MIMIC-III and ablation studies show that this design consistently improves recommendation quality and ranking over strong baselines while achieving a more favorable safety performance balance. We further find that the strongest-performing configuration uses only demographic auxiliary features under our experimental setting. Overall, GraphDiffMed demonstrates that combining noise-aware attention with pharmacological constraints yields more reliable and clinically meaningful medication recommendation. We open-source our code at https://github.com/saxenakrati09/GraphDiffMed.

</details>


### [131] [Polynomial-Time Robust Multiclass Linear Classification under Gaussian Marginals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21428)
*Ilias Diakonikolas,Giannis Iakovidis,Mingchen Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper addresses agnostic learning of multiclass linear classifiers under Gaussian distribution. The authors reveal that standard multiclass perceptron fails even in clean settings, and develop polynomial-time robust learners achieving error Õ(k^(3/2)√opt) for general k, O(opt) for k=3, and poly(k)·opt for geometrically regular classifiers.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The binary case (k=2) of agnostic learning under Gaussian distribution has well-developed algorithmic theory, but for k≥3, prior robust algorithms incur exponential complexity. Even for k=3, robust learning remained computationally intractable.

Method: Developed new structural results for multiclass linear classifiers, including pairwise improper-learning framework and sharper localization-based framework to achieve efficient learning.

Result: 1) Standard multiclass perceptron requires super-polynomially many samples even with clean labels; 2) Pairwise improper-learning yields error O(k^(3/2)√opt)+ε; 3) Localization-based framework achieves error O(opt)+ε for k=3 and poly(k)·opt+ε for geometrically regular classifiers.

Conclusion: Successfully developed fully polynomial-time robust learners for multiclass linear classification with dimension-independent error guarantees, overcoming the exponential complexity barrier of prior methods.

Abstract: We study the task of agnostic learning of multiclass linear classifiers under the Gaussian distribution. Given labeled examples $(x, y)$ from a distribution over $\mathbb{R}^d \times [k]$, with Gaussian $x$-marginal, the goal is to output a hypothesis whose error is comparable to that of the best $k$-class linear classifier. While the binary case $k=2$ has a well-developed algorithmic theory, much less is known for $k \ge 3$. Even for $k=3$, prior robust algorithms incur exponential dependence on the inverse of the desired accuracy in both complexity and representation size. In this work, we develop new structural results for multiclass linear classifiers and use them to design fully polynomial-time robust learners with dimension-independent error guarantees. Our first result shows that the standard multiclass perceptron algorithm requires super-polynomially many samples and updates, even with clean labels and Gaussian marginals, revealing a basic obstruction absent in the binary case. Our main positive result is a pairwise improper-learning framework which yields an efficient learner with error $\widetilde O(k^{3/2}\sqrt{\mathrm{opt}})+ε$ for general $k$. Additionally, we develop a sharper localization-based framework which leads to error $O(\mathrm{opt})+ε$ for $k=3$, and error $\mathrm{poly}(k)\mathrm{opt}+ε$ for geometrically regular $k$-class linear classifiers.

</details>


### [132] [TabPFN-MT: A Natively Multitask In-Context Learner for Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20234)
*Cormac Cureton,Narges Armanfard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabPFN-MT是一种多任务表格学习模型，通过扩展y编码器和共享解码器头实现多任务上下文学习，在保持单任务竞争力的同时将推理成本从O(T)降至O(1)，在344个数据集上达到深度表格多任务学习新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PFNs专为单任务推理设计，处理多目标预测需重复前向传播且无法实现任务间信息共享，存在计算效率低下和缺乏依赖关系建模的问题。

Method: 提出TabPFN-MT模型，采用扩展的多目标合成先验训练，通过扩展的y编码器和共享解码器头实现多任务上下文学习，支持同时推理。模型依赖上下文学习而非传统梯度训练进行小到中型数据集预测。

Result: 在344个数据集上的广泛评估表明，TabPFN-MT在深度表格多任务学习中建立新SOTA；在多任务数据集上实现平均准确率排名4.89，为所有测试模型中最高平均排名；同时保持与最新单任务集成方法的强竞争力。

Conclusion: TabPFN-MT成功实现了高效的多任务表格学习，在保持竞争力的同时将T个任务的推理成本从O(T)降至O(1)，为小型至中型数据集的多目标表格应用带来显著的计算效率提升。

Abstract: Prior-Data Fitted networks (PFNs) have been very successful in tabular contexts, handling prediction tasks in context. However, they are designed for single-task inference, meaning that predicting several target values within a context requires repeated forward calls and precludes inter-task information sharing. We propose TabPFN-MT, which is trained on an expanded multi-target synthetic prior to capture inter-task dependencies in context. This model uses an expanded $y$-encoder and a shared decoder head to enable multitask in-context learning and simultaneous inference. The model is uniquely specialized for small-to-medium datasets by relying on in-context learning rather than traditional gradient-based training. Within this regime (averaging fewer than 1,000 samples), extensive evaluations across 344 datasets demonstrate that TabPFN-MT establishes a new state-of-the-art for deep tabular multitask learning. Furthermore, despite the inherent compute asymmetry of joint optimization, our model remains highly competitive with the latest state-of-the-art single-task ensembles. Notably, on multitask datasets it achieves an overall Accuracy rank of 4.89, the highest average rank among all models tested. Crucially, TabPFN-MT delivers this highly competitive performance while reducing the inference cost for $T$ tasks from $O(T)$ to $O(1)$ forward passes, offering a massive computational efficiency improvement for multi-target tabular applications.

</details>


### [133] [Provably Learning Diffusion Models under the Manifold Hypothesis: Collapse and Refine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20235)
*Wei Huang,Andi Han,Mingyuan Bai,Huanjian Zhou,Qixin Zhang,Taiji Suzuki,Kenji Fukumizu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了扩散模型中score函数几何驱动的"坍缩-精炼"学习机制，并提出SiLD框架，通过单一去噪分数匹配目标统一流形学习与密度估计，实现样本复杂度仅依赖数据内在维度的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量高维数据，但其训练如何高效学习score函数、避开维度诅咒（当数据位于低维流形上时）的机理尚缺乏理论解释。现有VAE-based潜在扩散模型的KL正则化缺乏理论依据。

Method: 本文提出Score-induced Latent Diffusion (SiLD)框架，核心是"坍缩-精炼"机制。该机制由score函数几何特性驱动：小噪声尺度下，score函数的奇异性导致去噪映射快速坍缩到数据流形投影；中等噪声尺度下，训练过程精炼学习流形上的内在密度。采用两阶段架构：流形学习与密度估计均从单一去噪分数匹配目标中涌现。

Result: 实验验证：在Stacked MNIST、CelebA变体及分子生成基准上，SiLD在生成质量上匹配或超越VAE-based LDMs，且重建效果显著改善，证实了理论预测的准确性。

Conclusion: SiLD成功将流形学习和密度估计统一在去噪分数匹配框架下，在保持高质量生成的同时显著提升重建效果，且样本复杂度仅依赖内在维度而非环境维度，为扩散模型的机理理解提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate high-dimensional data with remarkable quality, yet how their training efficiently learns the score function, bypassing the curse of dimensionality when data is supported on low-dimensional manifolds, remains theoretically unexplained. We identify a collapse-and-refine mechanism driven by the geometry of the score function itself: at small noise scales, the diverging singularity of the score drives a rapid dimensional collapse of the induced denoising map onto the data manifold projection; at moderate noise scales, training refines the intrinsic density on the learned manifold. We instantiate this principle as Score-induced Latent Diffusion (SiLD), a two-stage framework in which both manifold learning and density estimation emerge from a single denoising score matching objective, replacing the heuristic KL regularization of VAE-based latent diffusion models. We prove that the resulting sample complexity depends on the intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension. Experiments on Stacked MNIST, CelebA variants, and molecular generation benchmarks show that SiLD matches or outperforms VAE-based LDMs in generation quality and consistently improves reconstruction, validating our theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [134] [MagBridge-Battery: A Synthetic Bridge Dataset for Li-ion Magnetometry and State-of-Health Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20240)
*Sakthi Prabhu Gunasekar,Prasanna Kumar Rangarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布了MagBridge-Battery v1.0数据集，通过桥接真实磁形态数据与电池SOH标签，创建了6,760个磁场签名样本用于电池健康诊断研究。数据集包含有根据样本、合成异常样本和低电压外推样本三部分，并定义了回归、分类和异常检测三项基准任务。标签混淆实验验证了数据集的有效性，代码和数据均公开可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电池健康诊断主要依赖电池端子处的电化学信号测量。另一研究脉络表明磁传感可以解析端子测量无法获取的信息，但方法开发受限于公开磁测量数据集的缺失。目前缺乏配对有标签的电池磁测量数据集，制约了该领域的发展。

Method: 数据集构建采用桥接策略：从Mohammadi-Jerschow开放科学框架档案提取真实磁形态数据，从PulseBat数据集获取SOH标签，通过条件生成方法创建6,760个配对样本。数据集包含三类样本：(1)5,600个PulseBat条件化的有根据样本，(2)600个源自干净父样本的合成传感器异常样本，(3)560个低电压Regime-B外推样本。基准分割采用细胞级别的不重叠设计，确保零重叠细胞、零跨分割父子对、零样本ID重叠。

Result: 数据集规模：6,760个磁场签名样本。基准验证：细胞不重叠分割通过验证，零重叠细胞、零跨分割父子对、零样本ID重叠。三项基准任务定义完成。消融实验：受控标签混淆使SOH回归R²从约0.77降至约0，证实桥接方法有效编码输入SOH信息而非产生标签对齐伪影。

Conclusion: 提供了磁传感电池诊断的公共基准数据集。MagBridge-Battery v1.0在Zenodo上以CC-BY-4.0许可发布，代码在Apache-2.0许可下发布。该数据集填补了磁传感电池诊断领域缺乏公开基准的空白，为该研究方向提供了重要的基础设施。标签混淆消融实验验证了数据集本身编码了有意义的SOH信息，而非简单的标签伪影。

Abstract: Battery health diagnostics today rely overwhelmingly on electrochemical signals measured at the cell terminals. A parallel literature has shown that magnetic sensing can resolve information that terminal-only measurements miss, but method development is limited by the absence, to the best of our knowledge, of public battery magnetic-measurement datasets paired with degradation labels. We release MagBridge-Battery v1.0, a synthetic dataset of 6,760 magnetic-field signatures that bridges real magnetic morphology from the Mohammadi-Jerschow Open Science Framework (OSF) archive with state-of-health (SOH) labels from the PulseBat dataset. The release contains 5,600 PulseBat-conditioned grounded samples, 600 synthetic sensor-anomaly samples derived from clean parents, and 560 low-voltage Regime-B extrapolation samples. A cell-disjoint, parent-child-leakage-free primary benchmark split is verified to contain zero overlapping cells, zero cross-split parent-child pairs, and zero sample-ID overlap. We define three primary benchmark tasks: SOH regression, second-life classification, and anomaly detection, plus an auxiliary anomaly-subtype classification task. A controlled label-shuffle ablation collapses SOH regression from R^2 approximately 0.77 to approximately 0, confirming that the bridge encodes input SOH non-trivially rather than producing label-aligned artifacts. The dataset is released on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0, and the bridge code and benchmark suite are released under Apache-2.0. This work provides a public benchmark for magnetic-sensing battery diagnostics while paired magnetic-electrochemical measurements remain scarce.

</details>


### [135] [Geometry-Lite: Interpretable Safety Probing via Layer-Wise Margin Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20241)
*Woo Seob Sim,Yu Rang Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究引入Geometry-Lite探针分析LLM安全检测的层级几何结构，发现安全证据主要体现在持久的边界位置几何而非层级间运动信号，最终/极值边际和不安全侧层级占用主导检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前安全探测虽能实现良好的平均检测性能，但无法解释安全/不安全提示分离的几何结构。具体而言：安全证据如何跨层形成？哪些几何特征支持低假阳性决策？在基准转移下哪些几何偏置保持稳定？

Method: 提出Geometry-Lite方法：将每层最终提示-token表示映射到带符号边际，使用三类读出器（质心、局部邻域、监督线性边界），然后通过边界位置、层级变化和粗略形状三个维度总结边际轮廓。在9个指令微调主干模型（1.2B-70B）和7个安全基准上验证。

Result: 安全证据主要通过持久边界位置几何表达：最终边际/极值边际和不安全侧层级占用主导聚合检测性能。有限差分漂移和结构总结对AUROC贡献很小，但漂移可在低FPR阈值下提供小规模召回导向修正。基准转移时，优化线性边界在训练混合上锐利，而类别条件均值几何在预定义困难留出子集上更可靠保留分离。

Conclusion: 安全证据本质上是持久的层级边际几何结构，而非层级间的运动信号。其有用组件和读出级偏置在决策关键区域变得可见。Geometry-Lite作为紧凑分析工具，在提升安全检测性能的同时，揭示了优化线性边界在训练混合上表现锐利，而类别条件均值几何在困难留出子集上更可靠保留分离能力。

Abstract: Prompt-level safety probes for large language models use hidden-state representations to separate safe from unsafe prompts, but strong average detection performance does not explain the geometry of this separation. In particular, it remains unclear how safety evidence is formed across layers, which aspects of that layer-wise geometry support low-false-positive decisions, and which geometric biases remain stable under benchmark shift. We study this as an empirical decomposition problem and introduce Geometry-Lite, a compact prompt-level probe that maps each layer's final prompt-token representation to signed margins under centroid, local-neighborhood, and supervised linear-boundary readouts, then summarizes the resulting margin profiles by boundary position, layer-to-layer change, and coarse shape. Across nine instruction-tuned backbones ($1.2$B--$70$B) and seven safety benchmarks, Geometry-Lite improves over single-layer probes while remaining close to raw multi-layer score stacking, making it a useful instrument for analyzing the multi-layer safety signal. The decomposition shows that safety evidence is expressed primarily through persistent boundary-position geometry: final or extremal margins and unsafe-side layer occupancy dominate aggregate detection performance. In contrast, finite-difference drift and structural summaries add little to pooled AUROC, although drift can provide small recall-oriented corrections under shifted low-FPR thresholds. Under benchmark shift, optimized linear boundaries are sharp on the training mixture, whereas class-conditional mean geometry retains separation more reliably on a predefined hard held-out subset. Overall, prompt-level safety evidence is not primarily a layer-to-layer motion signal, but a persistent layer-wise margin geometry whose useful components and readout-level biases become visible in decision-critical regimes.

</details>


### [136] [LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20242)
*Xin-De Wang,Zhi-Rui Chen,Ze-Feng Gao,Peng-Jie Guo,Cheng Mu,Zhong-Yi Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LEAP是一个结合领域专用大语言模型与贝叶斯优化的闭环框架，用于钙钛矿太阳能电池添加剂的智能优先级排序。该框架从文献中提取机理相关知识并生成可解释分子描述符，在低数据条件下进行不确定性感知筛选。实验验证表明该方法可将器件效率从19.25%提升至21.32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The vast chemical space for precursor additives makes trial-and-error screening prohibitively inefficient for improving perovskite solar cell performance; there's a need for intelligent prioritization that leverages accumulated scientific knowledge.

Method: Domain-specialized LLM extracts mechanism-relevant knowledge from perovskite additive literature and generates interpretable molecular descriptors; these descriptors integrate into a Bayesian optimization workflow for uncertainty-aware prioritization under low-data conditions; expert-in-the-loop review ensures feasibility assessment.

Result: Domain-specialized model outperforms general-purpose LLMs in mechanism-consistent reasoning on unseen literature; experimental validation across 3 screening rounds demonstrates improved additive prioritization with average PCEs reaching 20.13% (6-CDQ) and 20.87% (2-CNA) versus 19.25% control, achieving a champion device PCE of 21.32%.

Conclusion: Literature-grounded mechanistic descriptors coupled with Bayesian optimization and expert review can effectively support mechanism-aware additive prioritization; achieved champion PCE of 21.32% with 2-CNA treatment, representing meaningful improvement over 19.25% control baseline.

Abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. We develop LEAP(LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), an expert-in-the-loop closed framework that couples a domain-specialized large language model(LLM) with active learning for iterative additive prioritization. The LLM is trained to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge from the perovskite additive literature and to represent candidate molecules through interpretable descriptors, which are further integrated into a Bayesian optimization workflow for uncertainty-aware prioritization under low-data conditions. Benchmark results on unseen literature show that the domain-specialized model outperforms general-purpose models in mechanism-consistent reasoning. Experimental validation in an expert-in-the-loop proof-of-concept study suggests improved additive prioritization across three screening rounds, leading to average device PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% for the later-round 6-CDQ- and 2-CNA-treated devices, respectively, compared with 19.25% for the control, with a champion PCE of 21.32%. These results provide preliminary evidence that literature-grounded mechanistic descriptors, when coupled with Bayesian optimization and expert feasibility review, can support mechanism-aware additive prioritization in perovskite photovoltaics.

</details>


### [137] [GROW: Aligning GRPO with State-Action Modeling for Open-World VLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20246)
*Xiongbin Wu,Zhihao Luo,Shanzhe Lei,Lechao Zhang,Xuhong Wang,Jie Yang,Zhonglong Zheng,Yuanjie Zheng,Xin Tan,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GROW是一种用于开放世界VLM智能体的强化学习框架，通过将轨迹分解为状态-动作样本并在其间计算优势来克服标准GRPO的局限性，在800多个Minecraft任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM智能体依赖监督微调（SFT），而先进的强化学习算法GRPO因需完整轨迹导致上下文过长和噪声问题，尚未被有效应用于多轮强化学习。

Method: 提出GROW框架，将收集的轨迹分解为状态-动作样本，在样本间而非整条轨迹上计算优势；并提供替代损失函数分析，证明在简化假设下可保留GRPO的相对策略优化核心信号。

Result: 在800多个Minecraft任务上达到SOTA性能，验证了该RL框架对开放世界VLM智能体的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过轨迹分解策略，GROW成功将GRPO应用于多轮VLM智能体训练，为开放世界视觉-语言智能体的强化学习提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Recently, vision-language model (VLM) agents have shown promising progress in open-world tasks, where successful task completion often requires multiple turns of visual perception and action execution. However, existing methods still rely primarily on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with expert demonstrations, while the advanced reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has not been effectively employed for multi-turn RL in these tasks because standard GRPO requires full trajectories as training samples which leads to excessively long context and noise. To address this issue, we propose GROW, a RL framework for open-world VLM agents that decomposes collected trajectories into state-action samples, and computes advantages between these samples rather than treating a full trajectory as a single entity. We further provide a surrogate analysis indicating that, even though the grouped samples are conditioned on different local states rather than an identical prompt context, the objective can preserve the core relative policy optimization signal of GRPO under simplifying assumptions. Experiments on more than 800 Minecraft tasks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed RL framework for open-world VLM agents.

</details>


### [138] [A Deployment Audit of Release-Side Risk in Conformal Triage under Prevalence Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20956)
*Chengze Li,Xiao Liu,Hanrong Zhang,Haiyang Peng,Yanghao Ruan,Huanhuan Ma,Chunyu Miao,Qichao Zhou,Xiangrong Qi,Philip Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对共形分诊中的部署审计问题，提出一种泄漏感知审计框架，通过将目标对象分配到三个非重叠角色（患病率校正、共形校准、留出发布安全评估）来评估在高患病率偏移下，是否有事件阳性患者被无审查释放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边际覆盖率和工作审查率等指标无法捕捉安全性关键问题：当患病率发生偏移时，真正经历目标事件（如癌症复发）的患者是否被释放而未经审查。传统的评估方法可能掩盖危险信号。

Method: 提出泄漏感知部署审计框架，将目标受试者分配到三个非重叠角色：(1) 患病率校正，(2) 共形校准，(3) 留出发布安全评估。该方法通过分离这三个角色，直接评估发布安全性：有多少事件阳性患者被清除而未审查、试点是否有足够事件标签进行校准、以及安全-审查权衡如何变化。

Result: 在NSCLC（非小细胞肺癌）回顾性试点研究中，该审计揭示了降低审查率的误导性：经患病率校正后，合并共形分支通过释放更多患者降低了审查率，但其中部分患者为事件阳性。类别级分支作为稀缺性诊断工具显示：试点中事件标签不足，无法认证安全的低审查率发布。

Conclusion: 该审计框架能够识别传统指标无法发现的安全隐患；证实了在事件标签稀缺的情况下，低审查率发布存在风险；为共形分诊的部署安全性提供了系统性的评估工具。

Abstract: Conformal triage converts predictive scores into deployment actions that either release a case, flag it for urgent attention, or defer it to human review. Under prevalence shift, however, the usual summaries of marginal coverage and human-review rate can miss the safety-critical question of whether patients who truly experience the target event are released without review. To address this gap, we introduce a leakage-aware deployment audit for release-side conformal triage. It first assigns target subjects to three non-overlapping roles: prevalence correction, conformal calibration, and held-out release-safety evaluation. This separation then lets the audit evaluate release directly: how many event-positive patients are cleared without review, whether the pilot has enough event labels for calibration, and how the safety-review trade-off shifts. Applying this audit to a retrospective NSCLC pilot shows why lower review can be misleading: after prevalence correction, the pooled conformal branch lowers review by releasing more patients, some of whom are event-positive. Within the audit, the classwise branch acts as a scarcity diagnostic: the pilot has too few event labels to certify safe low-review release.

</details>


### [139] [CP-MoE: Consistency-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20247)
*Yang Liu,Toan Nguyen,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CP-MoE框架，通过引入瞬态专家捕获早期任务特定更新并引导其整合到稳定专家中，结合一致性保持路由偏置和正则化机制，解决了MoE架构中持续学习的灾难性遗忘问题，在语言和多模态任务上均验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoRA的MoE持续学习方法面临根本性权衡：专家隔离过于激进限制知识跨任务迁移，或任务特定更新覆盖重要现有参数导致严重遗忘。

Method: 提出CP-MoO框架，包含两个核心机制：1) 一致性保持路由偏置，利用瞬态专家估计与稳定专家的表示相似性，引导路由选择更兼容的专家；2) 瞬态专家引导的正则化机制，在合并时选择性保护重要的历史参数。两者协同作用减少参数干扰和遗忘，同时保持跨任务知识迁移。

Result: 在SuperNI基准测试中达到最优性能并展现更强的零样本迁移能力；在VQA v2数据集上有效扩展到多模态视觉推理，持续减少遗忘并优于强基线。

Conclusion: CP-MoE通过瞬态专家机制和双重策略有效解决了LoRA-based MoE持续学习中的参数干扰和遗忘问题，在语言和视觉-语言任务上均达到最优性能。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a major obstacle to continual learning in large language models (LLMs) and vision--language models (VLMs). Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer an efficient path to scaling, existing LoRA-based MoE continual learning methods still face a fundamental trade-off: they either isolate experts too aggressively, limiting knowledge transfer across tasks, or allow task-specific updates to overwrite important existing parameters, leading to severe forgetting. To address this, we propose CP-MoE, a continual learning framework built around a transient expert that captures early task-specific updates and guides their integration into stable experts. CP-MoE introduces a consistency-preserving routing bias, which uses the transient expert to estimate representation similarity with stable experts and steer routing towards more compatible expert selection, and a transient expert-guided regularisation mechanism, which selectively protects important historical parameters during merging. Together, these components reduce parameter interference and forgetting while preserving cross-task knowledge transfer. We validate CP-MoE on both unimodal and multimodal continual learning benchmarks with LLM-based and VLM-based MoE models. On SuperNI benchmark, spanning diverse sequential language tasks, CP-MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance and stronger zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks. On VQA v2 dataset, it scales effectively to multimodal visual reasoning, consistently reduces forgetting, and outperforms strong MoE baselines.

</details>


### [140] [Graph Transductive Sharpening: Leveraging Unlabeled Predictions in Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20248)
*Brown Zaz,Mar Gonzàlez I Català,Ferran Hernandez Caralt,Moshe Eliasof,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Transductive Sharpening (TS)：一种与骨干架构无关的损失级改造，在有监督交叉熵之上，对无标签节点最小化 Tsallis 熵 (q=2，Gini 不纯度，即 1-||p||_2^2)，同时对有标签节点最大化该熵以防止过自信。灵感来自交叉熵的分解 L_CE = H(p) + Σ(p_i - y_i)log p_i，其中熵项与标签无关，因而可在任意节点上计算。TS 仅引入一个标量超参 λ，在 13 个节点分类基准、MLP/GCN/SAGE/GAT 四种骨干上全面持平或优于基线（如 GCN 在 Cora +1.20、CiteSeer +2.50），且无需改动架构、不增加时空复杂度（额外开销 O(nC)）。λ=0.25 可作为跨数据集/架构的通用取值；在同等骨干下与自训练 (ST) 性能相当，但训练时间效率高出数倍（每单位时间精度可达 ST 的 2–10 倍），并在 ogbn-products/ogbn-papers100M 等大规模图上同样有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半监督/直推式节点分类的进展长期集中在架构创新（消息传递方案、Transformer 化模型），而训练目标（损失函数）这一正交维度被忽视。作者指出一个被忽略的事实：在直推设定下模型在每一步训练都对全图所有节点产生预测，包括无标签节点，但标准监督损失因缺少真值标签而丢弃了这些输出；而一旦模型形成较可靠、自信的预测，其自身输出即可成为无标签节点的学习信号。作者进一步通过交叉熵分解说明监督目标中存在天然与标签无关的部分（Shannon 熵项），因此可以构造任务无关、无需额外先验（如类别平衡假设）的无标签利用方式，从而提出“目标函数设计”这一被低估的改进轴。

Method: 方法分四部分。(1) 形式化：定义“增广直推目标” L = L_sup + f({p_v}_{v∈V_U})，其中 f 为定义在概率单纯形上的无标签信号提取函数。(2) 理论依据：引理 1 证明交叉熵可分解为标签无关的 Shannon 熵 H(p) 与标签依赖的对齐项，提示可仅通过预测分布的不确定性来构造 f。(3) 通用 TS 目标（定义 3）：L_R = L_sup + λ·(1/|V_U|)Σ_{V_U} R(p_v) − λ·(1/|V_L|)Σ_{V_L} R(p_v)，即无标签节点最小化不确定性（借鉴熵最小化/伪标签思想）、有标签节点最大化不确定性（抑制过自信、缓解过拟合），λ 控制强度；两项均按节点数归一化。(4) 实例化：选用 q=2 的 Tsallis 熵（等价于 Gini 不纯度）S_2(p)=1−Σp_i²=1−||p||_2²，最小化它等价于最大化预测分布的平方 L2 范数，具有二次、无需对数、易求导的优势；Shannon 熵为对照消融。工程实现基于 tunedGNN(PyG/DGL)，骨干超参沿用其逐格点最优配置，仅新增 O(nC) 的损失与梯度计算，不改变时间/显存复杂度。实验协议：13 个基准（Cora/CiteSeer/PubMed、Computer/Photo/CS/Physics、WikiCS、Squirrel/Chameleon、Amazon-Ratings、Roman-Empire、Minesweeper，后者用 ROC-AUC），4 种骨干；Cora/CiteSeer/PubMed 为类别平衡的 20-per-class 划分，Amazon/Coauthor 为 60/20/20，WikiCS/Squirrel/Chameleon 及 Platonov 系列取前 5 个官方划分，每格点 5 个配对种子；对比自训练 (ST) 与更先进架构 (GraphGPS、NAGphormer、Exphormer、GOAT、NodeFormer、SGFormer、Polynormer、NormProp、GCN+ReP、CoED、M3Dphormer、GraphTARIF、BuNN、Dir-Poly、CPGNN、FSGNN、GloGNN、GPRGNN、H2GCN 等)。

Result: 主结果：TS 在 13 个数据集 × 4 骨干上总体持平或提升，典型增益如 GCN：Cora 84.54→85.74、CiteSeer 72.68→75.18、WikiCS 79.97→80.31、Roman-Empire 91.15→91.66；MLP 提升更大（Cora +3.52、CiteSeer +6.14、PubMed +3.34），但 MLP+TS 仍低于对应 GNN，说明 TS 不替代消息传递。少数回退存在（如 GAT/PubMed −0.92、GCN/Computer −0.14、SAGE/Chameleon −1.00），且多在 1 个标准差内。λ 消融（以 Glass's Δ 归一化）显示性能在中等正值区间达峰、过大 λ 迅速恶化，λ∈[0,0.5] 为稳定区，λ=0.25 为跨域通用取值：Table 4 显示固定 λ=0.25 仍在多数格点提升（如 GAT/Cora +1.30、GAT/CiteSeer +2.90），个别格点退化但幅度有限。结构消融表明：去掉有标签侧熵最大化项普遍变差；引入非对称偏移 (λ_U≠−λ_L) 无系统性收益且常轻微退化；Shannon 与 Tsallis 平均精度相近但 Shannon 方差更大（如 GAT/Roman-Empire 出现 −26.21±44.01 的极端波动）；元学习 λ（内层训练集/元训练集一步更新）整体劣于验证集选定的常数 λ，说明额外的元优化引入不稳定性。效率方面（Table 3，1000×精度/秒），TS 显著优于 ST：如 Cora 上 GCN 为 2580 vs 432、SAGE 2645 vs 341、GAT 2828 vs 330，且该比较尚未计入 ST 的 8 组验证调参开销。扩展实验：OGB 大规模图 ogbn-arxiv/products/papers100M 上均提升（products SAGE +1.49、papers100M SAGE +0.75）；在更强架构 SGFormer 与 Polynormer 上，10 个“架构-数据集”配对中 7 个取得正增益，但幅度随模型与数据集变化（SGFormer/Cora +2.18、SGFormer/CiteSeer +2.66，SGFormer/PubMed −0.78）。与竞争架构的横向比较显示：在同质图上 TS 增强的标准 GNN 已接近甚至达到专用方法水平（如 GCN+TS 在 CiteSeer 75.18、WikiCS 80.31），而在异质图上结果混合，多数专用异质方法（如 GPRGNN、GloGNN、CPGNN）仍明显更强。

Conclusion: 结论：TS 是一种极简、架构无关的损失级改造，将训练过程中被标准监督目标丢弃的无标签节点预测直接转化为学习信号；它只增加一个标量超参、不改动架构/数据管线/训练流程，以极低开销在广泛基准上带来稳定增益，并在性能-复杂度权衡上优于需要伪标签重训练的自训练方案；核心洞见是“直推模型自身产生的无标签预测是有效且被低估的训练信号，置信度/熵是提取该信号的自然途径”。局限与展望：收益幅度依赖架构与数据集，异质图场景增益不稳定；TS 不替代消息传递也不取代架构创新；λ 的最优值随数据而异（逐格点 λ* 在 0–1.65 间），通用 0.25 只是稳定区中点；未来工作包括拓展到链路预测、时序节点分类等其他直推任务，以及按训练阶段或基于置信度准则的轻度自适应 λ（区别于本文中失败的一步元学习方案）。

Abstract: In the transductive setting, where the full graph is observed but node labels are only partially available, progress in semi-supervised node classification has largely focused on architectural innovation. In this paper, we revisit an orthogonal axis: the training objective. We start from a simple observation: transductive models produce predictions for every node during training, including nodes without labels. These unlabeled-node predictions may contain useful training signal, but standard supervised objectives discard them because no ground-truth labels are available. Inspired by the decomposition of cross-entropy into a label-dependent alignment term and a label-independent entropy term, we propose prediction confidence as a natural way to extract this signal in the absence of labels. This motivates Transductive Sharpening (TS): a loss-level modification that minimizes prediction entropy on unlabeled nodes while counterbalancing this effect on labeled nodes. We evaluate Transductive Sharpening across a wide range of node-classification benchmarks and observe consistent performance improvements without requiring any changes to the backbone architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/transductive-sharpening/tunedGNN.

</details>


### [141] [Automated Kernel Discovery Towards Understanding High-dimensional Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20249)
*Taeyoung Yun,Woocheol Shin,Inhyuck Song,Jaewoo Lee,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kernel Discovery，一种LLM驱动的进化框架，用于高维贝叶斯优化中的核函数自动设计。核心创新包括：①两阶段方法（数学形式→代码）避免直接生成代码的语义重复问题；②突破传统搜索空间限制；③使用LOO-CRPS准则防止过拟合。在5个高维BO任务中，该方法在17种方法中达到平均排名1.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化（BO）中，GP核函数设计是关键但困难的任务。现有自动化方法存在两个瓶颈：①核函数搜索空间被限制在基础核函数的加法和乘法组合；②基于LLM的方法需要处理原始观测数据，受限于上下文长度且难以提取有效模式。这两个限制导致现有方法在高维场景下性能不佳。

Method: 1. **两阶段LLM生成方法**：第一阶段让LLM提出新颖的数学形式，第二阶段将数学形式转换为可执行的验证代码，避免直接生成代码导致的语法多样但功能重复问题。

2. **扩展核函数搜索空间**：突破传统加法和乘法基础核函数的限制，允许更自由的核函数形式搜索。

3. **LOO-CRPS选择准则**：留一法连续排名概率分数作为核函数选择标准，通过惩罚过拟合来选择更优的核函数。

4. **进化框架**：结合LLM生成能力和进化算法思想，迭代优化核函数设计。

Result: 在5个高维BO基准测试中，Kernel Discovery在17种方法中取得平均排名1.2的优异性能，显著优于竞争性基线方法。研究还发现了在高维BO中表现优异的核函数特征。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了Kernel Discovery框架，通过LLM驱动的进化方法自动化设计高维贝叶斯优化中的GP核函数。实验表明该方法在17种方法中平均排名1.2，显著优于基线方法，并发现了适合高维BO的关键核函数特征。

【核心贡献】
1. 提出两阶段LLM方法解决上下文长度限制问题
2. 定义更广阔的核函数搜索空间（突破预设组合规则）
3. 设计LOO-CRPS准则防止核函数过拟合
4. 通过代码生成+数学形式分离的方式确保生成的核函数有效且可执行

【关键发现】
- 直接让LLM生成核函数代码会导致语法多样但功能相同的问题
- 两阶段方法（数学形式→代码）可有效解决此问题
- 发现了适合高维BO的核函数特征

Abstract: Gaussian Process (GP) kernels are central to Bayesian optimization (BO), yet designing effective kernels for high-dimensional problems still relies on extensive manual engineering. Existing automated approaches struggle in high dimensions for two bottlenecks: their kernel search space is limited to additions and multiplications of base kernels, and LLM-based approaches require conditioning on raw observations, which becomes infeasible due to context-length limits and the difficulty of extracting meaningful patterns. We introduce \textbf{Kernel Discovery}, a LLM-driven evolutionary framework for high-dimensional BO that searches a broader kernel space beyond predefined composition rules and does not require conditioning on observations. Motivated by the observation that directly prompting an LLM to generate kernel code yields syntactically varied but functionally identical kernels, we adopt a two-stage approach: an LLM first proposes novel mathematical forms, then a second LLM call converts each form into validated, executable code. We also propose a leave-one-out continuous ranked probability score (LOO-CRPS) as a selection criterion that penalizes overfitted kernels. On five high-dimensional BO benchmarks, our method achieves an average rank of \textbf{1.2 out of 17}, outperforming competitive baselines.
  We further analyze the discovered kernels to identify which kernels lead to improvements in high-dimensional BO.

</details>


### [142] [Physics-informed convolutional neural networks for fluid flow through porous media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20250)
*Rafał Topolnicki,Paweł Dłotko,Maciej Matyka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"物理启发"（physics-informed）卷积神经网络框架：以二维多孔介质结构图像（256×256）为输入，用 U-Net 型编码器—解码器（可插换多种 CNN 骨干网络）直接预测孔隙尺度的速度场。核心创新是自定制复合损失函数，将速度重建误差与四类物理约束（固体内无流动 L1 惩罚、不可压缩散度惩罚、周期性平移一致性惩罚、曲折度匹配）加权组合，权重通过系统消融确定（α=5, β=1, γ=0.1, δ=0.01）。最佳模型 ResNet-101 速度场 RMSE=5.10×10⁻³、曲折度 R²=0.983（MAPE 0.6%）、渗透率 R²=0.997（MAPE 4.8%）；模型在未见过的障碍形状、管道边界、不同孔隙率与真实 Li-O₂ 电极 CT 结构上表现出良好泛化能力；将预测速度场用作 LBM 的初始场可显著加速收敛（90% 案例更快，迭代数中位数减少约 50%，Wilcoxon p≈4×10⁻⁷⁰）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多孔介质中孔隙尺度流动模拟面临两个核心困难：孔隙几何复杂导致 Navier–Stokes 方程求解需精心构造网格并依赖人工干预，且动量输运的扩散特性使标准数值求解器收敛缓慢；而在渗透率测定、CO₂ 封存、滤芯催化、血脑屏障药物输运等应用中往往需要成百上千次重复求解，计算成本成为瓶颈。由于 LBM 求解器本身同样存在收敛慢的问题（尤其在高/低孔隙率下），需要一种能够从几何图像快速推断流场的代理模型。已有工作表明 CNN 可仅凭结构图像预测多孔样品的宏观输运性质（Graczyk & Matyka 2020; Graczyk et al. 2023），也有金属泡沫场预测的成功先例（Lin et al. 2025），但针对孔隙尺度速度场的物理约束损失函数尚缺乏系统设计与逐项评估。作者的目标不是提出新的学习范式，而是构建并逐项验证一套面向孔隙尺度流动的物理约束损失函数，并考察架构依赖性、分布外泛化行为及对 LBM 的加速效用。

Method: 数据与求解器：二维多孔结构由 N∈[10,100] 个驻波叠加（随机方向与相位、波长由 k∈[−12,12] 决定）生成随机三角多项式场 f(x)，以阈值 ε 划分固相 ℬ/孔相 𝒫 达到目标孔隙率 φ∈[0.70, 0.95]（共 10,000 个样本，剔除不连通样本）；用 D2Q9 BGK 格式的 LBM 在周期边界、重力驱动、no-slip 条件下求解稳态流场生成标签，曲折度按 τ=⟨v⟩/⟨v_x⟩ 计算，渗透率按 Kozeny–Carman 型 k=φ³/(cτ²S) 推算。模型：U-Net 编码器—解码器 + 跳跃连接 + bottleneck + 转置卷积解码，输出双通道 (u_x, u_y)；骨干网络可替换为 VGG16、ResNet18/50/101/152、DenseNet121/201、ConvNeXt Tiny/Small/Base、EfficientNet B2/V2 S、MobileNetV3 S/L。损失：L = L_vel（逐分量 MSE）+ α·L_obstacle（固相内 |u| 的 L1 惩罚，强调消除微小渗透）+ β·L_div（孔相内一阶差分离散散度平方）+ γ·L_perio（对结构做 T=[L/2,L/2] 周期平移后的预测与平移后预测的一致性）+ δ·L_tort（预测曲折度与参考值平方差），各项积分在 256×256 网格上以离散求和实现。训练：数据增强（以 p=0.5 随机竖直翻转并令 v_y→−v_y；随机 roll 且位移不超过 30%，保持速度场连续性）；两阶段策略——第一阶段仅用 L_vel+αL_obstacle（α=5）训练"pilot"模型，第二阶段载入其权重用全损失微调（β=1, γ=0.1, δ=0.01）；Adam，lr 5×10⁻⁴→1×10⁻⁵，梯度裁剪 1.0→0.1，batch size 32，step scheduler（step 10, γ=0.8），早停 patience 20，约 250 epochs；数据划分 70/15/15，每种架构用 3 个随机划分取均值±标准差，评估指标为速度场逐像素 RMSE 及曲折度/渗透率的 RMSE、MAPE、R²。补充材料另做：条件分位数（PCHIP 插值）误差置信界分析、超参敏感性扫描（各参数跨约两个数量级）、以及 Fourier Neural Operator 的对照实验（16 模态、宽度 256、4 层谱卷积）。

Result: 损失项消融（ResNet-101）：仅用 L_vel 时速度 MSE 最低但固相内出现虚假流动、曲折度 R² 仅 0.127；加入 L_obstacle（α=5）后固相惩罚下降两个数量级、R²_τ 升至 0.901；再加 L_div（β=1）进一步降低散度与 L_vel；加入 L_perio（γ=0.1）修复周期边界处的伪流与"三面封闭区域出流位置错误"等失效模式；再加入 L_tort（δ=0.01）得到 R²_τ=0.983，同时保持与基线相当的 L_vel——完整损失在局部精度、物理合理性、宏观量精度之间取得最佳权衡。架构对比（Table 2）：ResNet-101 全面最佳（速度 RMSE 5.10×10⁻³，std 1.92×10⁻³；曲折度 RMSE 1.13×10⁻²、MAPE 0.6%、R²=0.983；渗透率 RMSE 8.69×10²、MAPE 4.8%、R²=0.997），ResNet-50 次之；ConvNeXt/EfficientNet/MobileNetV3 等轻量或现代化设计未带来精度优势，ConvNeXt Base 甚至显著退化（4.40×10⁻²），说明在固定网格上"更复杂/更高效"不等于更准确。泛化性（Table 3，无需再训练）：圆形障碍（R²_τ=0.958, R²_k=0.994）接近训练分布表现，随方形障碍比例升高精度渐进下降，最难的纯方形情形曲折度 MAPE 仍 <2%、渗透率 MAPE <6%；管道/中心隔板边界下 R²_τ>0.96、R²_k>0.99，且垂直于管道方向的速度分量几乎为零（隐式满足单向流约束）；孔隙率 0.7–0.8 表现良好，0.6–0.7 尚可（R²_τ≈0.79），但 0.5–0.6 接近渗流阈值时性能崩溃（R²_τ=0.116、渗透率 MAPE 77%），构成明确的适用边界；真实 Li-O₂ 电池电极 Nano-CT 切片上速度 RMSE 6.41×10⁻³、渗透率 R²=0.986，曲折度 R² 降至 0.798。应用验证：用网络预测作 LBM "warm start"，90% 案例收敛更快，迭代数中位数减少约 50%（IQR 22%–68%，bootstrap 95% CI [46%, 54%]，Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 p≈4×10⁻⁷⁰）；推理耗时 5 ms/样本（RTX 4090）、190 ms（Ryzen 9 5950X），而 LBM 全量计算需 560 ms/样本。补充材料中 FNO 对照显示全损失同样改善 FNO（曲折度 R² 0.897→0.928），说明增益源于损失设计而非 CNN 架构本身；条件分位数分析表明误差带在高流速区狭窄、在低孔隙/近固体边界处明显展宽，与渗流阈值附近的失效现象一致。

Conclusion: 该工作的主要贡献是一套面向孔隙尺度流动预测的物理约束损失函数及其逐项定量评估：L_vel + αL_obstacle + βL_div + γL_perio + δL_tort 的组合能有效抑制固相渗透、保证不可压缩与周期性一致，并显著提升宏观输运量（曲折度、渗透率）的预测精度；最优权重为 α=5、β=1、γ=0.1、δ=0.01，且该增益可迁移至 FNO 等算子学习模型。第二个关键结论是泛化性：在完全未再训练的前提下，模型可迁移到不同障碍形状、管道型边界、不同孔隙率区间乃至真实 CT 微结构；但存在明确局限——实现限于二维、固定分辨率，物理约束仅以罚项近似满足，低孔隙率接近渗流阈值时性能显著退化。作者建议未来工作包括三维扩展（将 2D 卷积替换为 3D）、系统性架构搜索与损失权重自动优化、面向难例的自适应采样/课程学习、以及对实验微结构的迁移学习与少量样本微调，并结合 PINNs、FNO、DeepONets 等框架；同时指出网络推理相对 LBM 有数量级速度优势（5 ms vs 560 ms），具备工程实用价值，代码、数据与预训练模型均已公开。

Abstract: Accurate simulation of fluid flow in porous media is challenging due to complex pore-space geometries and the computational cost of solving the Navier-Stokes equations. This difficulty is particularly important when repeated simulations are required, as standard numerical solvers may converge slowly in intricate porous domains. We present a neural-network-based framework for predicting pore-scale velocity fields directly from sample geometry. The method uses a convolutional encoder-decoder architecture with skip connections to preserve spatial detail while extracting multi-scale features. Physical consistency is encouraged through a custom loss function combining velocity reconstruction with incompressibility, no-flow conditions inside solids, periodicity constraints, and agreement with the global tortuosity index. We analyze the influence of the corresponding loss weights and quantify the contribution of individual loss components to prediction accuracy. Several CNN backbones are evaluated to identify architectures providing accurate and robust predictions. The generalization ability of the trained model is tested on samples outside the training distribution, including changes in obstacle geometry, boundary conditions, porosity, and realistic porous structures. Finally, we demonstrate a practical use of the predicted velocity fields as initial conditions for Lattice-Boltzmann simulations. This warm-start strategy accelerates solver convergence, reducing the number of iterations in over 90% of tested cases.

</details>


### [143] [LOSCAR-SGD: Local SGD with Communication-Computation Overlap and Delay-Corrected Sparse Model Averaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20866)
*Yassine Maziane,Ammar Mahran,Artavazd Maranjyan,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LOSCAR-SGD是一种针对异构计算环境的分布式学习方法，结合了稀疏通信、本地SGD和通信计算重叠，通过延迟校正合并规则处理异步更新，首次为这三项技术的组合提供了理论收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式学习（尤其是联邦学习）中通信是主要瓶颈，现有的组合三种通信减少技术（压缩、本地训练、通信计算重叠）缺乏理论支撑，且异构环境中不同worker可能执行不同数量的本地步骤，现有方法难以有效处理。

Method: LOSCAR-SGD方法采用稀疏通信（仅传输模型坐标子集）、本地步骤优化和延迟校正合并规则，能够在通信进行中继续优化，并将延迟的同步信息纳入更新而不丢弃重叠阶段的进展。

Result: 给出了光滑非凸目标函数的收敛保证，明确了稀疏性、重叠和worker异构性对收敛率的影响。

Conclusion: LOSCAR-SGD通过结合稀疏通信、局部训练和延迟校正合并规则，在异构计算环境下实现了有效收敛，实验验证了通信计算重叠可减少训练时间，延迟校正合并优于简单的覆盖策略。

Abstract: Communication is a major bottleneck in distributed learning, especially in large-scale settings and in federated learning environments with slow links. Three standard ways to reduce this cost are communication compression, local training, and communication-computation overlap. Methods that combine these ingredients are used in practice and have been found to be effective for large-scale training, but there is little theory for methods that combine all three. We study a heterogeneous-compute setting in which different workers may take different numbers of local steps, and we propose LOSCAR-SGD, a Local SGD method that communicates only a sparse subset of model coordinates and continues optimizing while communication is in flight. A key ingredient is a delay-corrected merge rule that incorporates delayed synchronized information without discarding the progress made during the overlap phase. We give convergence guarantees for smooth non-convex objectives and show how sparsity, overlap, and worker heterogeneity affect the rate. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first theory for this combination of ingredients. Experiments further show that communication-computation overlap reduces training time and that the delay-corrected merge outperforms naive overwriting.

</details>


### [144] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20255)
*Prakash Aryan,Kaushik Raghupathruni,Timo Kehrer,Sebastiano Panichella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）共同训练自动驾驶汽车（SDC）与行人，相比固定策略的规则基准产生更真实的交互场景。实验表明，共同训练使SDC目标达成率从35%提升至78%，碰撞率从33%降至14%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于仿真的自动驾驶测试依赖脚本化或简化的行人模型，无法捕捉真实人类过街行为的异质性和不确定性，尤其在由潜在人格特质支配的乱穿马路场景中，限制了安全评估的真实性。

Method: 构建MARL环境，使用MAPPO算法共同训练1辆SDC与12个行人。行人采用脚本化Dijkstra路径规划，RL策略控制高层决策（走/停），乱穿马路概率由每集开始时采样的隐藏人格特质决定。

Result: 500集评估中，MARL训练的SDC达78%目标、14%碰撞率，最佳规则基准仅35%目标、33%碰撞率。速度差分指标显示SDC在乱穿马路者附近（0-3m）比在人行横道用户附近快2.65m/s，表明乱穿马路场景未被预见。乱穿马路占13%过街事件但导致62%碰撞。

Conclusion: MARL共同训练相比单智能体RL减少30%碰撞，行人学会在SDC高速接近时等待。乱穿马路虽占比低但造成大多数碰撞，可从轨迹数据直接测量可预测与不可预测过街的行为差距。

Abstract: Simulation-based testing of self-driving cars (SDCs) typically relies on scripted or simplified pedestrian models that do not capture the heterogeneity and uncertainty of real human crossing behavior. This limits the realism of safety assessments, especially in scenarios involving jaywalking, which is governed by latent personality traits that the vehicle cannot observe. We hypothesize that jointly training pedestrians and the SDC with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) produces more realistic interaction scenarios than training the SDC against fixed pedestrian policies, and that the resulting behavior gap between predictable and unpredictable crossings can be measured directly from trajectories. This paper describes a MARL environment in which an SDC and 12 pedestrians are co-trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO). Pedestrian locomotion follows scripted Dijkstra pathfinding, while an RL policy controls high-level go/wait decisions. Jaywalking probability depends on a per-pedestrian personality trait sampled at episode start and hidden from the SDC. In 500-episode evaluations, the co-trained SDC reached 78% of goals with a 14% collision rate, compared to 35% goals and 33% collisions for the best rule-based baseline. A speed differential metric shows that the SDC traveled 2.65 m/s faster near jaywalkers than near crosswalk users at close range (0-3 m), indicating that jaywalking encounters were not anticipated. Jaywalking accounted for 13% of crossing events but was associated with 62% of collisions. Co-training with MARL pedestrians reduced collisions by 30% relative to single-agent RL, as pedestrians learned to wait when the SDC approached at speed.

</details>


### [145] [FBOS-RL: Feedback-Driven Bi-Objective Synergistic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20256)
*Xikai Zhang,Yongzhi Li,Likang Xiao,Yingze Zhang,Yanhua Cheng,Quan Chen,Peng Jiang,Wenjun Wu,Liu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FBOS-RL框架，通过反馈驱动的双目标协同机制解决GRPO在超出模型能力边界任务上的训练停滞问题，EPA和ECC形成正向飞轮效应，显著提升训练效率和最终性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前GRPO及其变体采用简单的采样策略，对所有rollout使用相同的原始prompt。当任务超出策略模型的当前能力时，这种采样方案难以产生高质量rollout，导致策略模型在参数更新时缺乏有意义的梯度方向，从而造成训练停滞。

Method: 提出了反馈驱动的双目标协同强化学习框架FBOS-RL，包含两个相互增强的训练目标：EPA（利用导向的策略对齐）和ECC（探索导向的能力培养）。核心创新包括：1）基于环境反馈的引导式探索增强机制；2）EPA与ECC的协同训练框架，形成正向飞轮效应。

Result: 实验结果表明：1）在相同的rollout数量下，FBOS-RL比GRPO和基于反馈的基线方法学习速度显著更快；2）最终达到更高的性能上限；3）整个训练过程中展现出更高的策略熵和更低的梯度范数。

Conclusion: FBOS-RL通过EPA和ECC的相互强化形成了正向飞轮效应，在相同数量的rollouts下，显著提升了训练效率和最终性能上限，同时展现出更高的策略熵和更低的梯度范数。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a cornerstone for aligning and unlocking the reasoning capabilities of large-scale models. At its core, the training loop of GRPO and its variants alternates between rollout sampling and policy update. Unlike supervised learning, where each gradient step is anchored to an explicit ground-truth target, the optimal gradient direction for updating model parameters in this setting is not known a priori; the high-quality rollouts drawn during the sampling stage therefore act as the implicit "teacher" that guides every parameter update. However, GRPO adopt a simple sampling scheme that conditions all rollouts on the same original prompt. When a task lies beyond the policy model's current capability, this sampling scheme rarely yields a high-quality rollout, leaving the policy model without a meaningful gradient direction when updating its parameters, which causes training to stall. To address this issue, we propose FBOS-RL, a Feedback-Driven Bi-Objective Synergistic reinforcement learning framework. Specifically, we let the model perform Feedback-Guided Exploration Enhancement based on the feedback provided by the environment, and on top of this we design two mutually reinforcing training objectives: Exploitation-oriented Policy Alignment(EPA) and Exploration-oriented Capability Cultivation(ECC). Extensive experiments demonstrate that EPA and ECC can mutually reinforce each other, forming a positive flywheel effect that significantly improves both the training efficiency and the final performance ceiling of reinforcement learning. Specifically, under an identical number of rollouts, FBOS-RL learns substantially faster than GRPO and feedback-based baselines and ultimately attains a higher performance ceiling, while exhibiting higher policy entropy and lower gradient norms throughout training.

</details>


### [146] [Instance Discrimination for Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20257)
*Valentin Cuzin-Rambaud,Mathieu Lefort,Rémy Cazabet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对图自监督学习中的链接预测任务，提出基于链接表示的新模型L-GRACE和L-BGRL，并证明其性能与现有监督/自监督方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的实例判别自监督学习方法在图像领域已取得成功，在图领域也被应用于节点分类，但较少有工作专门针对链接预测任务进行研究。

Method: 1) 系统评估了现有自监督模型在链接预测上的表现，发现性能主要取决于数据增强过程；2) 提出基于社区结构的结构性增强方法；3) 提出基于链接表示而非节点表示的新模型L-GRACE和L-BGRL。

Result: 所提出的L-GRACE和L-BGRL模型在无属性图上表现优异，性能可与当前最优的监督和自监督方法相媲美。

Conclusion: 基于链接表示的图自监督学习方法在链接预测任务上具有竞争力，数据增强策略对性能有重要影响，社区结构是有效的增强信号。
