Result: 1.2B 结果（基线三种子均值 0.4829）：20 个方法中 8 个落在基线 bootstrap 95% 区间内（|z|<2），6 个名义改进，6 个显著退化（|z|>2）。仅 Softpick（0.4922，z=+4.47，p_Bonf≈1.5e-4）与 HybridNorm（0.4896，z=+3.19，p_Bonf=0.027）通过 Bonferroni；QK-Norm(+2.51)、Sandwich Norm(+2.45)、ReLU²(+2.36)、Selective Attention(+2.15) 降级为提示性证据。Holm 与 Bonferroni 保留同样的 7 个方法，BH(FDR=0.05) 额外纳入 QK-Norm、Sandwich Norm、ReLU²、Diff-Attn，结论在各校正程序下一致。显著失败为 Sigmoid Attention(−0.161)、SSMax(−0.062)、AttnRes(−0.061)、HyperConnections(−0.020)、LayerScale(−0.009)。QK-Norm 与 Softpick 的 3 种子 Welch t 分别为 t=+4.39(p=0.015)、t=+6.36(p=0.0053)；Stouffer 组合给出 Z=+2.68(p=0.0037) 与 Z=+2.85(p=0.0022)，12 项任务中分别有 9 项与 11 项高于基线。分类看：Attention 类效果跨度最大（+0.009 至 −0.161，约 8 倍噪声带宽），Residual 四项无一改进（3 项显著更差、DenseFormer 不可区分），FFN 侧 GeGLU 与基线不可区分、ReLU² 名义显著但不过 Bonferroni；soft/hard 标签不能预测单个方法结果。3B 检验：13 个尝试中 10 个完成、3 个发散；7/7 改进候选与 2/2 失败参照的效应符号在 3B 全部保持，但名次重排明显（QK-Norm+GeGLU 从第 7 升至第 1，Softpick 从第 1 降至第 6，改进者内部 Spearman ρ=−0.27，p≈0.56 不显著），说明 1.2B 可筛选"是否有效"但不可预测"哪一项最有效"。三个发散：HybridNorm 在三个噪声地板种子下均在 2800–3500 步窗口内 NaN、pre-NaN grad-norm 0.18–0.19 与基线一致，指向 Post-LN 深层方差增长（Xiong et al., 2020）而非种子噪声；SSMax grad-norm 由 27 单调升至 1578 后在 5800 步 NaN，属 softmax 替换 logit 爆掉；HyperConnections 自约 15000 步持续 grad-norm 膨胀、18300 步 NaN，属多通道 EMA 残差漂移。三者机制各异且与硬件无关；A100 复现的 1.2B 基线 CLIMB-avg 为 0.4821 vs 主平台 0.4820（差 1e-4，逐任务差 ±0.029 无系统方向），排除基础设施整体解释（但未在 A100 上重跑三个发散案例）。损失—下游脱钩：Sigmoid Attention 验证损失仅高于基线 2.4%、SSMax 仅 3.0%，CLIMB 却分别下降 16 与 6 个点（整个 20 方法区间约 3 点），其中 Sigmoid 的 LAMBADA 从 0.42 掉到近 0；而 AttnRes 损失上升 0.33 nats（13%）与其 CLIMB 落差一致，说明脱钩集中于注意力输出类改造而非"损失普遍不可用"。

Conclusion: 核心结论复现：在这份精心筛选的集合上，多数（后 2021 年的）Transformer 改造在 1.2B–3B 依然不迁移——名义改进 6 项、Bonferroni 存活 2 项、经 3B 稳定性过滤后仅 1 项（Softpick）；6/20 显著退化且退化机制与具体干预方式对齐（如去掉 softmax 跨位置归一化、Post-LN 深层方差增长、EMA 漂移），提示"不迁移"是特定干预的系统性属性而非随机噪声。论文的贡献在于协议更新而非新架构：在 1–3B 尺度做架构比较，三项前提已成必需——R5 多种子基线噪声地板（σ≈0.0021，任何小于约 0.005 的收益都落在种子方差内，20 个方法中 8 个在此区间，仅报单种子数字会高估有效方法数，且在 19 个假设下 α=0.05 的族系假阳性率约 62%）；R6 对注意力输出类改造必须做下游评测（损失排序会漏掉 Sigmoid/SSMax 这类"低损失、低能力"失败）；R7 共享配方下的跨规模稳定性检验（1.2B 过 Bonferroni 并不足以保证 1–3B 可部署，HybridNorm 即为反例）。作者同时给出三条建议 R5–R7 以补充 Narang et al. 的四条原始建议。明确声明的局限包括：规模上限（发散方法在重调配方或更大规模/MoE 下可能稳定，如 HyperConnections 的 671B MoE、AttnRes 的大 MoE 设定），单一配方单一语料（对推荐不同配方或多语/代码数据的方法不利），噪声地板仅由 3 组校准（n=3 的 bootstrap 覆盖率不足，边缘方法判定可能翻转），仅 QK-Norm 与 Softpick 具备逐方法多种子证据，3B 噪声地板除发散案例外为单种子，因此 3B 结论仅限于效应符号与稳定性、不做精细名次推断；结论适用范围被限定为"1.2–3B、CLIMB-12、共享配方"。

Abstract: Narang et al. (2021) evaluated 40+ Transformer modifications at T5-base scale and concluded that most did not transfer. Five years later, the typical working regime has moved to 1-3B parameters, downstream evaluation has replaced pretraining perplexity, and a substantially different catalogue of modifications has emerged. We revisit their question by testing 20 post-2021 Transformer modifications at 1.2B and 3B under strict iso-data, iso-compute, iso-recipe control, with a multi-seed baseline noise floor and CLIMB-12 downstream evaluation as the primary metric. The central finding reproduces theirs at this curated set: most modifications do not transfer. Of the 20 modifications, only two clear Bonferroni correction at 1.2B; one of those two further fails to train stably at 3B under the shared recipe. We also find that the loss-downstream gap reported by Tay et al. (2023) enlarges several-fold for attention-output modifications: two significant failures converge to within 2-3% of baseline validation loss yet drop 6-16 CLIMB-points. We conclude that noise-floor reporting, downstream evaluation, and cross-scale stability testing are now prerequisites for architecture comparisons at 1-3B.

</details>


### [226] [DASH: Fast Differentiable Architecture Search for Hybrid Attention in Minutes on a Single GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20936)
*Weizhe Chen,Miao Zhang,Junpeng Jiang,Yaping Li,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DASH是一种快速的差异化搜索框架，用于混合注意力架构设计。它将离散的层级注意力算子分配松弛为连续的架构logits，并使用冻结模型权重的架构搜索，显著提升了搜索效率。仅需12.3M tokens（20分钟）即可超越200B tokens的Jet-Nemotron搜索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing hybrid attention architecture designs rely on manual empirical rules or proxy-based selector signals, which are suboptimal and time-consuming. While NAS-style systems like Jet-Nemotron show promise for automated search, their PostNAS stages alone consume 200B tokens, making such approaches impractical as routine design methods.

Method: DASH introduces three key innovations: (1) relaxes discrete layer-wise attention operator placement into continuous architecture logits for differentiable optimization; (2) prepares reusable teacher-aligned linear candidates; (3) performs architecture-only search with model and operator weights frozen to significantly enhance search efficiency. Each search run uses only 12.3M tokens and completes in ~20 minutes on a single RTX Pro 6000 GPU.

Result: On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, DASH consistently outperforms comprehensive baseline suites of selector-style hybrid attention designs. It achieves stronger RULER performance than released Jet-Nemotron models while remaining competitive on overlapping short-context and general benchmarks. Search efficiency is dramatic: only 0.006% of the tokens required by Jet-Nemotron's PostNAS stage.

Conclusion: High-quality hybrid attention architectures can be obtained through minutes-level differentiable search, providing a promising direction for hybrid architecture design.

Abstract: Hybrid attention architectures are becoming an increasingly important paradigm for improving LLM inference efficiency while preserving model quality, making hybrid architecture design a central problem. Existing designs often rely on manual empirical rules or proxy-based selector signals for layer-wise operator allocation. Recent NAS-style systems such as Jet-Nemotron demonstrate the promise of automated hybrid architecture search. However, Jet-Nemotron's PostNAS search stages alone use 200B tokens, making such search pipelines difficult to use as routine methods for hybrid architecture design. We introduce DASH, a fast differentiable search framework for hybrid attention architecture design, which relaxes discrete layer-wise attention operator placement into continuous architecture logits, prepares reusable teacher-aligned linear candidates, and performs architecture-only search with model and operator weights frozen to significantly enhance search efficiency. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, DASH consistently outperforms a comprehensive suite of existing selector-style hybrid attention design baselines, showing that direct differentiable search can discover stronger hybrid architectures. Moreover, DASH achieves stronger RULER performance than released Jet-Nemotron models while remaining competitive on overlapping short-context and general benchmarks. Notably, each DASH search run uses only 12.3M tokens and takes about 20 minutes on a single RTX Pro 6000 GPU, corresponding to merely 0.006% of the PostNAS search tokens reported by Jet-Nemotron. These results suggest that high-quality hybrid attention architectures can be obtained through minutes-level differentiable search, providing a promising direction for hybrid architecture design.

</details>


### [227] [The Devil is in the Condition Numbers: Why is GLU Better than non-GLU Structure?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20749)
*Xingyu Lyu,Qianqian Xu,Zhiyong Yang,Peisong Wen,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在神经正切核(NTK)极限下从谱条件数角度解释了门控线性单元(GLU)优于非门控结构的原因：门控使NTK矩阵近似为非门控NTK与数据Gram矩阵的Hadamard积 K̃ ≈ K ⊙ (XXᵀ/d)，从而把最大特征值从 O(mn) 压到 O(mn/d)、把最小特征值抬升，条件数由 O(n/d) 降为 O(n/d²)，谱分布更"收缩"、更对角占优，因而梯度下降收敛更快（并解释了GLU与ReLU训练曲线的"损失交叉"现象）；同时实证表明GLU几乎不缩小泛化差距，其真正收益在于加速优化而非提升泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GLU/ReGLU/GEGLU/SwiGLU已成为现代开源大模型FFN的标准组件（Llama 3、DeepSeek-V2、Qwen3、Kimi K2等），但其优越性的理论来源长期不明——Shazeer(2020)本人将其归因于"divine benevolence"，Zhong et al.(2025)也指出"门控只是遗忘机制"的直觉缺乏理论支撑。论文提出把总泛化误差分解为训练误差与泛化差距两项，从而把问题拆成两个可分别验证的子问题：GLU究竟改善了优化（训练误差收敛）还是改善了泛化（缩小训练-评估差距）？作者选择NTK核极限作为可解析的切入点，因为已有工作（de Ryck et al. 2024; Liu et al. 2025）已建立"NTK条件数 κ=λ_max/λ_min 决定梯度下降收敛速率（迭代数 O(κ log(1/ε))）"的桥梁，而GLU如何改变NTK谱此前无人分析。

Method: 以两层网络（非门控 z(x)=Vφ(Wx) 与 GLU z(x)=V[(Px)⊙φ(Wx)]，LeCun 初始化）为最小分析单元，分三部分推进。(1) 谱分析：利用arc-cosine kernel与一阶Taylor展开得到 K=αXXᵀ+βrrᵀ+γD 与 K̃=α̃(XXᵀ)⊙(XXᵀ)+β̃(rrᵀ)⊙(XXᵀ)+γ̃D²，进而得到核心结构 K̃ ≈ K ⊙ (XXᵀ/d)；用随机矩阵工具分析极端特征值：Wishart矩阵的Marchenko-Pastur分布、自Hadamard积核随机矩阵的线性化（El Karoui 2010；Pandit et al. 2024）、BBP相变与Cauchy变换（求ReLU侧λ₁）、Weyl不等式、Gershgorin/行和界（求GLU侧λ₁）、Schur积定理与秩-1更新（Horn & Johnson 4.3.9）求λ_min。(2) 训练动力学：核极限下梯度下降解耦为逐特征方向衰减 (1-ηλ_i)，用E[L_k] ∝ Tr[(I-ηK)^{2k}K] + Yᵀ(I-ηK)^{2k}Y 展开早期（kη小，Tr(K-K̃)<0、Tr(K²-K̃²)>0）与后期（λ_min主导）行为，导出"损失交叉"结论；并从模型梯度夹角角度给出直觉解释 cos φ̃_ij = cos φ_ij · cos α_ij。(3) 实验验证：理论与数值NTK条件数/极端特征值对比；ViT、GPT-2 的FFN替换为GLU后条件数下降；两层MLP在Gaussian/MNIST上画损失曲线（含不同学习率）；泛化差距分析用MLP Mixer/ViT/GPT-2，在(L_S, L_D−L_S)平面上对比并做基于Energy Distance的双样本置换检验。

Result: 理论：GLU的NTK满足 K̃ ≈ K ⊙ (XXᵀ/d)（Hadamard乘数据Gram矩阵）；Thm 3.1（在n>d+1的高斯输入下）给出 λmax(K)=O(mn/d) vs λmax(K̃)=O(mn/d²)，两者λ_min均为O(m)且λ_min(K̃)≥λ_min(K)，故 κ(K)=O(n/d) 而 κ(K̃)=O(n/d²)（附录Prop B.6/B.9另给显式近似：λ₁(K)≈(m/2π)n+d/2+(π−1)m/2π，λ₁(K̃)≈(m/4d+1/2)n+…，与数值高度吻合）；GLU显著提升NTK对角占优性，等价于增大样本间模型梯度夹角。动力学：早期阶段ReLU因λ_max更大而收敛更快，后期λ_min主导时ReGLU反超，形成"损失交叉"（Cor 4.2，条件d≥5、n≥300）；学习率增大时交叉现象减弱，与逐方向衰减公式一致。实证：ViT/GPT-2的FFN换成GLU后NTK条件数下降；ReLU/ReGLU、GELU/GEGLU、SiLU/SwiGLU 在Gaussian与MNIST上均复现损失交叉。泛化差距：GLU与非GLU在(L_S, L_D−L_S)平面上分布高度重叠，Energy Distance置换检验p≥0.05无显著差异；而SGD→AdamW带来的泛化差距下降幅度明显大于GLU有无的影响；GPT-2在FineWeb-Edu上同样未见GLU降低泛化差距。

Conclusion: GLU的优势主要来自优化加速而非泛化能力提升：门控通过Hadamard重加权把NTK谱"收缩"（λ_max变小、λ_min变大、条件数降低、谱更对角占优、样本梯度更可分），从而在核极限下加速训练，并解释了分阶段收敛与损失交叉现象；同等训练误差下GLU并不缩小泛化差距（优化器选择的影响更大），但因训练更快最终得到更低的总体泛化误差。作者指出本文结论限于NTK/核极限与两层模型，更一般训练/特征学习区间中乘法门控如何影响训练与学习行为仍是开放问题；此外正文Thm 3.1的λ_max标度与附录Prop B.6的Θ(mn)、Θ(mn/d)存在量级不一致，值得进一步核对。

Abstract: Gated Linear Units (GLU) and their variants are widely adopted in modern open-source large language model architectures and consistently outperform their non-gated counterparts, yet the underlying reasons for this advantage remain unclear. In this work, we study GLU by analyzing two-layer networks in the neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime. Our analysis reveals that the GLU structure reshapes the NTK spectrum, leading to a smaller condition number and a more compact eigenvalue distribution. Building on this finding, we further analyze the resulting training dynamics and show how the reshaped spectrum leads to faster convergence of GLU models, including a characteristic loss-crossing phenomenon observed between GLU and non-GLU models. Finally, we empirically observe that GLU has limited impact in reducing the generalization gap on various models, including ViT and GPT-2, suggesting that its primary benefit lies in accelerating optimization rather than reducing the generalization gap.

</details>


### [228] [PACD-Net: Pseudo-Augmented Contrastive Distillation for Glycemic Control Estimation from SMBG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20751)
*Canyu Lei,David Repaske,Jianxin Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PACD-Net——一种自监督的「伪增强对比蒸馏」框架，用于从稀疏、不规则的自测血糖（SMBG）数据中估计血糖控制指标（TIR/TAR/TBR）。核心做法：用采样率更高的伪 SMBG 作为教师视图，通过自蒸馏向低采样率的学生视图传递知识；同时在学生空间内施加多视图对比学习以获得采样不变表示；骨干网络为改造的 Swin Transformer（加入卷积残差分支 CRB，即 Swin-CRB）。在 REPLACE-BG 的 repbg 队列上，PACD-Net 的整体 RMSE 为 0.053±0.003、R² 为 0.677±0.025，优于监督式 SOTA 方法 DPA-Net（RMSE 0.061±0.011，R² 0.615±0.074）与朴素计数基线（RMSE 0.099）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床上血糖控制主要用 CGM 派生的时间在范围指标（TIR/TAR/TBR）评估，但 CGM 价格高、可及性有限、佩戴困难，在低中收入国家大多依赖指尖采血的 SMBG。SMBG 每天仅测量少数几次，天然稀疏、不规则、个体间异质，朴素计数或插值会系统性低估 TIR、高估 TAR/TBR（观察窗越短、采样越稀偏倚越大）。已有的监督深度学习方法（如 DPA-Net）在极稀疏条件下训练不稳定、易过拟合到训练集特定的采样模式，泛化性差。因此需要一种在极少观测下仍能稳定估计 TR 指标、并对采样模式不敏感的表示学习框架，尤其面向 CGM 不可及地区的实际临床需求。

Method: 问题定义：由 CGM（5 分钟间隔，288 点/天）按阈值 70/180 mg/dL 计算 D 天窗口的 TR 真值，模型需从稀疏 SMBG 矩阵（缺失补零）回归 TR。输入表示三通道拼接：SMBG 数值矩阵 M_s、二值缺失掩码 M_m、日内/日间二维正弦位置编码 M_p（Θ∈R^{3×D×T}）。多视图生成器 G(·;α,S) 从 CGM 轨迹采样产生教师视图（随机采样，观测比 α_T）与学生视图（随机+主动点选择 APS，观测比 α_S<α_T），教师/学生共享 Swin-CRB 编码器（卷积 patch embedding + 层级 W-MSA/SW-MSA，每个注意力块并行接入卷积残差分支 CRB + LayerNorm + MLP + 残差），并接共享投影头。知识蒸馏采用 BYOL/DINO 式自蒸馏：教师由学生参数的 EMA 更新且不接受梯度监督，教师输出经中心化（EMA 中心向量）与温度 τ_T 锐化为软目标，学生以温度 τ_S 分布对齐，KD 损失为师生分布间交叉熵。多视图对比学习仅在学生嵌入空间进行，以同一 CGM 样本的不同学生视图为正对、批内其他样本为负对，用 InfoNCE 形式。总损失 L = λ_sup·L_sup（TR 回归 MSE）+ λ_KD·L_KD + λ_CL·L_CL。训练数据：Jaeb 公开数据中 REPLACE-BG 的 repbg 队列提供真实配对 CGM-SMBG，其余 CGM 数据集合成 SMBG 训练，repbg 保留部分作验证，患者级严格隔离。

Result: （1）教师采样率消融：固定 α_S=3%，α_T 从 10%→30%→50% 性能持续改善（RMSE 0.0589→0.0555→0.0533，R² 0.6237→0.6518→0.6771），α_T=70% 反而退化（RMSE 0.0599），说明教师需足够信息但与学生的信息差过大时对齐正则失效，默认取 50%。（2）视图数组合：2 个教师 + 4 个学生（V0）最优；教师过少（1）信号不足、过多（3）目标冗余相关；学生过少（2）缺乏采样多样性、过多（6）对齐优化负担加重。（3）消融：CNN+监督 RMSE 0.084/R² 0.456 → Swin-CRB+监督 0.068/0.539 → +KD 0.061/0.594 → 完整 PACD-Net 0.053/0.677；散点图显示逐级消除 TAR 高估、TIR 低估的系统性偏倚，预测点沿对角线更紧凑。（4）与 SOTA 比较：PACD-Net 整体 RMSE 0.053±0.003、R² 0.677±0.025、TAR/TIR/TBR MAE 0.050/0.047/0.016，显著优于 DPA-Net（0.061±0.011、0.615±0.074）与 No-Interp 基线（0.099、0.099），且标准差更小，稳定性与泛化性更好。

Conclusion: PACD-Net 通过「伪增强视图 + 自蒸馏 + 多视图对比」的组合，把同一 CGM 轨迹下不同采样模式视为同一潜在血糖状态的多种视图，从而在极稀疏 SMBG 条件下学到采样不变、稳定的表示，配合 Swin-CRB 骨干有效建模日内/日间长程与局部依赖，可靠地从稀疏 SMBG 估计 TIR/TAR/TBR，为 CGM 不可及地区提供低成本的血糖控制评估工具。局限方面，训练仍依赖配对 CGM-SMBG（多数数据集需合成采样），验证集规模受 repbg 队列限制；此外该框架的通用性尚需在更多稀疏不规则传感数据上检验。展望包括纳入真实多中心 SMBG-CGM 配对数据、扩展至连续血糖趋势/变异性的预测以及个体化采样策略建模。

Abstract: Effective diabetes management requires continuous monitoring of glycemic levels. Clinically, glycemic control is assessed using metrics such as Time in Range (TIR), Time Below Range (TBR), and Time Above Range (TAR), typically derived from continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). However, many patients rely on self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) due to the high cost and limited accessibility of CGM. Unlike CGM, SMBG provides sparse and irregular measurements, making accurate estimation of these metrics challenging. Conventional supervised learning approaches struggle under such sparsity, leading to poor generalization and unstable performance. To address this, we propose PACD-Net, a self-supervised contrastive knowledge distillation framework for estimating glycemic control from SMBG. Pseudo-SMBG samples with richer temporal coverage are used as teacher signals to guide learning from sparse observations. In addition, multi-view contrastive learning enforces representation consistency across diverse sampling patterns. The model adopts a hybrid Swin Transformer-CNN backbone to capture temporal dependencies in sparse SMBG sequences. Experimental results demonstrate that PACD-Net consistently outperforms existing methods in estimating TAR, TIR, and TBR from real-world SMBG data, achieving improved accuracy as well as enhanced stability and generalization under extremely sparse observation settings. The proposed framework provides a practical tool for clinical SMBG interpretation and offers a generalizable approach for learning from sparse and irregularly sampled sensor data in broader applications.

</details>


### [229] [SMoA: Spectrum Modulation Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21147)
*Yongkang Liu,Xing Li,Mengjie Zhao,Shanru Zhang,Zijing Wang,Qian Li,Shi Feng,Feiliang Ren,Daling Wang,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMoA（Spectrum Modulation Adapter）是一种面向参数高效微调（PEFT）的新方法：它按预训练权重的奇异值谱把输入/输出维度重排为 K 个对齐的谱块，在每个对角块上挂一条经 Hadamard 乘积调制的局部低秩分支（局部秩 ρ = r/K），合并成全局块对角残差更新。其可训练参数量仅为 rank-r LoRA 的 1/K，却具备严格更高的秩上限（U > r），并在 Llama-2-7B/Llama-3-8B 的常识推理、对话生成与数学推理任务上取得更优的平均性能与更高的实测更新秩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 用低秩更新模拟全参数微调，参数开销小、无推理延迟，但受限于表示能力：梯度流理论（Rushka & Klabjan）表明 rank-r LoRA 收敛到预训练权重矩阵的前 r 个奇异值的最优截断 SVD 解，残差由 r 之后的奇异值尾部决定；而随机矩阵分析表明 Transformer 权重谱呈长尾、数值上接近满秩，尾部方向仍携带与激活协方差结构高度对齐的任务相关信号（超出 3σ）。因此单一全局低秩分支会系统性低估化谱尾方向。提高秩能覆盖更多主奇异方向但带来更高参数与计算开销，形成"秩—预算"两难。已有方法（ReLoRA、COLA、MELoRA、HiRA、DoRA、MoRA 等）虽通过堆叠/组合/调制扩大更新族，但未显式围绕预训练算子的谱结构组织适配，难以在小预算下捕获有信息的尾部方向。

Method: **谱感知预处理**：对冻结权重 W₀ 做一次 SVD（O(d_out·d_in·q) 代价），仅用其奇异结构一次性定义输出/输入置换 π_out、π_in，把坐标重排为 K 个谱对齐的连续分组，得 W̃₀ = P_out W₀ P_inᵀ（层计算等价，不引入可训练参数、不在推理路径上）。**块锚点**：取重排后矩阵的第 k 个对角块 M_k = W̃₀[O_k, I_k] ∈ R^(d_out/K × d_in/K) 作为固定的局部谱锚点（不参与训练）。**适配更新**：设参考 LoRA 全局秩预算为 r，局部秩 ρ = r/K，每块引入可训练低秩因子 A_k ∈ R^(ρ×d_in/K)、B_k ∈ R^(d_out/K×ρ)，定义 ΔM_k = (B_k A_k) ⊙ M_k（低秩因子与块锚点的 Hadamard 逐元素调制），拼成块对角 ΔW̃ = blkdiag(ΔM₁,…,ΔM_K)，再映射回原坐标 ΔW = P_outᵀ ΔW̃ P_in，W = W₀ + ΔW。推理时可合并回基座权重，无额外延迟。

**理论分析**：①参数复杂度 P_SMoA = (r/K)(d_in+d_out)，为 rank-r LoRA 的 1/K。②命题1（谱感知秩上限）：利用 Hadamard 积秩不等式 rank(A⊙B) ≤ rank(A)·rank(B)，得每块 rank(ΔM_k) ≤ min(s_k, ρ·rank(M_k))，整体 rank(ΔW) ≤ U := Σ_k min(s_k, ρ rank(M_k)) ≤ min(d_out,d_in)；推论1表明在各块近满秩且 K、r < min(d_out,d_in) 时 U_nf > r，严格大于 rank-r LoRA 的秩上限 r。③命题2（表达族分离）：构造块对齐的调制目标 ΔW̃* = blkdiag(C_k⊙M_k)（rank(C_k) ≤ ρ），当其秩 > r 时可被 SMoA 精确表示但不属于 LoRA(r) 族；推论2用 Eckart–Young–Mirsky 定理证明 rank-r LoRA 在该族上存在不可消除的谱尾逼近误差 Σ_{j>r} σ_j² > 0，而 SMoA 误差为 0。作者同时指出该优势是结构性的：块对角偏置在强跨块交互的残差上可能成为限制。

**实验设置**：Llama-2-7B 与 Llama-3-8B，插入 Q/K/V/O 投影层；任务为 8 个常识推理基准（BoolQ、PIQA、SIQA、ARC-c/e、OBQA、HellaSwag、WinoGrande）、ConvAI2 对话生成（BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE-L/BERTScore）与 GSM8K 数学推理（MetaMath 训练）；对比 Prompt Tuning、P-Tuning v2、LoRA、DoRA、MoRA、SSMLoRA、MeLoRA、HiRA；默认 r=16/32、K=2，ρ=r/K；AdamW、lr=1e-3、warmup 1000 步、5 epoch、每 100 步评测取最优验证检查点，SMoA 结果取 5 个随机种子均值，H800-80GB。

Result: **常识推理**：两个骨干上 SMoA（r=32, K=2）平均准确率最高；Llama-2-7B 达 81.85%（HiRA r=32 为 81.42%、MeLoRA 为 79.93%），Llama-3-8B 达 87.39%（HiRA 86.73%、DoRA 85.20%）。更小预算下 r=16, K=2 在 Llama-2-7B 达 80.10%，Llama-3-8B 达 86.04%，参数量远少于多数 rank-32 方法。**对话生成**：ConvAI2 上 SMoA（r=32, K=2）平均分最高，Llama-2-7B 为 48.06%、Llama-3-8B 为 48.42%，BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE-L 均优于 LoRA 及 DoRA/MoRA/SSMLoRA，相对 HiRA/MeLoRA 在 BLEU、METEOR 上更优。**数学推理**：GSM8K（Llama-3-8B）SMoA 达 72.33%，明显高于 LoRA 65.89%、DoRA 66.12%、MoRA 67.89%；r=16 时仍有 68.55%。**谱结构分析**：微调后谱在 Marchenko–Pastur 主体之外出现显著右尾成分，且重叠度 O_k 的峰值集中在中间与尾部区域，说明 SMoA 选择性激活被低估的尾方向并与任务激活结构对齐；逐层可视化显示该现象系统存在，浅层变化弱、深层定位更强。**尾部消融**：分别去除 Q、K、V 的尾部谱分量均导致性能下降，三者联合去除时平均准确率从 81.85% 降至 79.56%，说明尾部谱含任务自适应信息且在不同投影间互补。**秩分析**：SMoA 的 ΔW 实测秩在所有 r 下均显著高于 HiRA、LoRA、MoRA、MeLoRA，并随 r 增大而快速上升。**秩/块配置扫描**：r 从 2 增至 32 时平均准确率从 83.49% 升至 87.35%（SIQA 提升 5.26%）；(r,K)=(2,8) 以极少参数达 85.87%，最优 K 依任务而异（ARC-e/HellaSwag 偏好 K=2，部分任务偏好 K=4/8）。作者说明该比较为"次预算"比较而非等参数量比较，且为单次运行（SMoA 有 5 种子方差），小幅差距应谨慎解读。

Conclusion: SMoA 通过把预训练算子划分为多个谱对齐块并在各对角块上施加 Hadamard 调制低秩分支，在更小的可训练参数预算（rank-r LoRA 的 1/K）下扩大了"谱感知"更新族的可达范围：理论证明其秩上限严格大于 rank-r LoRA，并在块对齐调制目标族上给出单向结构分离与谱逼近间隙（LoRA 误差 Σ_{j>r}σ_j²，SMoA 误差为 0），与 LoRA 秩理论直接衔接。实验表明在低预算设定下，SMoA 在常识推理、对话生成与数学推理上取得更强的平均性能与更高的实测更新秩，且尾部谱消融证实其有效性源于对被忽视的谱尾方向的利用。局限包括：需要一次性离线谱预处理（每层 SVD、O(d_out d_in q) 代价）并存储置换与块锚点，超大模型或多检查点场景成本不可忽略；块对角结构偏置在强跨块交互的残差上可能成为限制；最优 (r,K) 需按数据集调参，且未做等参数量的对照比较。

Abstract: As the number of model parameters increases, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become the go-to choice for tailoring pre-trained large language models. Low-rank Adaptation (LoRA) uses a low-rank update method to simulate full parameter fine-tuning, which is widely used to reduce resource requirements. However, decreasing the rank encounters challenges with limited representational capacity. Theory suggests that LoRA fine-tuning with rank r converges toward the top r singular values of the pre-trained weight matrix. As the rank increases, more principal singular directions are preserved, which generally improves the model's performance. However, a larger rank also introduces more trainable parameters, leading to higher computational cost. To overcome this dilemma, we propose SMoA, a \textbf{S}pectrum \textbf{Mo}dulation \textbf{A}dapter that enlarges the accessible family of spectrum-aware updates under a smaller parameter budget. SMoA partitions the layer into multiple aligned spectral blocks and applies one in-block Hadamard-modulated low-rank branch to each diagonal block, yielding broader coverage of pretrained spectral directions. We provide theoretical analysis and empirical results on multiple tasks. In our experiments, SMoA improves average performance in the current lower-budget setting over LoRA and competitive LoRA-style baselines.

</details>


### [230] [Correcting Stochastic Update Bias in Preconditioned Language Model Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20756)
*Nikhil Nayak,Julia White,Urchade Zaratiana,Kelton Zhang,Henrijs Princis,Dhruv Atreja,Henry Fawcett,Matthew Thomas,George Hurn-Maloney,Ash Lewis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文识别了语言模型预训练中预条件优化器的两类有限样本偏差，并提出统一的双偏差校正框架，通过交叉拟合预条件估计和方差校正求逆，在多种优化器(AdamW、Sophia、Shampoo)上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预条件优化器是语言模型训练的核心，但现有研究将随机更新规则视为对总体预条件下降的直接近似，忽视了两个关键的有限样本偏差来源，导致优化器更新存在系统性偏差。

Method: 提出单批次偏差校正框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 交叉拟合预条件估计——将小批次分为独立微批次组分别估计梯度和预条件器，消除梯度-预条件器耦合偏差；(2) 方差校正求逆——利用微批次变异性减去Delta方法的主要偏差项，校正非线性求逆带来的偏差。该框架可应用于对角矩估计、对角曲率估计和矩阵预条件方法。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-0.5B上，偏差校正分别降低AdamW、Sophia、Shampoo的保留集预训练损失0.15、0.07、0.11 nats；混合质量预训练和下游指令微调任务上效果一致为中性至正向。

Conclusion: 偏差校正是一个实用且有效的机制，可减少有限样本更新偏差并提升预条件优化器性能，为优化器设计提供了理论基础和实践指导。

Abstract: Preconditioned optimizers are central to language model training, but their stochastic update rules are usually treated as direct approximations to population preconditioned descent. We show that this view misses two finite-sample biases. First, the gradient and preconditioner are typically estimated from the same minibatch, introducing gradient--preconditioner coupling bias. Second, even when the preconditioner estimate is unbiased, its inverse or inverse-root is generally biased because inversion is nonlinear. We propose a single-batch bias-correction framework that addresses both effects: cross-fitted preconditioning estimates the numerator and preconditioner from independent microbatch groups, while variance-corrected inversion uses microbatch variability to subtract the leading delta-method bias term. The framework applies to diagonal moment, diagonal curvature, and matrix preconditioning methods, instantiated in AdamW, Sophia, and Shampoo. Bias correction reduces held-out pretraining loss on Qwen2.5-0.5B by $0.15$, $0.07$, and $0.11$ nats, respectively; the effects on mixed-quality pretraining and downstream instruction tuning are consistently neutral-to-positive. Together, these results establish bias correction as a practical mechanism for reducing finite-sample update bias and improving the performance of preconditioned optimizers.

</details>


### [231] [ChunkFT: Byte-Streamed Optimization for Memory-Efficient Full Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21177)
*Yongkang Liu,Zijing Wang,Mengjie Zhao,Ercong Nie,Mingyang Wang,Qian Li,Feiliang Ren,Shi Feng,Daling Wang,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ChunkFT 将大模型全参数微调重构为"按字节预算分块 + 轮转激活"的工作集优化：把参数切成 K 个字节均衡的 chunk，每步只对其中一个 chunk 做前向/反向与 AdamW 更新，其余 chunk 的梯度缓冲与优化器状态（fp32 主权重、一阶/二阶矩）常驻 CPU 并异步预取/换出，从而在任意子张量层面实现梯度计算而无需改动网络结构。该方法在显存占用、运行时间与内存抖动上均优于 BAdam/HiFT/GaLore/APOLLO 等显存高效基线，并在 SuperGLUE、数学推理与 MT-Bench 上稳定超过这些基线，某些情况下甚至优于标准全参数微调（Adam）：Llama 3-8B 全参微调仅需 13.72GB 显存，Llama 3-70B 可在 2×H800-80GB 上完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全参数微调（FFT）效果好，但其显存开销随模型规模急剧膨胀（混合精度 AdamW 需约 18M 字节，7B 模型即超百 GB），严重限制了资源受限场景的可及性。PEFT（如 LoRA）虽省显存，但在复杂推理与鲁棒性上存在与 FFT 的差距。已有的显存高效全参微调（MEFT）分两类：一是优化器类（LOMO、APOLLO、GaLore、压缩优化器状态），只优化梯度与优化器状态而未解决激活存储，节省有限；二是反向传播调度类（BAdam、HiFT），采用层级分区、轮流更新参数以降低激活/梯度/优化器状态显存，但存在两大缺陷：(1) 嵌入层、注意力层、MLP 块参数规模差异大，导致可变状态占用随层波动，形成不稳定的显存峰值（memory jitter）；(2) 反向传播仍需穿过未激活的层并丢弃其梯度，造成大量无效计算。此外，这些方法将更新粒度绑定在"层"这一架构单位上。作者希望得到一种方法：能以比层更细的粒度、依据真实字节级训练成本来划分参数；只在活动支撑集上materialize梯度；并使优化器驻留、状态放置与激活重算与该支撑集同步，从而在节省显存的同时获得稳定的时间维度显存曲线。

Method: ChunkFT 的核心是"字节流式（byte-streamed）轮转块优化"：

1. **分块**：为每个参数张量估算字节级训练成本 B(θ_l)（含参数存储、梯度缓冲、fp32 主权重、优化器状态），按模型顺序累加直到达到预设字节预算即切分；超大矩阵沿行维切分，可跨 chunk。由此得到 K 个字节均衡的 chunk（K 远大于层数 L），避免层间尺寸差异造成的显存抖动。

2. **chunk 局部训练算子**：为 Embedding、Linear、LayerNorm/RMSNorm 等显存主导模块实现 chunk-aware backward，仅为活动参数切片分配梯度缓冲并把梯度流限制在活动子张量上，无需修改原网络结构；非活动 chunk 不分配梯度缓冲。

3. **轮转调度**：给定更新间隔 T，同一 chunk 连续优化 T 步后切换到下一个（round-robin）。前向仍使用完整模型 y=f(x;θ)，训练目标与标准 FFT 完全一致；反向只计算 g^(k)=∇_{θ^(k)}L 并对该 chunk 做 AdamW 更新（含 bias correction，每个 chunk 维护独立的更新计数 n^(k)），更新后清空临时梯度缓冲。

4. **CPU 卸载与异步预取**：fp32 主权重与 AdamW 一阶/二阶矩存放于 CPU，chunk 激活时异步加载到 GPU，更新完毕异步换出并释放 GPU 缓冲区，与计算重叠以隐藏传输开销。

5. **理论**：在确定性设定下给出块坐标下降式的收敛分析——假设损失 L-光滑（分块 L_i-光滑）与偏导有界（‖g‖≤G），学习率 0<η≤1/L̄ 时，活动 chunk 梯度平方均值为 O(1/(TH))；进一步在完整轮转上给出 O(K/(ηTH)) + O(K³H²η²)，取 η=O(1/(K^{2/3}H T^{1/3})) 得 O(K^{5/3}/T^{2/3})，故固定 K、H 下收敛到一阶稳定点。文中还说明 AdamW 可视为分块预条件版本（预条件子有界正定即可套用同样证明），CPU 卸载不改变优化轨迹，并给出随机梯度的期望形式推广。

6. **复杂度分析**：显存 2M + 16M/K；反向梯度生成开销每个全参周期约为 1× 稠密反向（因 chunk 是参数空间的互斥划分），而 BAdam/HiFT 因需回传后缀子图约为 (K+1)/2×。

7. **实验**：基于 Transformers 实现，基线包括 Adam、LOMO、LoRA、GaLore、HiFT、BAdam、APOLLO；骨干模型为 Llama 2-7B、Llama 3-8B、Llama 3-70B、RoBERTa-large；评测涵盖 SuperGLUE 七个 NLU 任务、六个数学推理基准（GSM8K、AQuA、MMLU-Math、SAT-Math、MATH、NumGLUE）与 MT-Bench；结果为 5 个随机种子（7/42/123/1234/12345）平均并报告标准差；启用梯度 checkpointing、未用 DeepSpeed；峰值显存用 torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() 测量。

Result: **显存**：Llama 2-7B 在 BoolQ（序列长 1024、开启梯度 checkpointing）上，ChunkFT 是所有全参微调方法中显存最低者，且接近 LoRA 水平；FP32、batch=1 时仅 13.72GB，与 LoRA 相当，并可支持到 batch=32（BAdam/HiFT 此时 OOM）；在 24GB 卡上可支持 batch=8，优于 GaLore/BAdam/HiFT/APOLLO。**显存抖动**：ChunkFT 显存区间 26.34–26.71GB，jitter=0.01（与 LoRA/GaLore/APOLLO 同级，但绝对占用低得多），峰值显存较 GaLore 降 61.35%、较 APOLLO 降 50.18%；BAdam jitter=0.44（37.59→58.90GB）、HiFT jitter=0.46（34.53→54.91GB）。**速度**：batch=8 时 ChunkFT 4855s/epoch，优于 BAdam（5690s）与 HiFT（6501s）；batch=32 时 5150s，优于 GaLore（5310s）与 APOLLO（5232s），与 LoRA 仍有差距（LoRA 更新参数少）。**下游质量**：RoBERTa-large SuperGLUE 平均 77.6（最佳，Adam 74.9，BoolQ 88.5/COPA 73.6/WiC 73.5 单项最佳）；Llama 2-7B SuperGLUE 平均 84.9（最佳，Adam/HiFT 83.6，+1.3）；Llama 3-8B 数学基准平均 47.7（最佳，APOLLO 46.6、HiFT 44.9、BAdam 44.4、Adam 44.1，6 项中 5 项最佳或并列最佳）；Llama 3-70B 数学基准平均 63.7（最佳，BAdam 62.0、APOLLO 61.6、LoRA 59.0）；MT-Bench 上 Llama 2-7B 得分 5.6（Adam 5.3）、Llama 3-8B 得分 6.8（较 Adam +0.5、LoRA +0.6、APOLLO +0.2），均为最佳。**消融**：六项 NLU 任务损失曲线稳定下降；T 取值不改变最终收敛趋势，T 较小因频繁切换而早期下降变慢；增大 K 显著降低显存，K 达到中等规模后收益递减；BoolQ 精度随 K 变化波动小于 1 个百分点，显存大幅下降而质量基本不变。

Conclusion: ChunkFT 证明：全参数微调的显存瓶颈可以通过"按字节预算而非层级身份划分参数、在梯度materialize之前就施加稀疏性、并让优化器驻留/状态放置/激活与活动支撑集保持同步"这一组合来系统性地解决。相比 BAdam/HiFT，其关键差异在于稀疏化的时机——前者是"先生成（或近稠密生成）梯度再丢弃"，ChunkFT 则是"先选块再生成梯度"，因此在保持全参数可训练性、动量与二阶矩、优化器状态连续性与梯度累积的同时，反向开销维持在与稠密 FFT 相当的水平，并因字节均衡分块而消除了层式方法的显存抖动。总体而言，该框架在显存、速度与优化质量三者间取得了优于现有 MEFT 基线的权衡，并在多项下游任务上达到甚至超过标准全参微调的水平。其局限在于：需要为 Embedding/Linear/LayerNorm/RMSNorm 等实现 chunk-aware 反向算子，定制化算子的架构需额外工作；优化器状态与 fp32 主权重默认置于 CPU，运行时效率受主机-设备互联带宽、CPU 内存带宽及异步预取效果制约，在资源受限环境中通信开销可能部分抵消时间收益。

Abstract: This work presents \textsc{ChunkFT}, a memory-efficient fine-tuning framework that reformulates full-parameter fine-tuning around a dynamically activated working set. \textsc{ChunkFT} enables gradient computation for arbitrary sub-tensors without modifying the network architecture, providing an algorithmic foundation for optimizing arbitrary sub-networks while avoiding standard dense gradient computation. We provide a theoretical convergence analysis of \textsc{ChunkFT} in the deterministic setting. Empirically, we apply \textsc{ChunkFT} to fine-tune Llama 3-8B and Llama 3-70B using a single RTX 4090-24GB GPU and 2$\times$ H800-80GB GPUs, respectively. Full-parameter fine-tuning of a 7B model with a 1K input length requires only 13.72GB of GPU memory. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of \textsc{ChunkFT} in memory usage, running time, and optimization quality. Moreover, downstream evaluations on language understanding, mathematical reasoning, and MT-Bench show that \textsc{ChunkFT} consistently outperforms existing memory-efficient baselines. Notably, \textsc{ChunkFT} achieves performance comparable to, and in some cases exceeding, full-parameter fine-tuning. Our repository is on https://github.com/misonsky/chunk.

</details>


### [232] [ShapeBench: A Scalable Benchmark and Diagnostic Suite for Standardized Evaluation in Aerodynamic Shape Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20763)
*Shaghayegh Fazliani,Krissh Chawla,Jack Guo,Yiren Shen,Matthias Ihme,Madeleine Udell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShapeBench 是一个面向气动外形优化（ASO）的开源标准化基准与诊断套件，包含跨8类外形（2D翼型、3D三角翼、翼身融合、跨声速后掠翼、乘员车、CCA无人机、CERAS、STA超声速运输机）的103个任务，统一 Python API、统一预算度量，并为每个任务配对经验证的快速代理模型与（尽可能）高保真 CFD 验证管线。基准同时提供经典优化器（伴随梯度 IPOPT、L-BFGS-B、贝叶斯优化、PSO、CMA-ES）、通用 LLM 优化器（OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve）以及新提出的 ASO 专用 LLM 进化方法 ShapeEvolve，并配套三级确定性检查 + LLM 评判的诊断套件，用于识别"高奖励但不可信"的设计与代理模型利用（surrogate exploitation）。核心实证结论：优化器排名在不同外形类别与目标形式之间几乎不相关（平均成对 Spearman ρ ≈ 0.013），排名还随预算演化而变，单任务结论不可外推；基准远未饱和，经典方法难以覆盖全部任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气动外形优化（ASO）方法进展迅速，但现有评测体系严重滞后：既有基准普遍狭窄（多为二维、单一几何/单一工况）、缺乏跨外形类别的多样性，难以支撑公平的跨方法比较；ADODG 类算例强于梯度/伴随优化但限于少数经典几何的CFD在环，AFBench 聚焦大规模翼型生成，EngiBench 仅含有限翼型任务，三者均不能同时提供 (i) 多几何族任务、(ii) 代理到 CFD 的保真度核查、(iii) 匹配预算的横向对比、(iv) 有效性与可物理信度诊断。
此外，代理模型（surrogate）作为 ASO 的必要前提带来三类风险：近似误差与由此产生的优化器偏差、优化器钻代理模型空子（把设计推到训练分布边缘/低置信区，产生不稳定或不可信的预测）、以及代理模型各自为政的接口/数据/输出格式造成的碎片化集成开销。
第三，针对"LLM 驱动的优化框架在 ASO 中究竟表现如何"的证据缺失：若缺少在同一协议、同一算力预算下经充分调参的领域专用 LLM 参考基线，关于 LLM 优势或缺陷的论断无法解读。

Method: **基准构建（ShapeBench）**
- 统一 API 与元数据：暴露变量类型/边界、工况、目标与约束的结构化元数据；任务实现、代理权重、评测设置均版本化，每次运行记录完整解析后的配置文件，支持插件式扩展任务而保持可比性；提供设计级与运行级可视化（几何/流场图、收敛轨迹）。
- 8 类外形 / 103 个任务：Delta Wing（VortexNet，3D，2 个平面形变量+固定根弦）、BWB（BlendedNet，9 变量）、2D 翼型（NeuralFoil，18 个 Kulfan/CST 变量）、跨声速后掠翼（SuperWing，38 变量）、乘员车（DrivAerStar + Transolver，20 个 FFD 形变变量）、CCA（本文新构建 COCOANet，16 变量）、CERAS 与 STA（混合变量概念设计，经 FAST-OAD 评测）。任务覆盖单/多目标、单点/多点任务、连续与混合变量设计空间。
- 代理-高保真配对：每个任务提供经验证的快速代理（VortexNet 多保真 GNN；BlendedNet 的 PointNet 几何反演 + FiLM 条件化场预测；NeuralFoil；SuperWing 的 U-Net/ViT/Transolver；CERASNet 四层 MLP；STANet；COCOANet），可行时提供高保真 CFD 管线（SU2、FUN3D、Flow360、XFOIL、STAR-CCM+ 等）用于最终复核与保真度间隙分析。
- **COCOANet（本文新工作）**：基于 Transolver 物理注意力神经算子，在公开的 3,570 例高保真 CFD（401 个 CCA 几何 × 最多 10 工况）上训练，公开数据集与预训练权重；相对直接 CFD 约 1,600× 加速；Cp 相对 L1 误差 14.08%。
- **诊断套件（Diagnostic Suite）**：与优化目标解耦的"有效性"评估，分三阶段——确定性检查（① 优化可行性：参数/指标齐备、边界合规、模型工件存在、归一化兼容性；② 几何有效性：近边界集中度（边界塌缩风险）、角度应力和 Σ|θ_j|、全局尺度-宽长耦合；③ 气动合理性：力/力矩闭合、C_L/C_D/C_M 量级合理性、多点趋势一致性、场量合理性、任务专属检查如配平/稳定性、翼类诱导阻力一致性），输出逐项状态、∈[0,1] 严重度与证据引用；随后由 LLM 整合判定器结合设计图与流场图生成 schema 校验的结构化诊断报告（失败机制、次生风险、缓解建议、后续测试）。
- **优化器与评测协议**：8 种优化器共享同一接口与同一预算度量（评估次数），并给出每千次评估的算力成本统计；包含伴随梯度 IPOPT（CasADi 自动微分贯通 Kulfan/CST→NeuralFoil→目标）、L-BFGS-B（3 点有限差分、3 次重启）、BoTorch 贝叶斯优化（Matérn-5/2 GP + LogEI、30 初始样本、10 次重启/256 候选）、PSO（线性递减惯性）、CMA-ES（cma 理论默认超参）、OpenEvolve 与 ShinkaEvolve 的 ASO 适配版，以及本文提出的 **ShapeEvolve**：designer 智能体（分层种群采样 + 几何/流场反馈 + 持久反思记忆的 ASO 结构化提示）与 sampler 智能体（生成执行无梯度局部搜索/坐标更新的 Python 优化脚本，进入可复用-变异的代码档案）的两阶段 LLM 进化框架，采用岛模型与幂律父代选择。
- **保真度验证范式**：代理优先搜索→局部精修→高保真复核的三段式流程（如 2D 翼型：NeuralFoil 优化 → IPOPT 精修 → XFOIL 地面真值），并以归一化罚函数（λ=500 的分数约束违反惩罚）替代硬过滤/对数障碍/Lagrangian，以兼顾"不可行解 decisively 不划算"与"近边界轻微违反保留梯度信号"。

Result: 1) **排名不稳定**：跨环境层面的优化器排名平均成对 Spearman ρ ≈ 0.013，表明不同任务上的排名几乎无相关性；排名还随相对预算演化（无任何方法在全程保持第 1，IQR 带很宽）。BO 与 PSO 在 CERAS、Delta Wing 上最好却在 CCA 上垫底，LLM 方法在 CCA 上呈相反趋势；基准远未饱和，经典方法（尤其伴随法仅适用于翼型）很少能覆盖全部外形类别与任务。
2) **任务级结论**：ShapeEvolve 在 2D 翼型多点任务上以约 2,000–3,000 次评估即接近伴随法水平（L-BFGS-B、PSO 需 O(10⁴)），且在 CCA 的 L/D 任务上明显优于经典方法（设计空间更大）；L-BFGS-B 有 7.5%（3/40）的运行落入不可行局部极小；BO 在翼型多点任务落入次优盆地且算力最贵（每千次评估 1,100–3,500 CPU·h），翼型单点任务上 BO 早期收敛快但停滞于次优值。
3) **保真度间隙**：翼型单点最大 L/D 任务中 NeuralFoil→XFOIL 存在系统性约 9% 的 L/D 落差（L/D≈360→327），个别探测设计误差达约 18%，源于 C_L/C_D 比值放大与置信包络边缘的预测退化；多点阻力最小化任务则高度准确（最优设计误差均 ≤0.50%，全任务最大 2.67%），且 XFOIL 复核保持原排名。
4) **代理利用的系统性证据**：以修正后的总阻力为目标的 BWB 任务收敛到展弦比 AR≈1.02 的非物理构型（压力阻力 <5% 参考值、升力目标在异常小迎角 4.93° 下满足），≥5/10 参数饱和；施加 AR≥2.5 后阻力约翻倍但仍有 ≥4 参数饱和，说明"调整目标只是改变了被利用的角点"而非消除利用；乘员车任务全部方法收敛到同一设计，20 个参数中 13 个被推至边界、后部离地间隙塌缩、C_D≈0.065 在物理上极不可信，诊断报告判定 GEOMETRY_DEFORMATION_EXCESSIVE、surrogate exploitation 风险"高"、物理可信度"低"，建议加入离地间隙硬约束；收紧边界的消融实验显示饱和反而加剧，印证其为代理景观内在属性。
5) **局部最优陷阱诊断**：BWB 中"最大化 L/D 代理"目标存在 A/B 两个性能角，直接优化该目标的 PSO/CMA-ES/ShapeEvolve 全部落入较差的 B 角；用最小 C̄_fx 的 A 角最优解热启动后，三者均能在预算内收敛到 A 角，证明失败源于探索（吸引域偏置）而非收敛能力不足。
6) **成本画像**：各方法每千次评估的 CPU·h 差异跨任务达 1–3 个数量级（如 CCA 上 L-BFGS-B 约 1.4–3.0、BO 约 599、ShapeEvolve 约 71.6；CERAS 上 BO 约 599、ShapeEvolve 约 385），为部署侧"算力—性能"权衡提供了依据。

Conclusion: ShapeBench 通过跨 8 类外形的 103 个任务、统一 API 与预算协议、配对的代理/高保真验证管线和诊断套件，为 ASO 提供了可复现、可比较的标准化评测基座。实证表明优化器排名在任务之间与预算之内均极不稳定（平均成对 Spearman ρ=0.013），因此单任务实验结论不可靠外推，需要在异质任务集上系统评测；代理模型驱动的优化即使经过充分训练与验证仍易被利用，出现"高目标值但物理上薄弱"的设计，故任何排名结论都必须伴随显式的有效性检查与可用时的高保真回放。作者强调后续版本将扩展方法—任务覆盖、强化标准化代理→高保真复现流程、引入更强的确定性与置信度校准报告。局限包括：高保真验证并未覆盖所有任务（3D 乘员车因 STAR-CCM+ 许可限制仅能分发 12,000 例预计算静态数据、运行时只能用 Transolver 代理评估）、当前重心偏概念与代理速度而未覆盖大规模高保真预算与制造性/鲁棒性/不确定性目标、以及基准尚未饱和。

Abstract: Rapid progress in aerodynamic shape optimization (ASO) has outpaced currently-available standardized evaluation frameworks. Fair comparison requires a unified benchmark spanning diverse shape classes, objective formulations, and matched-budget state-of-the-art baselines. We introduce ShapeBench, an open-source ASO benchmark with a unified API spanning 103 tasks across eight shape categories and multiple optimization regimes. Each ShapeBench task includes a validated surrogate for fast search; when feasible, a high-fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) pipeline for final verification is available, enabling systematic fidelity-gap analysis. ShapeBench provides a reproducible protocol with well-configured baselines to compare fairly using a consistent budget metric, allowing for comparison among both classical and LLM-driven methods, including general-purpose optimizers and a new domain-specialized evolutionary LLM baseline, ShapeEvolve. Results on ShapeBench demonstrate substantial variance in optimizer rankings across shape categories and problem formulations, with mean pairwise Spearman $ρ= 0.013$, so single-task conclusions do not reliably generalize across problem classes. The benchmark is also far from saturation; classical methods are rarely applicable across all shape categories and tasks, further highlighting the need for more general-purpose approaches.

</details>


### [233] [Cumulative Meta-Learning from Active Learning Queries for Robustness to Spurious Correlations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20771)
*Kin Whye Chew,Jingxian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAML通过在主动学习框架中引入累积归纳偏置来解决虚假相关性问题。与传统方法仅更新似然项不同，CAML利用元学习捕捉主动学习轮次间的序列依赖关系，在多个虚假相关基准数据集上实现了最高27.8%~29.9%的少数群体准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型易受虚假相关(spurious correlations)影响，在虚假相关基准下表现不佳。标准主动学习方法仅追加查询样本更新似然项，在过参数化模型中这些信息性样本的影响会被稀释。同时，现有元学习方法将任务视为独立同分布，忽略了主动学习轮次间的时序依赖关系。

Method: 提出累积主动元学习(CAML)框架：将每轮主动学习建模为元学习任务，当前标注集作为元训练数据进行模型适配，新查询批次作为元测试数据评估泛化能力。通过维护并逐步细化的累积归纳偏置(Cumulative Inductive Bias)捕捉轮次间的序列依赖。理论上证明该累积形式引入了交互项，将早期元学习归纳偏置与后期查询目标耦合。

Result: 在Dominoes、Waterbirds、SpuCo和CivilComments四个虚假相关基准数据集上，CAML均优于基线方法。少数群体准确率提升分别为：Dominoes 27.8%、Waterbirds 29.9%、SpuCo 14.3%、CivilComments 24.0%。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模主动学习轮次间的序列依赖，CAML能有效引导模型关注核心特征而非虚假相关模式。该框架为解决分布外泛化和公平性问题提供了一种新的主动学习范式。

Abstract: Spurious correlations in real-world datasets cause machine learning models to rely on irrelevant patterns, undermining reliability, generalization, and fairness. Active learning offers a promising way to address this failure mode by querying informative samples that distinguish core features from spurious ones. However, standard active-learning methods simply append queried examples to the labeled set, effectively updating only the likelihood term. In deep learning regimes, the influence of these informative samples can be diluted by the larger labeled set and memorized by overparameterized models. We propose Cumulative Active Meta-Learning (CAML), an active-learning framework that uses queried examples to meta-learn the prior, or inductive bias, governing how the model adapts. CAML casts each active-learning round as a meta-learning task: the current labeled set serves as meta-train data for adaptation, while the newly queried batch serves as meta-test data for evaluating generalization. Unlike conventional meta-learning, which treats tasks as independent and identically distributed, CAML exploits the sequential dependence between active-learning rounds by maintaining a cumulative inductive bias that is progressively refined. Theoretically, we show that this cumulative formulation introduces interaction terms that couple earlier meta-learned inductive biases with later query-induced objectives, capturing dependencies absent from standard meta-learning. Empirically, CAML improves minority-group accuracy across spurious-correlation benchmarks and acquisition strategies, with gains of up to 27.8% on Dominoes, 29.9% on Waterbirds, 14.3% on SpuCo, and 24.0% on CivilComments.

</details>


### [234] [DelTA: Discriminative Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21467)
*Kaiyi Zhang,Wei Wu,Yankai Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DelTA（Discriminative Signal-guided Token Credit Assignment），把序列级 RLVR（如 DAPO）的策略梯度更新重新解读为 token 梯度空间上的一个隐式线性判别器，并用「正负优势侧判别性对比」估计的 token 系数去重加权自归一化的 DAPO surrogate，从而放大侧别特有、抑制共享的背景 token 梯度方向。在 7 个数学基准上，DelTA 相对最强同规模基线在 Qwen3-8B-Base / 14B-Base 上分别提升 3.26 / 2.62 个平均分，并在代码生成、其他 backbone（Olmo3-7B）与域外评测上同样有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 用可验证的响应级奖励（如答案对错）优化策略，但更新实际累积在 token 级，存在粒度错配：同一响应的所有 token 共享同一个标量优势。已有观察表明 RLVR 只在极少数 token 上引起显著分布偏移，说明存在一个未被显式指定的隐式 token 选择机制，但"哪些 token 概率被上调或下调、由什么决定"尚不清楚。同时标准序列级 RLVR 的正/负优势侧方向由优势加权的 token 梯度质心（加权最小二乘中心）构成，训练中高频共享模式（格式 token、问题实体等）会同时拉偏两侧质心，使判别器被任务无关的共性主导，稀释了真正能区分高/低奖励响应的稀疏判别方向。作者的核心问题是：如何让 RLVR 隐式判别器更具判别性，从而改善 token 级信用分配。

Method: 1）判别器视角：一阶泰勒展开 Δlogπ(x|c) ≈ ∇logπ(x|c)ᵀ Δθ；局部 DAPO 更新可写成 Δθ ∝ M₊μ̄₊ − M₋μ̄₋，即正负优势侧的 token 梯度加权质心之差；候选 token 的正侧分数高于负侧分数则概率被上调，故更新方向在 token 梯度空间上等价于一个线性判别器（附录证明质心即加权最小二乘中心，并说明 GRPO/DAPO/Forking-Tokens/FIPO 本质上只在改有效 token 权重 ρ）。
2）DelTA：初始化两侧质心 → 做 K 步 stop-gradient 交替精化：固定质心时用熵正则化指派问题求闭式软分数 α=σ((‖v−μ₋‖²−‖v−μ₊‖²)/γ₊)（负侧对称），温度 γ 取平方距离差的经验标准差并滞后更新；固定分数时以分数加权重算质心 → 最后重算 α 并线性映射为有界系数 λ=λ_min+(λ_max−λ_min)α。
3）优化目标：将 DAPO 的均匀 token 平均替换为自归一化加权 surrogate（1/Σλ·Σλ·min(rÂ, clip(r)Â)），等价于在标准 token 数归一化下使用 λ̄=λN/Z；系数为 stop-gradient，每批次算一次、跨 epoch 固定。
4）工程实现：全参数 token 梯度在大模型规模不可行，改用 LM-head 层的受限代理 (1−p_t(y_t))h_t（并给出 top-K 隐状态梯度代理变体），仅用于系数估计，主目标仍更新全部参数。

Result: 主实验（DeepMath-103K + VeRL，8×B200）：Qwen3-8B-Base 平均分从 25.14（SAPO）→28.40，14B 从 37.29（FIPO）→39.91，7 个数学基准（AIME24/25/26、HMMT25 二月与十一月、HMMT26 二月、Brumo25）全面最优；重复生成评测下单侧 Mann–Whitney U 检验 p<0.05 显著。训练动态上 DelTA 后期继续提升且保持更长响应、更低熵，DAPO 平台化并响应变短、熵升高。分析：仅用本侧中心性的变体（17.94）劣于 DAPO（19.05），说明跨侧对比不可省；仅用 λ 做 top-50% token 选择的训练优于全量 DAPO、随机 50% 接近 DAPO、bottom-50% 迅速崩溃，说明低 λ token 会主动损害更新。消融显示 refinement、自适应 γ、熵正则、有界范围映射、λ 质量归一化各组件均有贡献（去掉 refinement 降幅最大）；代理消融中 top-K 隐梯度代理更优（24.29 vs 23.27），随机 λ 显著变差（18.34），证明收益来自判别结构而非任意扰动。泛化：Olmo3-7B 上 DAPO 19.01→DelTA 22.80；代码生成 HumanEval+/MBPP+/LCB 加权 47.7→49.5；域外 GPQA-D+MMLU-Pro 8B 58.87→62.38、14B 66.77→68.40。超参较鲁棒（K=2/3 反而变差，λ 范围不敏感），额外开销约首步时长 +10.2%（K+2 次 actor 前向）。

Conclusion: RLVR 的响应级奖励通过 token 梯度的优势加权聚合隐式地产生 token 级选择，其本质是在 token 梯度空间上的判别器；标准序列级方法的判别方向被共享高频模式污染，使"侧内摘要"与"跨侧判别"目标错配。DelTA 通过对 token 梯度做正负判别性对比的软指派并重加权自归一化 surrogate，使有效质心更具对比性，从而在数学推理、代码生成、不同 backbone 与域外评测上一致优于强 RLVR 基线，且几乎不引入额外训练开销。局限：系数依赖 LM-head 层受限梯度代理而非全参数梯度；评测以数学为主，未覆盖多轮交互与工具使用等更复杂 RLVR 场景；系数估计带来有限但非零的计算成本。作者提出的方向是更丰富高效的 token 梯度近似与更广场景验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a central technique for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Despite its effectiveness, how response-level rewards translate into token-level probability changes remains poorly understood. We introduce a discriminator view of RLVR updates, showing that the policy-gradient update direction implicitly acts as a linear discriminator over token-gradient vectors and thereby determines which token probabilities are increased or decreased during learning. Under standard sequence-level RLVR, this discriminator is constructed from positive- and negative-side centroids formed by advantage-weighted averaging of token-gradient vectors. However, such centroid construction can be dominated by shared high-frequency patterns, such as formatting tokens, diluting sparse yet discriminative directions that better distinguish high-reward responses from low-reward ones. To address this limitation, we propose $\textbf{DelTA}$, a discriminative token credit assignment method that estimates token coefficients to amplify side-specific token-gradient directions and downweight shared or weakly discriminative ones. These coefficients reweight a self-normalized RLVR surrogate, making the effective side-wise centroids more contrastive and thereby reshaping the RLVR update direction. On seven mathematical benchmarks, DelTA outperforms the strongest same-scale baselines by 3.26 and 2.62 average points on Qwen3-8B-Base and Qwen3-14B-Base, respectively. Additional results on code generation, a different backbone, and out-of-domain evaluations further demonstrate the generalization ability of DelTA.

</details>


### [235] [Learning to Think in Physics: Breaking Shortcut Learning in Scientific Diffusion via Representation Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20780)
*Haozhe Jia,Pengyu Yin,Wenshuo Chen,Shaofeng Liang,Lei Wang,Bowen Tian,Xiucheng Wang,Nanqian Jia,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REPA-P是一种无教师、架构无关的框架，通过在中间层附加轻量投影头并施加PDE残差损失，实现物理约束从输出层向中间层的扩展，显著提升收敛速度、物理保真度和分布外鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理信息扩散模型仅对最终输出施加PDE约束，导致中间表示缺乏约束，在边界条件偏移时容易产生捷径学习（shortcut learning）。

Method: REPA-P采用teacher-free、architecture-agnostic的架构，通过在选定层附加轻量级1×1投影头将隐藏激活解码为物理量，并在训练时施加PDE残差损失；推理时丢弃这些投影头，实现零开销。

Result: 在Darcy流、拓扑优化、静电势和湍流通道流四种PDE任务中，REPA-P实现最高2倍收敛加速、66.4%物理残差 reduction和49.3%分布外鲁棒性提升，对U-Net和Diffusion Transformer backbone均有效。消融实验表明，仅监督少量中间层即可获得大部分收益。

Conclusion: REPA-P通过轻量化投影头实现中间层监督，在四种PDE任务上均表现优异，且对U-Net和Diffusion Transformerbackbone均有效。代码已开源于GitHub。

Abstract: Physics-informed diffusion models typically enforce PDE constraints only on final outputs, leaving intermediate representations unconstrained and prone to shortcut learning under shifted boundary conditions. We introduce **REPA-P**, a teacher-free, architecture-agnostic framework that aligns intermediate features with physical states using first-principles residuals. REPA-P attaches lightweight $1{\times}1$ projection heads to selected layers, decodes hidden activations into physical quantities, and applies PDE residual losses during training. These heads are discarded at inference, introducing **zero overhead**. Across four PDE tasks, including Darcy flow, topology optimization, electrostatic potential, and turbulent channel flow, REPA-P accelerates convergence by up to $2{\times}$, reduces physics residuals by up to $66.4\%$, and improves out-of-distribution robustness by up to $49.3\%$, with consistent gains on both U-Net and Diffusion Transformer backbones. Ablations show that supervising a small set of intermediate layers captures most benefits and complements output-level physics losses. Code is available at [https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P](https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P).

</details>


### [236] [You Only Need Minimal RLVR Training: Extrapolating LLMs via Rank-1 Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21468)
*Zhepei Wei,Xinyu Zhu,Wei-Lin Chen,Chengsong Huang,Jiaxin Huang,Yu Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现RLVR权重轨迹具有极低秩且高度可预测的特性，90%以上的性能提升可由秩-1近似捕获。提出RELEX方法，通过观察窗口估计秩-1子空间并线性外推，以15%训练步骤达到完整RLVR效果，并能外推10-20倍于观察窗口的范围。成功源于秩-1投影的去噪效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR已成为提升LLM推理能力的主流范式，但其权重轨迹的几何特性未被充分探索。

Method: RELEX：利用短观察窗口估计秩-1子空间，通过线性回归外推未来检查点，无需训练模型。

Result: RELEX在三个模型（Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-8B-Base）的域内和域外基准测试中均达到或超越RLVR性能，仅需15%训练步骤即可。

Conclusion: RELEX通过仅需15%的RLVR训练步骤即可达到相当甚至更好的性能，且能外推10-20倍于观察窗口的范围。其成功归因于秩-1投影的"去噪"效应。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a dominant paradigm for improving reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying geometry of the resulting parameter trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that RLVR weight trajectories are extremely low-rank and highly predictable. Specifically, we find that the majority of downstream performance gains are captured by a rank-1 approximation of the parameter deltas, where the magnitude of this projection evolves near-linearly with training steps. Motivated by this, we propose a simple and compute-efficient method RELEX (REinforcement Learning EXtrapolation), which estimates the rank-1 subspace from a short observation window and extrapolates future checkpoints via linear regression, with no learned model required. Across three models (i.e., Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3-4B-Base, and Qwen3-8B-Base), RELEX produces checkpoints that match or exceed RLVR performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, requiring as few as 15% steps of full RLVR training. Remarkably, RELEX is able to extrapolate far beyond the observation window at no training cost, predicting checkpoints up to 10-20$\times$ beyond the observed prefix with continued improvement (e.g., observe only the first 50 steps and extrapolate to 1000 steps). Our ablation analysis confirms the minimalist sufficiency of RELEX: neither increasing the subspace rank nor employing non-linear modeling yields further gains in extrapolation. Finally, we show that RELEX's success stems from a "denoising" effect: by projecting updates onto the rank-1 subspace, the model discards stochastic optimization noise that would otherwise degrade performance during extrapolation. Our code is available at https://github.com/weizhepei/RELEX.

</details>


### [237] [Causal Machine Learning Is Not a Panacea: A Roadmap for Observational Causal Inference in Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20782)
*Donna Tjandra,Trenton Chang,Sonali Parbhoo,Rajesh Ranganath,Andre Kurepa Waschka,William Mitchell,Maggie Makar,Shalmali Joshi,Finale Doshi-Velez,Leo Anthony Celi,Jenna Wiens*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将因果机器学习应用于观察性临床数据的路线图，强调因果假设验证的重要性，并指出因果ML的局限性常被低估，需谨慎建模以避免偏倚结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机对照试验（RCT）面临实施困难，而大规模观察性临床数据集日益丰富，研究者热衷于用法因果ML进行因果推断，但其局限性尚未得到广泛认可，可能导致偏倚或误导性结果。

Method: 概述了在观察性数据中应用因果ML的流程，强调需在可用数据内评估因果假设的有效性，并为临床专家和缺乏临床经验的ML从业者分别提供指导。

Result: 指出尽管因果ML取得进展，但其局限性在不同学科中仍普遍被低估，这种知识差距可能影响研究结果的有效性。

Conclusion: 因果ML可成为生成因果假设的有力工具；文章提供模板以增强因果分析的严谨性和可解释性，但必须满足因果假设并合理说明建模选择。

Abstract: Objective: The growing availability of large-scale observational clinical datasets and challenges in conducting randomized controlled trials have spurred enthusiasm in using causal machine learning (ML) for causal inference in observational data. We present a roadmap for applying causal ML to observational data. Materials and methods: We outline the importance of assessing validity assumptions within available data and applying causal ML responsibly for clinical experts using causal ML and ML practitioners with limited clinical expertise. Observations: Despite advances in causal ML, its limitations remain largely under-appreciated across disciplines. This gap in shared knowledge may impact the validity of findings. Discussion: Causal assumptions must be satisfied and modeling choices justified. Otherwise, these approaches risk producing biased or misleading results, with consequences for clinical research and patient care. Conclusion: Causal ML can be a powerful tool for generating causal hypotheses. We provide a template to strengthen the rigor and interpretability of causal analyses.

</details>


### [238] [Beyond Numerical Features: CNN-Driven Algorithm Selection via Contour Plots for Continuous Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20797)
*Yiliang Yuan,Xiang Shi,Mustafa Misir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于轮廓图可视化的实例级算法选择新方法，利用CNN回归器从探测景观的等高线图中学习预测各求解器的性能表现，在BBOB基准上显著优于单最优求解器，并与特征基线方法具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续优化算法选择主要依赖数值特征（如ELA特征和DeepELA嵌入），本文探索一种互补的视觉表征方法，即通过探测景观的等高线图来捕捉空间结构信息，为算法选择提供新的表征视角。

Method: 构建包含两个关键技术环节：（1）生成实例特定的轮廓图可视化；（2）设计CNN回归模型接收多视图轮廓图（堆叠或逐视图编码后聚合），预测各求解器的性能，通过预测最优值实现算法选择。在BBOB 2009单目标协议上评估，并扩展至DeepELA设置下的双目标场景。

Result: 在BBOB 2009单目标基准上，提出的选择器显著优于单最优求解器（SBS），并与基于特征的基线方法具有竞争力。DeepELA设置下的双目标评估进一步表明，图像化方法在使用窗口化轮廓视图时同样具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 简单的视觉模型能够利用探测景观中的空间结构进行算法选择，无需手工设计的ELA特征，验证了轮廓图作为一种互补表征在算法选择问题上的有效性。

Abstract: The present paper introduces a new representation-driven approach to per-instance algorithm selection, applied to black-box optimization, for automatically choosing the most promising solver from a fixed portfolio. Prior work in continuous optimization largely relies on numerical descriptors, including Exploratory Landscape Analysis features and learned embeddings such as Deep-ELA. This work studies a complementary representation: contour-map visualizations of probed landscapes. A CNN regressor takes multiple instance-specific contour views (stacked or encoded per view and aggregated) and predicts per-solver performance, enabling selection by the predicted best value. On the standard BBOB 2009 single-objective protocol, the resulting selectors significantly outperform the single best solver (SBS) and are competitive with feature-based baselines. A subsequent bi-objective evaluation under the DeepELA setting further indicates that the same image-based principle can be competitive when using windowed contour views. Overall, the results suggest that simple vision models can exploit spatial structure in probed landscapes for algorithm selection without handcrafted ELA features.

</details>


### [239] [Tunable MAGMAX: Preference-Aware Model Merging for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20803)
*Kei Hiroshima,Kento Uchida,Shinichi Shirakawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Tunable MAGMAX，一个基于模型合并的持续学习框架，通过引入偏好向量实现任务性能的可控调节，使模型能够适应不同的部署环境和用户偏好需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要关注所有任务的平均性能，缺乏对不同部署环境或用户偏好的灵活适配能力。用户在不同场景下可能需要不同任务性能权重，但现有方法无法提供这种细粒度控制。

Method: 提出Tunable MAGMAX框架，核心创新包括：(1) 引入偏好向量控制从各任务向量中选择元素的权重，实现任务性能的动态调节；(2) 提出基于少量目标环境数据和训练任务数据集自动构建偏好向量的方法，无需人工指定偏好参数。

Result: 在持续学习基准任务上的实验表明，Tunable MAGMAX能够有效控制任务级性能，并成功适配多种目标部署环境。在性能上达到或超越基线方法，验证了框架的实用性和有效性。

Conclusion: Tunable MAGMAX为持续学习模型的部署提供了一种灵活实用的解决方案，能够根据不同环境和偏好需求调整模型性能，无需重新训练即可实现任务性能的动态权衡。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to train models sequentially on multiple tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting of previously learned knowledge. Recent advances in large pre-trained models (LPMs) and model merging techniques, such as MAGMAX, have demonstrated effective CL performance by combining task-specific parameters. However, existing methods primarily focus on average performance across all tasks and do not adequately address how to construct models accommodating different deployment environments or varying user preferences. This paper proposes a model merging framework, termed Tunable MAGMAX, which enables preference-aware control of task-specific performance in CL. Our method introduces a preference vector that controls the number of elements selected from each task vector during model merging, allowing us to adjust the merged model performance according to their deployment needs. We further propose a method for automatically constructing appropriate preference vectors by leveraging small amounts of target environment data and datasets from model training tasks, thereby eliminating the need for manual specification. The experimental result on CL benchmark tasks demonstrates that Tunable MAGMAX effectively controls task-wise performance and successfully adapts merged models to various target environments. The proposed Tunable MAGMAX achieves superior or comparable performance to baseline methods, making it a practical solution for deploying CL models to various environments where the preferences of each task performance differ.

</details>


### [240] [Markovian Circuit Tracing for Transformer State Dynamic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20824)
*Abdullah X*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出了MCT（马尔可夫电路追踪）方法，用于测试transformer激活是否包含粗粒度状态转换结构。通过使用已知真实值的合成HMM任务基准测试，发现tiny causal transformers能学习接近贝叶斯最优的预测器，残差激活包含部分贝叶斯信念信息，状态抽象可恢复粗粒度转换信号，且状态修补显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Many sequence computations are better understood as movement through internal states rather than isolated local circuits. There is a need to test whether transformer activations contain coarse state-transition structure, which requires controlled benchmarks with known ground truth for evaluation.

Method: Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT): a diagnostic pipeline that uses synthetic Hidden Markov Model (HMM) tasks with known ground truth (latent states, transition matrices, Bayesian belief vectors, Bayes-optimal predictions, and forced-state counterfactual targets). State abstractions are extracted from residual activations and tested via state forcing with recovered-state centroid patching.

Result: 1. Tiny causal transformers achieve near-Bayes-optimal performance (mean excess loss: 0.0138); 2. Residual activations contain partial Bayesian belief information; 3. State abstractions recover coarse transition signal, strongest in persistent and lower-state regimes, weaker in ambiguous-emission and six-state regimes; 4. State forcing via recovered-state centroid patching reduces KL divergence to exact HMM counterfactual from 0.1957 to 0.0532, outperforming all control conditions.

Conclusion: MCT provides a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework for transformer state-dynamics interpretability, serving as a simple reference pipeline for studying whether transformer activations contain coarse state-transition structure.

Abstract: Many sequence computations are easier to study as movement through internal states than as isolated local circuits. We introduce Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT), a diagnostic pipeline for testing whether transformer activations contain coarse state-transition structure. The benchmark uses synthetic Hidden Markov Model (HMM) tasks where latent states, transition matrices, Bayesian belief vectors, Bayes-optimal predictions, and forced-state counterfactual targets are known exactly. Across six HMM families and three seeds per family, tiny causal transformers learn near-Bayes next-token predictors, with mean excess loss over Bayes of 0.0138. Residual activations contain partial Bayesian belief information in this controlled synthetic benchmark. State abstractions extracted from these activations recover coarse transition signal, strongest in persistent and lower-state regimes, and weaker in ambiguous-emission and six-state regimes. The clearest result comes from state forcing. Patching a recovered-state centroid reduces KL to the exact HMM counterfactual target from 0.1957 in the unpatched model to 0.0532 on average, beating wrong-state, mean-activation, random-activation, and shuffled-label controls. The contribution is a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework for transformer state-dynamics interpretability, with MCT as a simple reference pipeline

</details>


### [241] [Finite-Time Regret Analysis of Retry-Aware Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20854)
*Bingkui Tong,Junpei Komiyama,Soichiro Nishimori,Paavo Parmas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了针对retry-aware目标优化的随机老虎机算法ReMax。该算法选择最大化M次虚拟抽取后验期望最大奖励的采样分布。对于M=2的高斯奖励场景，论文证明了首个次线性遗憾界，并揭示了欠估计效应这一ReMax特有的现象——这解释了为何ReMax比Thompson采样更具利用性且分析更复杂。实验验证了欠估计程度与性能的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将强化学习中用于不确定性下探索的retry-aware目标（pass@k, max@k）应用于多臂老虎机问题，验证其在随机老虎机中是否具有良好 regret 性质。

Method: 对于M=2的高斯奖励场景，通过期望改进平衡条件刻画最优ReMax分布；引入饱和行为与欠估计效应的分离分析框架。关键证明技术需处理欠估计导致的采样偏差问题。

Result: 证明了首个ReMax的次线性遗憾上界；发现ReMax存在特有的欠估计效应（最优臂在不利估计后被采样过少）；实证表明轻度欠估计下ReMax优于KL-UCB和TS，后验方差缩放可缓解严重欠估计。

Conclusion: ReMax可被证明实现次线性遗憾，且分析揭示了“欠估计效应”——最优臂在不利估计后可能被采样过少，这解释了为何ReMax比Thompson采样更具利用性且其遗憾分析技术上更复杂。实验表明，在轻度欠估计条件下ReMax性能优于KL-UCB和Thompson采样，后验方差缩放可缓解严重欠估计。

Abstract: We study a stochastic bandit algorithm motivated by retry-aware objectives that value the best outcome among multiple attempts, such as pass@$k$ and max@$k$. Given a posterior over arm values, ReMax chooses a sampling distribution that maximizes the posterior expected maximum reward over $M$ virtual draws. Although this objective was introduced in reinforcement learning as an exploration mechanism under uncertainty, its regret properties in bandit problems have remained unclear. For Gaussian rewards and the first nontrivial case $M=2$, we characterize the optimal ReMax distribution through an expected-improvement balance condition and prove the first sublinear regret bound for ReMax. Our analysis separates the usual saturation behavior of suboptimal arms from a ReMax-specific underestimation effect, in which the optimal arm may be sampled too rarely after an unfavorable estimate. This explains why ReMax can be more exploitative than Thompson sampling (TS) and why its regret analysis is technically delicate. Experiments support this picture: ReMax often outperforms KL-UCB and Thompson sampling under mild underestimation, while posterior-variance scaling empirically mitigates severe underestimation.

</details>


### [242] [Multi-Step Likelihood-Ratio Correction for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20865)
*Deokgyu Yoon,Hyungkyu Kang,Joongkyu Lee,Byeongchan Kim,Gyungin Shin,Sungrae Park,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 N-步前向迹（forward trace）校正，并据此设计了 RLVR 算法 NFPO。核心洞察是：PPO/GRPO 的代理目标因只使用当前 token 的似然比 ρ_t（"局部"目标）而在精确策略改进恒等式中丢弃了对未来 token 的似然比修正项 Γ_{t+1}=∏_{j>t}ρ_j，从而引入结构性偏差；而完整迹虽无偏却方差极高。作者保留其后 N−1 个 token 的似然比构成 N-步前向迹 Γ^{(N)}_{t+1}=∏_{j=t+1}^{min(t+N−1,T)}ρ_j，在 PPO/GRPO（N=1）与精确策略梯度（N=T）之间提供连续插值。理论上证明：N 增大使截断偏差以 O((T−N)²δ²) 递减，但有限样本方差项以 O((1+ε)^{N−1}) 指数上升，从而存在"甜点" N。实践上 NFPO 在 masked policy gradient 框架（DPPO 的 TV token mask）中对每个 token 的权重乘以截断并 stop-gradient 的前向迹。实验表明 NFPO 在 Qwen3-1.7B/8B 的 7 个数学推理基准上稳定优于 GRPO 与 DPPO（1.7B 平均 pass@1 30.7% vs 26.4%/27.9%），且机理分析显示前向迹选择性强化推理 token 的校正并充当"语义低通滤波器"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的主流范式，PPO/GRPO 家族算法被广泛使用。作者指出其代理目标存在"局部性"（locality）缺陷：每个 token 项仅使用当前步似然比 ρ_t=π(y_t|s_t)/μ(y_t|s_t) 与响应级奖励/优势，完全忽略策略更新对后续已生成 token 概率的影响。

由性能差异引理（Lemma 1）可知，精确的策略改进可分解为 J(π)−J(μ)=E_μ[R(y)Σ_t(ρ_t−1)Γ_{t+1}]，其中 Γ_{t+1}=∏_{j>t}ρ_j 称为"完整前向迹"（full forward trace），是未来 token 序列在 π 与 μ 下的似然比。PPO 代理目标相当于取 Γ_{t+1}=1，丢弃了这一修正项。

由此产生结构性偏差–方差困境：
1. 偏差侧：省略的前向修正由 μ 与 π 未来轨迹分布的偏差决定，在一致信任域 sup_s D_TV(μ,π)≤δ 下误差为 O(T²δ²)（Proposition 1）。信任域机制（PPO 的 ratio clipping、GRPO/DPPO 的 token 级掩码）只是间接补偿，无法真正恢复被丢弃的前向似然比修正。
2. 方差侧：完整迹在长序列生成中会复合放大 token 级失配，少量大迹轨迹即可主导经验梯度，导致高方差与不稳定更新。
3. 现有工作（如 FIPO）虽也引入未来相关的乘性重加权，但属于启发式稠密信用分配，缺乏从精确恒等式出发的推导与显式的偏差–方差刻画。

因此需要一种"部分恢复"前向迹的中间目标：以牺牲部分偏差为代价换取可控的方差。

Method: 【理论部分】
- N-步前向迹定义：Γ^{(N)}_{t+1}:=∏_{j=t+1}^{min{t+N−1,T}}ρ_j，N∈{1,…,T}。N=1 时为空积（退化为 PPO/GRPO 局部代理）；N=T 时恢复完整迹（退化为精确策略梯度目标）。
- 总体 N-步代理目标：L^{(N)}_μ(π)=E_μ[R(y)Σ_t(ρ_t−1)Γ^{(N)}_{t+1}]。
- Proposition 1（局部代理的策略改进下界）：J(π)−J(μ) ≥ L̂_μ(π) − 2ξT(T−1)(D_TV^max)² − ξTε√(2log(1/α)/G)，第一项为 O(T²δ²) 的截断偏差，第二项为 Hoeffding 方差项。
- Theorem 1（核心）：J(π)−J(μ) ≥ L̂^{(N)}_μ(π) − 2ξ(T−N)(T−N+1)(D_TV^max)² − B_N√(2log(1/α)/G)，其中 B_N=ξεΣ_{t=1}^T(1+ε)^{min{N−1,T−t}}。证明分三步：(i) 将完整迹分解为 Γ_{t+1}=Γ^{(N)}_{t+1}·Q_{m_t+1}（残余乘积），用序列核 TV 的望远镜界 E_μ[|Q−1||s]≤2(T−m_t)δ 及 E_μ[Γ^{(N)}|s_{t+1}]=1 得到偏差项随 N 递减；(ii) 用 Hoeffding 不等式得方差项；(iii) 证明 S_{N+1}−S_N=(T−N)(1+ε)^{N−1}ε>0，即 B_N 关于 N 严格单调递增。两端点自洽：N=1 退化为 Proposition 1，N=T 时截断偏差消失、恢复精确目标。
- 结论：N 是显式的偏差–方差旋钮，D_TV^max 与 ε 小（策略接近行为策略、ratio 稳定）时宜取大 N，反之取小 N。

【算法实现：NFPO】
在 masked policy gradient（MPG）框架内实现：
- 目标：L̂^{(N)}_{μ,NFPO}(π) = (1/G)Σ_i Σ_t M_t^{(i)}·Â^{(i)}·ρ_t^{(i)}·Γ̄^{(N,i)}_{t+1}。对前向迹施加 stop-gradient 以保证数值稳定（因此权重为 ρ_t 而非 ρ_t−1）。
- 似然比截断：ρ_{t,β}=clip(ρ_t, 1/β, β)，β=3.0（固定不调）。
- 截断前向迹：Γ̄^{(N,i)}_{t+1}=clip(∏_{j=t+1}^{m_t(N)}ρ_{j,β}^{(i)}, 1−ε_low, 1+ε_high)，主实验用 [0.8, 1.4]。
- 信任域：采用 DPPO 的 TV-based token mask M_t^{(i)}=1{D_TV(μ(·|s_t),π(·|s_t))≤δ 或 Â^{(i)}(ρ_t−1)≤0}，δ=0.2。
- 超参：N=4（1.7B）、N=8（8B）；不重算 log prob；无 KL/熵正则。

【实验设置】
verl 框架，8×H200；基础模型 Qwen3-1.7B-Base（MATH level 3–5，8k 长度）与 Qwen3-8B-Base（DAPO-Math-17k，16k 长度）；每步 128 prompt × 8 响应 = 1024 rollout，mini-batch 256；lr 1e-6，AdamW，训练温度 1.0；评测 AIME24/25/26、AMC23、MATH-500、Minerva、OlympiadBench，pass@1（每 prompt 32 条采样，温度 0.7）。基线：GRPO（clip-higher，ε_low=0.2/ε_high=0.28）、DPPO（TV mask）、FIPO。另有小 token MDP（|V|=3, T=7, "abcabc" 子序列稀疏奖励，α_μ=0.5<α_π=0.8）作为偏差–方差的受控验证。

Result: 【主结果】
- Qwen3-1.7B-Base 平均 pass@1：NFPO 30.7%，DPPO 27.9%，GRPO 26.4%（相对提升 16.3% / 10.0%），且在 7 个基准中 7 项全部最优（AIME24 13.3%、AIME25 7.4%、AIME26 8.1%、AMC23 49.6%、MATH500 74.5%、Minerva 26.2%、Oly. 36.0%）。
- Qwen3-8B-Base 平均：NFPO 51.5% > DPPO 50.1% > GRPO 46.1%，同样在多数基准领先（AIME24 36.4%、AIME25 28.4%、AMC23 82.0%、Oly. 57.1%）。
- 相对 FIPO 优势明显（KL 距离、训练奖励与评测性能均更优）。

【机理分析】
- 观测 1（更主动的偏差校正）：基于约 3.4M token 的"校正强度"（E|ρ−1| vs E|ρ·Γ̄−1|）：全体 token 0.0278→0.0722，推理类 token 0.0531→0.1078；分八类（推理连接词/推理动作/功能词/数学内容名词/数学变量/数字/格式/其他）均显示 trace 校正后更强，且推理类与内容类显著高于数字、格式等残余类。
- 观测 2（语义低通滤波）：token 级 ρ_t 常在中性值 1 附近高频振荡；引入前向迹后相邻 token 共享大部分 N-步迹，batch 平均"切换频率"由 20.18% 降至 10.08%（约减半），抑制孤立波动、保留成段一致信号。
- 观测 3（中间 N 最优）：性能在 N=4 出现"甜点"，所有 N>1 的配置均优于 N=1（即 DPPO）；随 N 增大前向迹方差上升（利：校正更主动）而低通滤波更强（利：噪声更小），二者反向作用形成中间最优区。
- 消融：不同前向迹截断范围（[0.8,1.2]/[0.8,1.4]/[0.8,1.6] 等）均优于 DPPO，结论稳健；重算 rollout log prob 反而略降且开销更大（默认不重算）；去掉 ρ 的 β=3 截断性能几乎不变（说明前向迹自身截断已抑制方差爆炸）；token mask 选择上 TV mask 优于 KL mask、GRPO 的 PPO clipping 与 IcePop mask，故默认采用 TV mask。
- 小 token MDP 实验：随 N 增大，总体目标 J(μ)+L^{(N)}_μ(π) 逼近真实 J(π)（偏差下降），同时 Var[L̂^{(N)}_μ(π)] 上升（方差增大），与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是把"局部代理目标"这一长期沿用的工程近似重新追溯到精确的策略改进恒等式，并指出被丢弃项就是前向似然比迹 Γ_{t+1}，从而给出一个有理论支撑的、可调的偏差–方差插值族，而非仅仅在 PPO 实现细节上做微调。

主要结论与意义：
1. NFPO（N-步前向迹策略优化）在形式上统一了 PPO/GRPO（N=1）与精确策略梯度（N=T），并证明在合适的 N 下其策略改进下界严格紧于标准 PPO 代理目标（截断偏差 O((T−N)²δ²) 递减、方差项 O((1+ε)^{N−1}) 递增）。
2. 工程实现上通过 stop-gradient、似然比截断（β=3）、前向迹截断区间与 TV-based token mask，把"无偏但高方差"的高阶修正安全地引入 RLVR 训练，1.7B 与 8B 规模、7 个数学推理基准上一致优于 GRPO 与 DPPO。
3. 机理层面给出直观解释：前向迹使校正信号集中到推理 token（推理"分叉点"），并通过相邻 token 共享窗口构成低通滤波器，降低 token 级噪声。
4. 方法论启示：N 应作为 RLVR 的重要超参——策略偏离信任域越远、ratio 越不稳定，越应取小 N；反之可取大 N。论文也客观区分了自身与 FIPO：后者是基于 future-KL 的启发式稠密信用分配（其折扣为 1 时可视为本文框架 N=T 的特例），而本文是从精确恒等式推导出的目标修正。

局限与后续方向可由文中线索推知：理论界依赖 |R|≤ξ、|ρ_t−1|≤ε 等强假设与最坏情形 TV 界，实际中的紧性有待更精细刻画；前向迹在超长生成下仍会复合失配，clip 区间与 N 的联合选取仍依赖经验调参；方法仅在数学推理类可验证奖励任务上验证，迁移到代码/多模态 RLVR 的效果有待检验；与更强基线（如更大规模 RL 算法、critic-based 方法）的对比仍可扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) plays a pivotal role in improving the reasoning ability of large language models. However, widely used PPO surrogate objectives are fundamentally local, as they rely on a local approximation of the exact policy gradient objective. While this approximation improves stability by reducing the variance induced by importance sampling, it also introduces structural bias into the surrogate objective, which must be controlled through trust region mechanisms. In this work, we introduce the $N$-step forward trace, which augments the PPO surrogate objective using the cumulative likelihood ratio of the next $N-1$ tokens. Building on this idea, we propose $N$-Step Forward-Trace Policy Optimization (NFPO), a practical RLVR algorithm that integrates the $N$-step forward trace into the masked policy gradient framework. NFPO provides a continuous bridge between the PPO surrogate objective and the exact policy gradient objective, offering a principled mechanism for controlling the bias-variance trade-off. Our theoretical analysis shows that, with an appropriate choice of $N$, the proposed objective yields a tighter policy-improvement bound than the standard PPO surrogate. Experiments on comprehensive reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that NFPO consistently improves performance, supporting our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [243] [Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20868)
*Dean Calver*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层KV缓存架构，通过在GPU内存存储INT8键和INT4值，同时在系统RAM保留FP16原值，结合在线计算的逐头逐步误差界和自适应精度选择，实现运行时可认证的注意力计算，保证在需要时精确恢复到FP16参考输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存量化可降低长上下文LLM推理的内存成本，但引入近似误差，现有系统仅依赖经验性验证，缺乏运行时检测或故障恢复机制，无法保证计算正确性。

Method: 设计分层KV缓存架构：GPU内存存储INT8键和INT4值，系统RAM保留FP16原值用于确定性回退。采用两项误差分解方法，计算键量化导致的注意力分布畸变和值重建误差的逐头逐步界。基于这些在线计算的误差界驱动自适应精度选择和多级回退阶梯，保证在必要时精确恢复到密集FP16注意力输出。

Result: 在LLaMA 3.1-8B、128K上下文长度的PG-19、NIAH和RULER基准上，语言建模和检索任务的质量与密集FP16 KV相当，同时恢复了朴素INT8/INT4基线中的灾难性故障。短上下文值敏感任务存在压缩保真度的可控权衡，可通过更严格的值容差或FP16值回退消除。

Conclusion: 该方法将KV缓存量化重新定位为运行时验证的计算而非固定近似。认证是局部的（逐头、逐步），不保证端到端模型正确性，但确保每次注意力计算要么有界（相对于FP16参考），要么通过回退精确恢复。目标不是追求原始加速，而是实现在严格质量约束下安全部署激进KV压缩。

Abstract: KV cache quantization reduces the memory cost of long-context LLM inference, but introduces approximation error that is typically validated only empirically. Existing systems rely on average-case robustness, with no mechanism to detect or recover from failures at runtime. We present a tiered KV cache architecture that enables runtime-certified attention: INT8 keys and INT4 values are stored in GPU memory, while FP16 originals are retained in system RAM for deterministic fallback. A two-term error decomposition yields per-head, per-step bounds on (i) attention distribution distortion from key quantization and (ii) value reconstruction error. These bounds are computed online and used to drive adaptive precision selection and a multi-stage fallback ladder, which guarantees recovery to the exact dense attention output when required. Across PG-19, NIAH, and RULER benchmarks on LLaMA~3.1-8B with contexts up to 128K, the system matches dense FP16 KV quality within noise for language modelling and retrieval tasks, while recovering catastrophic failures observed in naive INT8/INT4 baselines. Value-sensitive tasks at short context expose a controlled trade-off between compression and fidelity, which can be eliminated via tighter value tolerances or FP16-value fallback. The certification is local (per-head, per-step) and does not guarantee end-to-end model correctness, but ensures that each attention computation is either bounded relative to an FP16 reference or exactly recovered via fallback. This reframes KV cache quantization as a runtime-verified computation rather than a fixed approximation. The goal is not raw speedups, but enabling safe deployment of aggressive KV compression under strict quality constraints.

</details>


### [244] [CAdam: Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation for 3D Gaussian Densification in Generative Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20872)
*SeungJeh Chung,Geonho Park,Misong Kim,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAdam（Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation）针对优化式生成蒸馏（Generative Distillation）中的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）致密化（densification）冗余问题，将基于梯度幅值累积的启发式判据重写为"统计信号验证"过程：以 Adam 一阶动量（世界坐标梯度 EMA + 偏置校正）利用相消/相长干涉分离几何漂移与随机噪声，配合分位数（分位排名）与内在 SNR 门控进行上下文自适应候选筛选，实现致密化软终止，并以选择性不透明度重置抑制噪声主导的高斯。在 SDS/ISM/VFDS 三类目标与 GaussianDreamer、LucidDreamer、GCS-BEG、FlowDreamer 等骨干上，高斯数量减少 85%–97%（如 1067K→143K、3373K→82K），存储同步下降约 8–40 倍，而感知质量总体持平（用户 2AFC 总体偏好 49.5% vs 50.4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 的自适应致密化（densification）是其表达能力的核心，但它是面向"重建"任务设计的：重建中监督来自固定真值视图，渲染图收敛后梯度幅值自然衰减，故"梯度幅值大"可可靠指示欠重建。而在优化式生成蒸馏（SDS/ISM/VFDS 等）中，监督是随机时间步、随机噪声、随机视角采样产生的伪目标（x̂₀ᵗ），优化不收敛（non-convergence），梯度方向高频震荡（作者称"zigzag 现象"）。若把梯度分解为确定性几何漂移 ḡₜ 与零均值噪声 ξₜ，由 L₂ 范数的凸性，累积量 A ≈ ‖ḡₜ‖ + (1/K)Σ‖ξₜ‖，噪声地板恒为正，导致任何固定阈值都无法同时避免"冗余高斯无限增殖"与"有效细化被抑制导致欠拟合"，作者称之为 Densification Dilemma（致密化困境）。此外周期性全局不透明度重置会污染动量统计。

Method: 方法分四部分：(1) 问题形式化：将每步位置梯度建模为 gₜ = ḡₜ + ξₜ，证明幅值累积无法分离信号与噪声。(2) Momentum-based Signal Verification：在世界坐标系（而非视空间）直接累积位置梯度向量，以 EMA 一阶动量 mₜ = β₁mₜ₋₁ + (1−β₁)gₜ 及偏置校正 m̂ₜ = mₜ/(1−β₁ᵗ) 估计一致漂移；新生高斯以其"年龄"作为步数 t 做校正。零均值噪声经相消干涉抵消，一致漂移经相长干涉累积，从而在细节区域即使幅值小也能凭方向一致性被检出。(3) Context-Adaptive Selection：分位数选择——当 ‖m̂ᵢ‖ 超过全场景动量范数的 τ_Q 分位（如 0.9）时进入候选，自动形成由粗到细的精化日程；SNR 选择——利用 Adam 二阶原始矩 v̂ₜ 构造内在信噪比 SNRₜ = ‖m̂ₜ‖₂ / (√‖v̂ₜ‖₁ + ε)，仅当 SNRₜ > τ_SNR 才致密化。两条件取交集：几何收敛时动量信号消失而方差项继续累积，SNR 自然跌破阈值，形成"软终止"。(4) Selective Structural Refinement：将"何时致密化"（统计一致性）与"如何修改几何"（Clone vs Split，仍按尺度阈值 ‖Sᵢ‖∞ 判定）解耦；并提出选择性不透明度重置，仅对预热后低 SNR 的不可靠基元将 α 置为 0.01，避免全局重置破坏动量历史与既有结构。默认超参 τ_Q = 0.9、τ_SNR = 0.1、β₁ = 0.9，动量/SNR 状态在每优化步在线更新，候选仅在原有 K 步致密化调度点筛选。

Result: 在单张 RTX A5000 (24GB) 上，50 个提示词（T3Bench、DreamFusion Gallery 及自建提示词，覆盖材质/结构/概念三类）上评测。定量（Table 1）：SDS 1067K→143K 高斯、46.4MB→6.1MB；ISM 1706K→81K、110.6MB→5.3MB；VFDS 3373K→82K、218.8MB→5.3MB，整体高斯数减少 85%–97%。质量指标大体持平：CLIP 略降（30.14→29.95、31.10→28.48、29.88→29.21），ImageReward 在三种目标下均提升（−0.125→−0.028、0.413→0.518、0.436→0.486），HPS v2 持平或微升，NIQE 部分场景变差。用户研究（30 人盲测 2AFC，跨三骨干）：总体偏好 49.5% vs 基线 50.4%，纹理细节 54.1% 优于基线 45.8%，清洁度 44.3% 低于 55.7%，即紧凑度大幅提升而感知质量基本相当。训练动态分析（图6）显示基线曲线由噪声主导并衰减至噪声地板、原语数爆炸性增长直至 OOM，而 CAdam 保持持续的结构信号并在小规模处饱和；目标掩码从粗形状激活转向选择性细节激活，印证软终止。消融（图7）显示：仅动量判据无法抑制后期增长导致 OOM；加入上下文自适应选择但去掉选择性不透明度重置会导致表示逐步过度抑制直至消失；阈值敏感性（图8）显示过高阈值欠致密化弱支撑细结构，过低阈值过致密化，默认为均衡工作点。跨 SDS/ISM/VFDS 及四骨干（GaussianDreamer、LucidDreamer、GCS-BEG、FlowDreamer）的一致表现证明其模型无关、即插即用。

Conclusion: CAdam 通过把致密化从"幅值启发式"重构为"统计信号验证"，利用动量的相消/相长干涉把几何漂移从生成噪声中解耦，再以分位数相对重要性与内在 SNR 绝对可靠性双重门控实现自调节致密化与软终止，从而在优化式生成蒸馏中以 85%–97% 的原语削减换取可比的感知质量，显著降低显存与存储开销。作者明确指出该方法并非免阈值：阈值过松会退化为基线式过致密化，过紧则欠致密化细薄、低对比结构；默认设置为稳定工作区间。残余失败主要源于生成骨干本身语义或跨视角信号不一致，属于密度控制之外的问题。局限在于仍需 τ_Q/τ_SNR 两个超参、SNR 基于 L2/L1 范数的近似、且质量指标（如 NIQE、CLIP）在部分设定下略有波动。

Abstract: Adaptive densification is the engine of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, when transposed to the optimization-based Generative Distillation paradigm, this reconstruction-native mechanism reveals fundamental limitations, resulting in inefficient representations cluttered with redundant primitives. We diagnose this failure as a Densification Dilemma stemming from the stochastic nature of generative guidance: the standard magnitude-based accumulation indiscriminately aggregates transient noise alongside geometric signals, making it difficult to strike a balance between over-densification and under-fitting. To resolve this, we introduce Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation (CAdam), a novel framework that reinterprets densification as a statistically grounded signal verification problem. CAdam leverages the first moment of gradients to exploit the interference principle, where stochastic fluctuations cancel out via destructive interference while consistent geometric drifts accumulate via constructive interference, effectively disentangling the underlying signal from the generative noise floor. This is further augmented by a quantile-based context awareness and an intrinsic Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) gating mechanism, which ensure robust adaptation across optimization stages and enable the soft termination of densification. Extensive experiments across diverse objectives (SDS, ISM, VFDS) and strong generative 3DGS backbones show that CAdam reduces Gaussian count by 85%-97% relative to standard densification while preserving overall comparable perceptual quality. These results highlight signal-aware density control as a practical way to improve memory efficiency in optimization-based generative distillation.

</details>


### [245] [CIG: Exploration via Conditional Information Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20878)
*Tim Joseph,Marcus Fechner,Philipp Stegmaier,Karam Daaboul,J. Marius Zöllner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件信息增益(CIG)奖励，通过对数行列式目标和集成disagreement kernel的Cholesky分解，解决了强化学习中探索奖励的不同条件集组合问题，在12个任务中验证了其优越性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探索奖励方法存在局限性：终身奖励忽略回合内冗余，阶段性奖励忽略终身进步，混合方法需要高斯过程动态模型无法扩展到高维状态空间，且轨迹级信息增益对深度模型不可处理。

Method: 推导出CIG奖励作为可处理替代方案：基于集成 disagreement kernel 的对数行列式目标，其Cholesky分解产生因果每步奖励，同时保留两种条件集（重放缓冲区和回合前缀），可扩展到高维状态空间。在基于模型的设置中实例化。

Result: 在12个任务（离散MiniGrid和连续控制OGBench）中，在干净和随机干扰设置下，CIG优于或匹配先前的探索方法。

Conclusion: CIG通过Cholesky分解实现因果每步奖励，在高维状态空间中保持可扩展性，在离散(MiniGrid)和连续控制(OGBench)共12个任务中优于或匹配先前的探索方法，并展现出对随机干扰物的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards for exploration in reinforcement learning condition on different contexts: lifelong rewards score each transition against accumulated experience but ignore within-rollout redundancy; episodic rewards penalize intra-trajectory repetition but discard lifetime progress. Hybrid methods combine both signals through heuristic weights or require Gaussian-process dynamics that do not scale beyond low-dimensional state spaces. Trajectory-level information gain decomposes into per-step terms that condition on the replay buffer and rollout prefix simultaneously, but remains intractable for deep models. We derive the Conditional Information Gain (CIG) reward as a tractable surrogate: a log-determinant objective over an ensemble disagreement kernel whose Cholesky factorization yields causal per-step rewards that retain both conditioning sets while scaling to high-dimensional state spaces. We instantiate CIG in a model-based setting, where rollouts are short and within-rollout corrections remain largely unexplored. Across twelve tasks spanning discrete (MiniGrid) and continuous control (OGBench), in both clean and stochastic-distractor settings, CIG outperforms or matches prior exploration methods while remaining robust to stochastic distractors.

</details>


### [246] [NeighborDiv: Training-free Zero-shot Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Neighbor Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20879)
*Kaifeng Wei,Teng Liu,Liang Dong,Xiubo Liang,Yuke Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeighborDiv proposes a novel Neighbor-to-Neighbor Diversity Paradigm for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection (GGAD), replacing the dominant Node-to-Neighbor Consistency approach with a training-free method that uses inter-neighbor feature similarity variance as the anomaly signal. It achieves state-of-the-art performance with zero training dependency and zero performance volatility.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing Generalist GAD (GGAD) methods predominantly rely on the Node-to-Neighbor Consistency Paradigm for anomaly quantification, which suffers from: (1) complex training pipelines, (2) heavy training data dependency, (3) high computational costs, and (4) unstable cross-domain generalization.

Method: NeighborDiv shifts from the Node-to-Neighbor Consistency Paradigm to the Neighbor-to-Neighbor Diversity Paradigm. It quantifies neighbor diversity via the variance of inter-neighbor feature similarities, capturing how a node organizes its local graph environment. As a training-free framework, it operates independently of conventional node-to-neighbor consistency mechanisms.

Result: Under two standard GGAD evaluation paradigms, NeighborDiv achieves state-of-the-art performance: (1) SDIT setting: 10.25% AUC improvement and 17.78% AP improvement over the second-best baseline; (2) UMDT setting: 6.89% AUC and 9.58% AP improvement. Notably, it yields zero performance volatility across all datasets.

Conclusion: NeighborDiv establishes a lightweight, highly practical GGAD framework that eliminates training-set dependency. It achieves zero performance volatility across all datasets, offering a robust alternative to training-dependent methods.

Abstract: Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) is increasingly shifting to Generalist GAD (GGAD) for cross-domain "one-for-all" detection, but existing GGAD methods predominantly rely on the neighbor consistency principle, falling into the \textbf{Node-to-Neighbor Consistency Paradigm} for anomaly quantification. These methods suffer from complex training pipelines, heavy training data dependency, high computational costs, and unstable cross-domain generalization. To address these limitations, we propose NeighborDiv, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework based on neighbor diversity. Departing from the dominant Node-to-Neighbor Consistency Paradigm, we shift the focus to the \textbf{Neighbor-to-Neighbor Diversity Paradigm}, and uncover that the internal structural dispersion of a node's neighbor set is a powerful, independently discriminative anomaly signal. We quantify neighbor diversity via the variance of inter-neighbor feature similarities, which captures how a node organizes its local graph environment, and operates independently of conventional node-to-neighbor consistency frameworks. Extensive experiments under two standard GGAD evaluation paradigms show NeighborDiv achieves state-of-the-art performance, with relative gains of 10.25% in average AUC and 17.78% in average AP over the second-best baseline under Single-Domain Independent Training (SDIT), and 6.89%/9.58% in AUC/AP under Unified Multi-Domain Training (UMDT), respectively. Notably, NeighborDiv yields zero performance volatility across all datasets, eliminating training-set dependency and establishing a lightweight and highly practical GGAD framework.

</details>


### [247] [Learning fMRI activations dictionaries across individual geometries via optimal transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20883)
*Sonia Mazelet,Rémi Flamary,Bertrand Thirion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 AGDL（Amortized Graph Dictionary Learning）：将融合 Gromov–Wasserstein（FGW）图字典学习与摊销最优传输相结合，用预训练 ULOT 神经网络以一次前向传播预测 FGW 传输计划（复杂度从 O(pqn³) 降至 O(pqn²)），并将字典原子显式建模为 FGW 权衡参数 α 的函数（线性插值与 MLP+softbin 两种形式），从而可在个体原生脑几何上直接学习可解释的 fMRI 字典，无需将所有被试配准到公共模板。在 HCP 数据集（1200 名被试、约 12000 张图、950 节点）上，模型能同时捕捉对比（任务）特异与被试特异信息：对比分类最优 α=0.22，被试分类最优 α=0.78。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI 字典学习是获得可解释脑活动表示的重要手段，但跨被试存在显著的个体解剖与功能组织变异。现有做法普遍把所有被试配准到公共模板（如 FreeSurfer fsaverage），这会引入不精确对应、扭曲个体组织，并丢弃个体几何信息，使表示难以兼顾泛化性与个体敏感性。已有基于 FGW 的图字典学习（Vincent-Cuaz et al., 2021）可比较不同几何的图，但 FGW 求解成本随节点数三次方增长，仅适用于几十节点的小图，无法用于含数百至上千脑区的大规模 fMRI 图；同时该框架针对固定 α 学习单一字典，探索不同特征/结构权衡需多次训练。此外，α 的选择对表示质量至关重要（α 决定字典捕捉几何变异还是特征变异），逐个 α 重新训练代价高昂。

Method: 方法框架：(1) 以 FGW 距离比较不同几何与不同节点数的图，损失含 Wasserstein 特征项与 Gromov–Wasserstein 结构项，α∈[0,1] 控制二者权衡；字典由 K 个原子 (F^D_k, C^D_k) 构成，样本重建为原子的凸组合（单纯形系数 ω，即嵌入），字典优化采用小批量随机梯度，交替进行解混（求嵌入）与字典原子更新。(2) 为解决可扩展性，用摊销优化训练 ULOT 神经网络（交叉注意力 + GCN，以 α 为条件）以无监督方式直接最小化 FUGW 损失来学习 FGW 传输计划近似；推理时单次前向传播得传输计划，复杂度 O(n1n2)，将整体复杂度由 O(pqn³) 降至 O(pqn²)；推理阶段取较大 ρ=0.9 以近似满足边缘约束。(3) 字典原子在公共 fsaverage 几何 C 上定义（保证跨被试可解释、可视化），而被试图保持原生几何，通过 OT 计划对齐以保留个体差异；由此问题化简为式 (5) 的逐被试加权最小二乘形式。(4) 字典显式依赖 α：模型一为端点原子线性插值 F^D = αF^D_0 + (1−α)F^D_1；模型二为以 softbin(α) 高维编码为输入的两层 MLP（隐层 16 维）输出原子，实现随 α 平滑演化、无需重训即可切换。实验设置：HCP 1200 被试、7 个任务（emotion/gambling/motor/relational/language/social/WM）、每被试至多 10 张对比图，Nilearn GLM 提取对比，Ward 算法聚类成图（节点特征=簇内平均对比值⊕三维坐标，边为测地距离），共约 12000 图、950 节点，70/15/15 划分被试；ULOT 预训练（每 epoch 采样 20 万对图、10^5 epoch、batch 64、lr 0.002、α~Beta(0.5,0.5)、ρ 对数均匀 [1e-7,1]，约 200 GPU 小时），随后冻结用于字典学习（K=40、batch 32、lr 0.001、1000 epoch、每 epoch 100 图、约 10 GPU 小时），基线为投影到 fsaverage 上的标准字典学习（最小二乘损失）。

Result: 重构结果保留了原始对比图的主要激活模式，同时更平滑、噪声更少；α 增大时原子更锐化，激活呈局部化分布且与所选对比（fear−neutral、right hand−average）一致，激活系数非二值，说明需多原子联合重构。嵌入空间的 t-SNE 显示同一对比的图聚成一簇（α=0.22），嵌入空间 PCA 沿主成分移动可还原不同被试的个体化重构。定量上：用高斯核 SVM 做对比分类，性能随 α 变化并在 α=0.22 达最优，说明特征与结构信息平衡才利于区分对比；AGDL 在对比分类上略低于 fsaverage 基线，作者归因于嵌入同时编码了个体几何信息（对对比分类是噪声），且 MLP 版本明显优于线性插值版本，说明需要更强表达力。SVC 做被试分类（10 名被试、跨对比测试、5 个随机种子）在 α=0.78 达最优，且与对比分类的最优 α 不同，t-SNE 显示 AGDL 的 SVC 分数按被试成簇，而基线不聚类，证明方法成功保留了被试特异的几何信息。原子激活分布显示全部原子均被广泛使用。

Conclusion: AGDL 首次实现了在大规模 fMRI 数据上、利用个体原生几何进行联合表示学习的可扩展 FGW 图字典学习方法，突破"配准到公共模板"的惯例，避免了功能与皮层几何紧耦合所致的偏差，在保留可解释性的同时捕捉任务特异与被试特异信息，并支持无额外开销地在任意 α 下获取字典。作者指出该工作为初步尝试，存在若干局限与后续方向：构建左右半球联合字典以改善主要激活于右半球的对比分类；放松原子几何固定假设以获得更具表达力的原子（但会牺牲表面几何这一可解释性关键）；进一步将原子与重构系数完全摊销化（网络直接由图输出嵌入），进一步降本并支持近实时处理。

Abstract: Dictionary learning is a powerful tool for creating interpretable representations. When applied to functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, the resulting patterns of brain activity can be used for various downstream tasks, such as brain state classification or population-level analysis. However, a major challenge is the variability in brain geometry across individuals. This is usually addressed by projecting each individual brain geometry onto a common template, which removes subject-specific information. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to dictionary learning on fMRI data that explicitly accounts for this variability. We use the optimal transport-based Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) distance to compare graphs with different geometries and features. To address the challenge of computing multiple FGW distances for large graphs such as those arising from fMRI data, we rely on amortized optimization to learn a neural network that predicts an approximation of the optimal transport plans, which substantially reduces the computational cost.
