Additionally, we learn dictionary atoms that depend on the FGW trade-off parameter, which controls the balance between feature alignment and structural consistency. Numerical experiments on the HCP dataset demonstrate that the proposed approach captures different levels of geometric variability in the data and provides representations that preserve essential information.

</details>


### [248] [Training distribution determines the ceiling of drug-blind cancer sensitivity prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20885)
*Taekyung Heo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究揭示精准肿瘤学中药物敏感性预测停滞的真正原因——标准评估指标(global Pearson r)存在缺陷，而非药物特征表示不足。通过重新设计评估指标(per-drug Pearson r)并进行对照实验，证明将作用机制(MoA)作为训练分布约束而非特征，可有效提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准肿瘤学中药物盲敏感性预测的性能停滞不前，研究者普遍认为是药物表示不够复杂所致，但本文质疑这一假设，试图找出性能停滞的真正原因。

Method: 1) 在四个独立数据集上比较全局Pearson r与药物内Pearson r指标；2) 设计对照实验，将MoA身份作为药物特征或训练分布约束两种方式进行比较；3) 测试机制分层训练和响应匹配两种部署策略。

Result: 全局Pearson r被药物效力差异主导，简单的药物均值预测器即可捕获；per-drug Pearson r显示现有药物编码均不优于仅使用细胞特征的模型；MoA作为特征几乎无效，但作为训练分布约束可显著提升靶向激酶抑制剂的预测性能。

Conclusion: 药物盲敏感性预测的性能瓶颈源于评估指标的人为因素，而非特征表示不足。机制分层训练和响应匹配是恢复预测能力提升的可行策略。

Abstract: Precision oncology requires predicting which drugs will suppress a specific tumor from its molecular profile, but drug-blind sensitivity prediction has plateaued despite increasingly complex drug representations. Here we show that this stagnation reflects a metric artifact rather than a representational bottleneck. The standard benchmark, global Pearson r, is dominated by between-drug potency differences that a trivial drug-mean predictor captures without any cell-specific learning. Per-drug Pearson r, which isolates within-drug cell ranking, reveals that no drug encoding improves over cell-only features across four independent datasets. A controlled experiment channeling mechanism-of-action identity as either a drug feature or a training-distribution constraint identifies the cause. Supplying MoA as a feature yields negligible benefit, whereas using it to stratify training raises per-drug r substantially for targeted kinase inhibitors, because pan-cancer co-training suppresses pathway-specific sensitivity signals. Mechanism-stratified training and response matching from pilot observations provide two deployable strategies that together recover the principal sources of predictive gain in drug-blind sensitivity prediction.

</details>


### [249] [Sutra: Tensor-Op RNNs as a Compilation Target for Vector Symbolic Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20919)
*Emma Leonhart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Sutra 是一门有类型、纯函数的编程语言，其编译产物（前向传播）是一个运行在冻结嵌入基底（frozen embedding substrate）之上的单一 PyTorch 张量算子图。作者主张：(1) 用拉格朗日插值多项式实现 Kleene 三值逻辑的与/或/非等连接词，在 {-1,0,+1} 真值网格上逐点精确且处处可微；(2) 编译器对整个程序做 β-归约（基元、控制流、字符串 I/O），融合为一条直线张量数据流图，条件语句降级为 soft-mux 多项式，尾递归循环降级为带软停机（soft-halt）的 RNN 单元；(3) 以基于内容哈希的 Haar 正交旋转矩阵作为绑定（bind）算子替代教科书式的 Hadamard 积；(4) 编译图天然可微，可用 autograd 直接训练，并把训练得到的标量参数烘焙回 .su 源码字面量。核心结论是：同一制品既是逻辑程序，又是可训练、可读、可重编译的神经网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文针对两个具体技术缺口展开。其一，VSA/HDC 经典绑定算子（Hadamard 积、循环卷积）假定超向量服从受控随机分布，而冻结的 LLM/蛋白 LM 嵌入空间高度各向异性（表征集中于窄锥、余弦动态范围被压缩），因此经典 bind/unbind 在真实嵌入上失效；需要重新确定「哪些嵌入操作足够可靠，可作为基底向量空间上的组合代数基元」以及「正确的绑定操作是什么」。其二，神经符号系统（Scallop、DeepProbLog、LTN、NeurASP）通常是「感知抽取离散符号 → 符号程序推理」两段式，可微性靠语义环或概率溯源标注实现；而 HDC 工具（TorchHD、OpenHD/HDTorch）只是库而非语言，没有源语言层、没有编译步骤、无法把控制流折叠进张量图，且字符串 I/O 需用户手工维护 codebook。作者希望把 VSA 操作提升为「语言基元 + 编译器目标」，让整个程序（连同逻辑部分）被 β 归约为单条融合张量算子图，从而可微、可训练，且训练结果以可读源码形式留存。同时，多项工作（Shaw et al. 2025 的范畴论 VSA 形式化）指出「纯函数式 VSA」是重要工程目标，作者声称 Sutra 是工程优先路径对该方向的一次独立实现。

Method: 方法由四部分技术贡献与一套验证协议组成。
(1) 多项式模糊逻辑：以真值轴 T=+1、U=0、F=−1 编码 Kleene 强三值逻辑，AND=min、OR=max、NOT=−· 在对角线 a=b 处不可微，破坏梯度流。作者用 3×3 网格上的拉格朗日插值把每个连接词写成多项式：AND=(a+b+ab−a²−b²+a²b²)/2，NAND/NOR 为其取反，OR=(a+b−ab+a²+b²−a²b²)/2，XOR=−ab、XNOR=ab（双线性，U 角为 0）。这些插值多项式在 9 个网格点上与经典 Kleene 逐位一致，格点外 C∞，可微、分支自由。代价是牺牲单调性（AND(0.5,0)=0.125，非单调隆起），作者明确接受该权衡。
(2) β 归约到基底纯（substrate-pure）张量图：五阶段流水线——词法/解析 → 内联 stdlib + egglog 化简（含公共子表达式消除）→ 代码生成（输出自包含 PyTorch 模块，运行时类以源码内联）→ 编译期基底填充（embed_batch、populate_sutradb、prewarm_rotation_cache）→ 执行。三个超出常规内联+常量折叠的动作：条件句降为 soft-mux 多项式 (1+cond)/2·a+(1−cond)/2·b，从而无 if 操作码；Haar 正交旋转 R_role 在编译期物化为常量张量，运行时 bind 只是一次常量矩阵 matmul；合成轴（real/imag/truth/char/loop-done 及 2D Givens 槽位）在编译期分配，使每次基元读写都是已知索引而非哈希表查找。扩展状态向量布局为 [语义块 | 合成块]，旋转矩阵在语义块 Haar 随机、在合成块为单位阵，使真值标量与语义向量可共存而不被 bind 涂抹。
(3) 尾递归作为循环基元：do_while/while_loop/iterative_loop/foreach_loop 的循环体为直线张量流水线，逐拍快照前置状态、在基底上求停机信号（truth 轴读出 → heaviside → 累积饱和求和 H_t → soft-mux 冻结状态），Python 层仅保留一个 while True 驱动以在 H_t 饱和时 break（循环机制中唯一的宿主端分支）。状态向量宽度固定：内存 O(1)、计算 O(N)、训练时 autograd tape O(N)。
(4) 合成维旋转绑定作为「角度哈希表」：R_role = QR(seed=hash(role)).Q 为 Haar 正交，bind(r,f)=R_r f，unbind 为转置；编译期预热缓存，运行时退化为一次矩阵乘。绑定未采用 Hadamard/循环卷积。
子语言前端：OCaml、TypeScript、Rust、Scala、Clojure、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell（OCaml 为参考实现，61 个 fixture，其余 21–31 个），均为 tree-sitter 源到源降级；条件/模式匹配/守卫降为 soft-mux 融合；尾递归归约为 while_loop 单元；可折叠的非尾递归经 CPS trampoline 承载；代数数据类型映射到标签轴/结构轴。
I/O：字符串字面量在编译期一次性嵌入存入 SutraDB（RDF 三元组 + HNSW 索引的嵌入式向量库，.sdb 文件随编译产物分发），输出边界用 nearest_string（argmax 余弦/HNSW ANN）解码。
验证协议分两条互为佐证的路径：(1) 容量实验——同一段程序在四个冻结基底（nomic-embed-text 768 维、all-minilm 384 维、mxbai-embed-large 1024 维、ESM-2 small 320 维；各用 84 条词汇/氨基酸序列）上跨 bundle 宽度 k∈{2,4,8,16,24,32,48} 做 10 次试验的 bundle→unbind→argmax-cosine 解码，与教科书 Hadamard 绑定对照；另做链式 bind/unbind 的串扰深度扫描（L∈{1,2,4,8,…}，bundle 宽 4，含 raw 与 snap 两种 cleanup 变体）与旋转往返误差测量。(2) 端到端可微训练——写一段纯 .su 的模糊规则分类器（similarity 与拉格朗日-Kleene AND/NOT 组合），由编译器生成 rule 函数（使用编译产物 _VSA.similarity，非手工重实现），对 5 类 50 词用全批量交叉熵 + Adam(lr=0.01) 反传原型向量；用 torch.vmap 批量化同一已编译函数，并断言批量与逐样本结果在 1e-4 内一致以证明快路径是同一计算。加权变体额外训练标量余弦增益 w，与原型联合训练后把 w* 写回 .su 为数值字面量、重编译并断言逐 logit 误差 <1e-4；再做消融（分别冻结增益/原型）以识别真正起作用的可学习因子。所有实验脚本位于 experiments/ 目录并附 JSON 结果与固定随机种子。

Result: 绑定算子对比（解码准确率）：k=8 时旋转绑定在四个基底上均 100%（nomic/all-minilm/mxbai/ESM-2），而 Hadamard 分别为 87.5%、7.5%、2.5%、28.7%；k=48 时旋转仍有 93.3%、42.3%、72.1%、44.2%，Hadamard 降至 48.3%、1.7%、1.0%、4.2%。信号余弦两者相当，差异来自 Hadamard 逐元素乘积带来的高噪声底（与码本中大量干扰项重叠）而非近正交。旋转往返误差均值 1.5e-15（浮点舍入量级）。
串扰深度：raw 解码在 L=2 前保持 100%（各基底），L=4 降至 5–20%，L=8 落到随机水平 1/84；snap（每步 argmax 硬清理）在 L>1 时反而更差（把软噪声转成高置信错误且不可恢复），故运行时不在算子间隐式 snap。
可微训练：5 类 50 词、30 epoch、3 种子，从随机初始化 18.7±9.5%（随机水平 20%）训练到 100.0±0.0%，交叉熵降至约 0.43；每个原型均获非零梯度，梯度路径确为编译器发出的 similarity → 发射的 NOT/AND → 交叉熵。批量化 vmap 路径约 230 s（CPU），逐样本 Python 驱动给出位相同结果但耗时约 6.2 h。
权重→可读源码：3 类 24 词、2 种子、30 epoch，从 33.3±5.9%（随机水平 33.3%）到 100.0±0.0%，学到标量增益 w*=1.434±0.004（两种子一致地从 1.0 上移，说明是锐化被压缩的余弦带而非恒等重标定）。烘焙为字面量 1.431431 的 .su 重编译后与参数化模型逐 logit 差异约 2e-7。消融显示：仅原型（w=1 冻结）即达 100%；仅增益（原型冻结）停在 33.3% 随机水平（w 漂移到约 0.42 但 argmax 不变），即类别可分性由原型承载，增益是共适应参数而非承重因子。

Conclusion: 论文的结论是：把「嵌入空间」当作编译目标架构（如同 C 面向 x86、CUDA kernel 面向 NVIDIA SM）可以统一 VSA 的代数操作与可微神经网络的计算图；只要让每个基元成为张量算子、把控制流降为可微插值、把循环降为软停机 RNN 单元，源级符号程序就能既作为逻辑程序执行，又通过 autograd 端到端训练，并把训练结果以可读、可重编译的源码形式留存——「同一制品既是逻辑程序又是可训练神经网络」。作者同时明确列出边界：组合深度限于单周期记录（L≤2，链式记录超出已验证区间）；所有数值仅在四个具体冻结基底上测得，大 bundle 宽度容量随基底差异显著且对任意嵌入模型不保证；编译期 codebook 为 O(词表) 规模，超大码本需未探索的 ANN 权衡；未与 Scallop/DeepProbLog 等神经符号系统在共享任务上做外部基准对比，也未做墙钟性能基准；绑定算子固定为内容哈希种子的 Haar 旋转，不含学习型/语义绑定；训练实验为样本内（无留出集），仅验证梯度可达性而非泛化；九种源语言前端仅为 fixture 级成熟度。指出这与 Shaw et al. (2025) 的范畴论 VSA 形式化（其中将「纯函数式 VSA」列为开放方向）殊途同归，说明该方向在结构上是自然的。

Abstract: Sutra is a typed, purely functional programming language whose compiled forward pass is a PyTorch neural network. The compiler beta-reduces the whole program -- primitives, control flow, string I/O -- to one fused tensor-op graph over a frozen embedding substrate. Rotation binding, unbind, bundle, polynomial Kleene three-valued logic, and tail-recursive loops all lower to tensor operations; the Kleene connectives are Lagrange-interpolated polynomials exact on the {-1, 0, +1} truth grid. Validation is one fact tested two ways. (1) The same program runs on four frozen embeddings spanning two modalities -- three text encoders (nomic-embed-text, all-minilm, mxbai-embed-large) and one protein language model (ESM-2) -- and decodes bundles at 100% accuracy through width k=8 on every substrate, where the textbook Hadamard product has already collapsed (2.5% on mxbai-embed-large, 7.5% on all-minilm). (2) PyTorch autograd flows through the actually compiled graph: a fuzzy-rule classifier written in .su trains from random init (18.7 +/- 9.5%; chance = 20%, five classes) to 100.0 +/- 0.0% (three seeds) by backpropagating through the emitted graph, the symbolic source unmodified. A weighted variant additionally trains a scalar cosine gain and writes it back into the .su source as a numeric literal; recompiling reproduces the trained behaviour to ~2e-7 per logit, so the trained model is itself legible, recompilable code. The same artifact is therefore both a logic program and a trainable neural network.

</details>


### [250] [Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20922)
*Jiawen Dai,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WONN（Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network）是一种基于广义 Winfree 同步动力学的振荡器架构：把每个神经元表示为相位振子，在环面 (S^1)^d 上演化表示，用「敏感度函数 S × 影响函数 I」的可分离交互（可固定三角映射或可学习 MLP）实现耦合，并通过分组（patch/group）交互与相位—频率双状态实现层次化信息流。它在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-100/1K 上以约一半或更少参数取得有竞争力甚至更优精度（ImageNet-1K 达 76.78%，据称是首个具竞争力的同步型振荡架构），在 Maze-hard 上以 0.396M 参数达 76.2%（能量投票后 80.1%），在 Sudoku 上以 1.58M 参数达 100% 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物与物理系统中，振荡与同步是组织集体动力学的基本机制（Buzsáki、von der Malsburg 的绑定理论、Kuramoto/Winfree 模型），被广泛视为感知绑定与表征形成的基础。然而机器学习中的同步类模型长期局限于对象中心/无监督对象发现等专用场景（如 Slot Attention、振荡网络类工作、AKOrN 的 Kuramoto 神经元），缺乏可扩展到 ImageNet-1K 这类标准视觉基准或迷宫寻路、数独这类组合推理任务的证据。论文据此提出核心问题：同步驱动的动力学能否成为可扩展且参数高效的前馈/Transformer 架构的替代方案？作者希望把「表征学习」重新理解为相互作用动力学状态的集体演化与自组织过程，而非静态特征变换的序列。

Method: **动力学基础**：经典 Winfree 模型 θ̇ᵢ = ωᵢ + (κ/N)S(θᵢ)ΣⱼI(θⱼ)，将交互分解为接收者的敏感度函数 S 与邻居的影响函数 I；相较仅依赖相位差的 Kuramoto 模型（保全局相位平移对称），WONN 允许引入 sin(θⱼ+θᵢ) 形式的破对称耦合（q≠0），并在 q=1 时等价于 S=cos、I=sin 的可分离三角形式。\n\n**状态与几何**：每个振荡子状态是相位角，d 个振子自然位于环面 (S^1)^d；计算在欧氏嵌入 (sinθ, cosθ) 中进行并通过 wrap/atan2 保持周期性。\n\n**双状态设计**：相位 Θ∈(S^1)^d 承载快速同步振荡，频率 Ω∈R^d 承载输入相关的信息（Ω⁽⁰⁾=f_init(x)，Θ⁽⁰⁾~N(0,σ²) 随机初始化）。层内做 T 步参数共享的离散 Winfree 演化，层间分别做 ThetaUpdate（权重绑定卷积作用于 (sinΘ, cosΘ) 后 atan2 映回）与 OmegaUpdate，从而分离快同步与慢特征演化的时间尺度。\n\n**结构化交互**：分组（grouped）Winfree——振荡子按 N×N 空间块聚合得到组级影响信号 I_patch，实现组内同步+组间协调的层次结构；N=1 退化为逐点交互（推理任务采用），N=2 用于视觉。耦合系数通过全局注意力实现（局部卷积耦合作为备选，参数量更大）；S、I 可选固定三角映射（强振荡先验）或可学习 MLP（更高表达力）。\n\n**能量结构**：对称耦合与三角交互下 E_int = -½Σ c_ij sinθᵢ sinθⱼ，动力学为「漂移+梯度流」θ̇=ω-γ∇E_int；天然频率项因非零环量构成拓扑障碍，故 E_int 在一般情形不是 Lyapunov 函数，但在 ω=0、对称耦合下是梯度流并给出 Lyapunov 结构；实践中 E_int 被用作同步程度/解质量的诊断量（迷宫任务中做能量投票选择最低能量的轨迹）。

Result: **视觉**：CIFAR-10 上 WONN 最佳 95.26%（11.84M），CIFAR-100 最高 76.20%（12.04M），均超过 ResNet-18/50、ViT-T/S/B（ViT 额外用了 CutMix/标签平滑等正则）以及 AKOrN（4.6M，72.03%）。ImageNet-100 最高 82.88%（12.05M）优于 ResNet-50 的 81.18% 与 ViT-S 的 77.96%。ImageNet-1K 上 WONN 达 76.78%（12.28M），与 ResNet-50（76.89%，25.56M）相当、优于 ResNet-18（69.73%）与 ViT-S/B（75.54/75.85%），显著优于 AKOrN（67.45%）；仅 MLP 参数化版本给出 1K 结果。\n\n**推理**：Maze-hard（30×30、难度>110、1000 训练/1000 测试）上 WONN 76.2%（0.396M），超过 HRM（74.5%，27M）与 AKOrN（36.2%），低于 TRM-Att（85.3%，7M）；能量投票（32 条随机初始化轨迹取最低 E_int）提升至 80.1%，参数量仅为 HRM 的 1.47%。数独上 WONN（T=16、1.58M）达 100%±0.0，优于 AKOrN（99.8%、2.98M）与 HRM（99.7%、27.28M）。LLM（DeepSeek-R1、Claude 3.7、O3-mini）在迷宫任务上均为 0%。\n\n**机制分析**：末层相位自发呈双峰分布（峰间隔约 π，未被显式监督），两个同步相位模分别响应粗粒度全局区域与细粒度局部边界，且随层深逐步从局部弱激活刷新为连贯语义响应；迷宫可视化显示早期产生多个弥散候选路径片段，随动力学推进相互竞争、抑制无效段、合并为单一最优路径（与 HRM 的「突然跃迁式」形成对比）；训练中交互能量下降与准确率上升呈反向相关，验证其作为解质量代理。\n\n**消融与工程开销**：更小的输入 patch 更好；MLP 与三角参数化各有所长（三角在小数据集略优、MLP 更大规模更有利）；加深层数 L、增大步数 T 提升精度但增加计算；N 需与参数化匹配（N=1 最优为三角情形）；注意力耦合比卷积耦合更省参数。ImageNet-1K 训练 WONN 用 4×H100、300 epoch 约 750 GPU 小时、约 35GB 聚合显存，优于 AKOrN 的 8×H200 约 950 GPU 小时与 110GB+ 显存。

Conclusion: 论文提出 WONN，把广义 Winfree 同步动力学实例化为可扩展的神经架构，结合可分离交互参数化、分组层次化耦合与相位—频率双状态设计，在感知与组合推理两类任务上同时取得有竞争力精度与显著参数效率，并首次将同步型振荡架构扩展到具竞争力的 ImageNet-1K 规模（Maze-hard 以约 1% 参数量达 80.1%）。其贡献在于证明「振荡同步」可以是可规模化的高效计算范式，并给出可解释的内部表征现象（自发双峰相位组织、多片段—单路径的同步式搜索）。局限与未来方向：递归动力学步数带来高于 ResNet/ViT 的计算开销，尚未探索更大规模模型与语言模型；作者亦明确指出能量/Lyapunov 论证仅适用于三角可分离子情形，不能视为完整模型的全局稳定性定理；此外更大规模、连续时间动力学与更深入的几何/稳定性理论仍待研究。

Abstract: Oscillations and synchronization are widely believed to play a fundamental role in representation and computation. However, existing machine learning approaches based on synchronization dynamics have largely been confined to specialized settings such as object discovery, with limited evidence of scalability to standard vision benchmarks or logic reasoning tasks. We propose the Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN), a dynamical neural architecture based on generalized Winfree dynamics. WONN evolves representations on the torus $(S^1)^d$ through structured oscillatory interactions, combining phase-based inductive biases with flexible and hierarchical interaction mechanisms instantiated as either fixed trigonometric mappings or learnable neural networks. We evaluate WONN on image recognition and complex reasoning tasks, including CIFAR, ImageNet, Maze-hard, and Sudoku. Across these domains, WONN achieves competitive or superior performance with strong parameter efficiency. In particular, WONN is, to our knowledge, the first synchronization-based oscillatory architecture to scale competitively to ImageNet-1K. Furthermore, on Maze-hard, WONN achieves 80.1% accuracy using only 1% of the parameters of prior state-of-the-art models. These results suggest that structured oscillatory dynamics provide a scalable and parameter-efficient alternative to conventional neural architectures.

</details>


### [251] [Choose Wisely and Privately: Proactive Client Selection for Fair and Efficient Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20975)
*Adda Akram Bendoukha,Heber Hwang Arcolezi,Nesrine Kaaniche,Aymen Boudguiga*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种主动式客户端选择框架，通过差分隐私 contingency 表计算互信息来量化跨特征相关性，在训练前寻找数据效用和公平性达到最优平衡的客户端联盟。实验表明该方法在四个基准数据集上优于均匀采样和最先进的自适应聚合策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于平均的联邦学习受非独立同分布(non-IID)数据限制，导致收敛速度慢和模型精度下降。现有方法存在效率低下问题——噪声或高度异构数据客户端的梯度计算被丢弃或大幅降权，造成计算资源浪费、更多通信轮次和不必要的隐私暴露。传统方法是被动的，本文认为应主动在训练前选择最优客户端组合。

Method: 1. 利用差分隐私 contingency 表计算互信息，量化联合数据集中跨特征相关性；2. 提出潜在联邦损失(Potential Federation Loss, PFL)函数，同时最大化数据效用并确保公平的跨特征相关性以防止群体不公平；3. 将客户端选择表述为 PFL 目标上的最优子集搜索问题；4. 使用模拟退火算法在强差分隐私保证下求解。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，通过最优联邦训练的模型具有更快的收敛速度、更公平的跨特征相关性和更高的准确率，优于均匀采样以及先进的自适应聚合或采样策略。

Conclusion: 通过主动的客户端选择而非被动的聚合权重调整，可以更高效地构建联邦学习系统，在保证差分隐私的前提下实现更快的训练、更公平的模型和更高的准确率。该框架为非IID数据环境下的联邦学习提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across decentralized data sources without data transfer. Averaging-based FL is limited by the presence of non-IID data, which negatively impacts convergence speed and final model accuracy. Conventional alternatives suffer from significant inefficiency. Clients with noisy or highly heterogeneous data contribute expensive gradient computations that are either discarded or heavily down-weighted before aggregation. These reactive approaches waste computational resources, require more communication rounds and result in unnecessary privacy exposure. In this paper, we propose a proactive client selection framework that aims to find an optimal federation of clients whose combined data match utility and fairness requirements before training begins. Our method relies on mutual information computed from differentially private contingency tables to quantify the relevance of cross-feature correlations in the union dataset. We introduce a Potential Federation Loss (PFL) over the set of fixed-size federations, which balances two objectives. Maximizing collective data utility while ensuring fair cross-features correlations to prevent group unfairness. Client selection is expressed as an optimal subset search problem over the PFL objective, which we solve using simulated annealing under strong differential privacy guarantees for clients' local statistics. Experimental results on four benchmarks show faster, fairer, and more accurate models trained on optimally found federations, compared to uniform sampling, even when state-of-the-art adaptive aggregation or sampling strategies are employed.

</details>


### [252] [Point Cloud Sequence Encoding for Material-conditioned Graph Network Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20978)
*Philipp Dahlinger,Balázs Gyenes,Niklas Freymuth,Luca Geminiani,Tobias Würth,Johannes Mitsch,Nadja Klein,Luise Kärger,Gerhard Neumann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PEACH（Point Cloud Encoding for Accurate Context Handling）提出一种基于点云的上下文学习框架：用新型时空（4D 空间-时间）点云序列编码器将若干条观测点云序列压缩为隐式材料描述符，再以可学习的 softmax 聚合为单一任务级向量，条件化基于 MaNGO 的轨迹级图网络模拟器，从初始网格一次前向预测完整网格轨迹；并配合两项辅助监督（物理参数回归 + SDF 重建）与点云数据增强，从而无需测试时优化即可对未见材料参数泛化，并在真实"蹦床"场景实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图网络模拟器（GNS）虽可微、速度比传统有限元求解器快数个数量级，但默认已知刚度、黏度等材料参数，材料一变就退化为参数辨识问题：逐实例系统辨识或可微求解器反演代价高、目标非凸且病态。已有元学习/上下文方法（如 MaNGO）通过编码网格轨迹得到材料描述符，但网格轨迹在真实场景难以获取（需侵入式标记或依赖先验的模板配准），且真实点云缺乏跨帧点对应关系，使参数估计更困难。因此需要一种仅用深度相机/LiDAR 点云即可实现材料感知适应、无需测试时优化的通用条件化模拟器。

Method: 问题设定：同一族物理系统共享控制方程但材料属性 ρ 不同，训练时用 FEM 生成真值网格轨迹并用虚拟相机光线投射得到点云轨迹；推理时仅给出 1~8 条上下文点云序列与初始网格 G0。

（1）条件化流程（CNP 扩展）：每条点云序列 P_i∈R^{T×N×3} 经时空编码器得 r_c ∈ R^{d}；用逐元素 softmax 的可学习逆温度 β 加权聚合 r = Σ α_c ⊙ r_c，支持可变上下文数量；r 与 G0 一起输入可微网格模拟器预测完整轨迹，端到端反传。

（2）时空点云序列编码器：把序列视为 4D（3D 空间 + 时间）点云，τ 为时间缩放因子（τ→0 忽略时间，τ→∞ 各帧独立）；在时空坐标上用 FPS 采样 M 个 patch 中心、KNN 提取 patch；对时空坐标做多频带 Fourier 特征编码并拼接物体类型特征；用 PointMAE 风格 tokenizer（类似 PointNet 的 max-pool）得 patch 嵌入 s，patch 中心经 MLP 得位置嵌入 c，token t=s+c；经单层 Transformer 自注意力细化后，用可学习查询 token 的注意力池化输出序列级 r_i。实验发现单层 Transformer 已优于更深结构。

（3）MaNGO 轨迹级 GNS 骨干：将整条轨迹表示为单一静态图，含时间索引的节点/边特征，初始特征与条件变量广播到各时刻并加可学习时间嵌入，K 轮消息传递（MLP）后接沿时间维的 1D 残差 CNN，按逐时刻 MSE 损失监督。

（4）辅助监督（仅训练时）：a) 轻量 MLP 解码器 ρ̂=MLP(r) 做材料参数回归，把隐空间锚定到物理量；b) SDF 重建损失——对采样查询点在 4D 时空中找 K_SDF 个最近 patch token，Fourier 编码相对位置、注意力 MLP 预测邻居权重（按归一化距离偏置），加权聚合后 MLP 解码有符号距离，用 tanh(α·f) 归一化目标 + 平滑 ℓ1 损失；动机是让 tokenizer 保留细粒度几何信息。

（5）数据增强：多尺度高斯噪声、结构化区域 dropout、场景包围盒内均匀采样的伪点（模拟传感器失效与重建噪声），弥合仿真-真实点云差距。

（6）基线：点云上下文（PSTNet、GNN Encoder）、网格上下文（MaNGO）、Oracle（真值参数作为节点特征）、No Context，以及将骨干换成步进式 MeshGraphNet 的变体；辅助损失消融、上下文规模消融、OOD（泊松比分布尾部）测试与 PCA 隐空间可视化。

Result: 仿真：四个场景（Deforming Block、Sheet Deformation、Bending Beam、Trampoline）上以 8 条上下文评测全 rollout MSE，PEACH 在所有点云上下文方法中大幅领先；在 4 个环境中的 3 个超过使用特权网格上下文的 MaNGO（归因于 MaNGO 编码器为浅层 CNN + Deep Sets，容量有限）；在 Bending Beam 上甚至超过 Oracle（隐式嵌入可同时编码梁厚等几何量与标量材料参数）；步进式 MGN 骨干即使给 Oracle 也不及轨迹级 MaNGO。

消融：去掉两项辅助损失性能显著下降，说明辅助监督对学习有用材料表征至关重要；仅用 SDF 辅助损失已具竞争力（无需真值物理参数，实用性强）；去除数据增强在真实蹦床的弹跳后阶段精度变差。OOD 实验中 PEACH 仍接近 Oracle 表现，说明隐式材料表征可外推。隐空间 PCA 显示第一主成分按松弛时间分离、第二按载荷比（质量/(E·厚度)）分离，自发解耦出有物理意义的结构，单参数环境呈近一维流形。

真实场景：Franka 机械臂释放不同材质/密度钢球与 PLA 球到不同厚度乳胶膜（Zed Mini 立体相机 + FoundationStereo 深度），PEACH 从未见过真实点云训练却能适应球的尺寸/重量与膜厚，峰值拉伸时刻形变准确；No Context 退化为均值预测（几乎无形变）；在接触阶段（0.12–0.28 s）基线误差显著增大而 PEACH 最优，甚至优于实测参数的 Oracle 基线；后期所有方法误差上升，源于弹跳后混沌动力学。效率：编码 84 ms（1 条上下文）至 219 ms（8 条），rollout 约 352 ms，而 FEM 单次 rollout 需约 4 分钟；模型共 3.96 M 参数（3.01 M 模拟器 + 0.96 M 编码器与辅助头），单次前向完成材料辨识。

Conclusion: PEACH 通过点云而非网格作为上下文，实现了对未知/未见材料的免测试时优化的自适应网格级物理模拟：其核心贡献是 4D 时空点云序列编码器（可泛用于任意点云序列操作）与物理参数回归 + SDF 两类辅助监督。方法在四个仿真数据集上达到与网格方法持平甚至更优的精度（包括超越 Oracle），并完成真实蹦床场景的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移，具备工程部署价值。局限与未来方向：需已知初始几何（可由观测重建以放宽假设）；假设上下文轨迹与目标过程共享物理属性（在线累积上下文可应对材料漂移）；单次前向预测整条轨迹带来长序列/高分辨率网格的内存约束，可用稀疏关键帧+插值网络解耦；可扩展温度、触觉等其他传感模态以提升参数估计。数据驱动特性意味着在训练分布外的材料/几何/工况下精度下降，存在静默失效风险，建议在决策关键场景前先行验证。

Abstract: Graph Network Simulators (GNSs) have emerged as powerful surrogates for complex physics-based simulation, offering inherent differentiability and orders-of-magnitude speedups over traditional solvers. However, GNSs typically assume access to the underlying material parameters, such as stiffness or viscosity, severely limiting their utility in realistic experimental settings. While recent meta-learning approaches address the parameter dependency by inferring properties from mesh trajectories, reconstructing a mesh from an observed scene is challenging. In this work, we introduce Point Cloud Encoding for Accurate Context Handling (PEACH), a novel framework that applies in-context learning on point clouds to adapt a learned simulator to unseen physical properties during inference. Our approach relies on a novel spatio-temporal point cloud sequence encoder, as well as two forms of auxiliary supervision to help improve simulation fidelity. We demonstrate that PEACH is capable of accurate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a challenging, dynamic scene. Experiments on simulation scenes show that PEACH even outperforms mesh-based baselines on prediction accuracy, while being much more practical for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [253] [A Sharper Picture of Generalization in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20988)
*Paul Lintilhac,Sair Shaikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从PAC-Bayes理论角度研究Transformer在布尔函数上的泛化行为，证明稀疏低阶谱函数可构造平坦最小值并获得非平凡泛化界，并通过经验评估和机械可解释性研究验证理论构建的现实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究（Edelman等2022; Trauger和Tewari 2024）使用Rademacher复杂度推导泛化界，存在一定局限性。本文探索通过PAC-Bayes理论获得泛化界的新路径，以更深入理解Transformer的泛化机制。

Method: 1. 证明稀疏谱（集中在低阶分量）可实现平坦最小值构造；2. 对理想化低锐度学习器应用PAC-Bayes界；3. 进行经验评估和机械可解释性研究验证理论构建在真实Transformer中的现实性。

Result: 成功获得非平凡（non-vacuous）的泛化界，验证了稀疏谱函数与良好泛化性能之间的关联。

Conclusion: PAC-Bayes理论可有效用于分析Transformer在布尔域上的泛化行为，稀疏谱集中于低阶分量是实现平坦最小值和良好泛化的关键因素。

Abstract: We study transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains from the perspective of the Fourier Spectra of their target functions. In contrast to prior work (Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger and Tewari, 2024), which derived generalization bounds from Rademacher complexity, we investigate the feasibility of obtaining generalization bounds via PAC-Bayes theory. We show that sparse spectra concentrated on low-degree components enable low-sharpness constructions with good generalization properties. Our idea is to show the existence of flat minima implementing any boolean function of sparsity no greater than the context length, and then apply a PAC-Bayes bound to an idealized low-sharpness learner, resulting in a non-vacuous generalization bound. We evaluate predictions empirically and conduct a mechanistic interpretability study to support the realism of our theoretical construction in real transformers.

</details>


### [254] [Modeling Temporal scRNA-seq Data with Latent Gaussian Process and Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20989)
*Mehmet Yigit Balik,Harri Lähdesmäki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究针对单细胞RNA测序数据中时间进程推断的挑战，提出了一种结合异方差高斯过程、最优传输和细胞特异性时间建模的生成式框架，有效解决了现有方法的过拟合问题，并实现了最先进的轨迹推断性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单细胞RNA测序的静态快照数据推断时间进程是一个基础性挑战，当前基于神经微分方程和流的方法对过拟合敏感，且缺乏对生物变异性的仔细考虑。

Method: 提出生成式框架，使用Hilbert空间方法近似潜在异方差高斯过程(GP)建模人群趋势；利用最优传输(OT)目标对齐生成与观测的人群分布；通过整合细胞特异性潜在时间和细胞类型条件来捕获生物异质性，从而解耦时间异步性和到不同细胞类型的轨迹。

Result: 在复杂插值和外推基准测试中展示了最先进的性能，并引入了一种新颖的基于梯度的策略用于推断扰动轨迹。

Conclusion: 该方法成功解决了过拟合问题，并在复杂插值和外推基准测试中展示了最先进的性能，同时引入了用于推断扰动轨迹的梯度策略，为单细胞时间进程推断提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing provides insights into gene expression at single-cell resolution, yet inferring temporal processes from these static snapshot measurements remains a fundamental challenge. Current approaches utilizing neural differential equations and flows are sensitive to overfitting and lack careful considerations of biological variability. In this work, we propose a generative framework that models population trends using a latent heteroscedastic Gaussian process (GP) approximated by Hilbert space methods. To address the absence of genuine cell trajectories, we leverage an optimal transport (OT) objective that aligns generated and observed population distributions. Our method explicitly captures biological heterogeneity by incorporating cell-specific latent time and cell type conditioning to disentangle temporal asynchrony and trajectories to different cell types. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on complex interpolation and extrapolation benchmarks and introduce a novel gradient-based strategy for inferring perturbation trajectories.

</details>


### [255] [Beyond the Bellman Recursion: A Pontryagin-Guided Framework for Non-Exponential Discounting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20996)
*Hojin Ko,Jeonggyu Huh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对非指数折扣场景下Bellman递归失效的问题，提出PG-DPO框架，通过变分方法结合Pontryagin最大值原理和Monte Carlo rollout，实现有效策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Bellman-style递归在非指数折扣（如人类偏好和生存过程中的双曲折扣）下会失效。问题根源在于指数折扣依赖于乘性性和时间齐次性的脆弱平衡，破坏任一特性都会导致标准动态规划崩溃。

Method: 提出了Pontryagin引导的直接策略优化(PG-DPO)方法，将变分框架与Pontryagin最大值原理相结合，通过Monte Carlo rollout和Adjoint-MC投影实现逐点Hamiltonian最大化，摒弃了传统的Bellman递归结构。

Result: 在多维双曲折扣和生存折扣基准测试中，PG-DPO相比方程驱动求解器和基于critic的基线方法，在准确性和稳定性方面均有显著提升。

Conclusion: PG-DPO demonstrates superior performance on multi-dimensional hyperbolic and survival-discount benchmarks, showing improved accuracy and stability where equation-driven solvers and critic-based baselines fail to converge.

Abstract: Most value-based and actor--critic reinforcement learning methods rely on Bellman-style recursions, yet these recursions collapse under non-exponential discounting common in human preferences and survival processes. We show the breakdown is structural: exponential discounting sits at a fragile intersection of multiplicativity and time homogeneity, and violating either property breaks standard dynamic programming. To overcome this, we propose Pontryagin-Guided Direct Policy Optimization (PG-DPO), a variational framework that abandons recursion and couples the Pontryagin Maximum Principle with Monte Carlo rollouts via an Adjoint-MC projection enforcing pointwise Hamiltonian maximization. Across multi-dimensional hyperbolic and survival-discount benchmarks, PG-DPO improves accuracy and stability where equation-driven solvers and critic-based baselines diverge.

</details>


### [256] [A Dialogue between Causal and Traditional Representation Learning: Toward Mutual Benefits in a Unified Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21058)
*Yan Li,Yuewen Sun,Shaoan Xie,Gongxu Luo,Yunlong Deng,Kun Zhang,Guangyi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个统一的形式化框架，将表征学习解构为任务组件和约束组件，以弥合因果表征学习与传统表征学习之间的鸿沟，实现双向优势互补，并通过对CausalVerse数据集的实验验证了任务设计对因果约束效果的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果表征学习(CRL)与传统表征学习因发展轨迹不同而存在鸿沟：传统方法由应用驱动、关注经验目标，而CRL侧重理论问题尤其是可辨识性。这种关注点差异导致术语、问题形式化和评估方法的分歧，限制了跨领域交流并造成工作重复或脱节。

Method: 提出统一形式化框架，将表征学习分解为任务组件（指定学习表征需保留的信息）和约束组件（在潜在空间施加的结构），从而在统一框架下整合两种学习范式。

Result: 在CausalVerse数据集上的实验表明，不同任务组件与结构化约束的组合对CRL方法的行为产生显著影响，因果约束的有效性高度依赖于其配套任务的设计。

Conclusion: 提出了统一框架来弥合因果表征学习与传统表征学习之间的鸿沟，通过任务组件和约束组件的统一形式化，实现了双向互利——因果表征学习提供理论工具理解结构化潜在约束的价值，传统表征学习则提供任务设计和目标选择的实践洞察。实验结果表明因果约束的有效性高度依赖于其配套任务的选择。

Abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) and traditional representation learning have largely developed along different trajectories. Traditional representation learning has been driven mainly by applications and empirical objectives, whereas CRL has focused more on theoretical questions, particularly identifiability. This difference in emphasis has created a gap between the two fields in terminology, problem formulation, and evaluation, limiting communication and sometimes leading to disconnected or redundant efforts. In this paper, we argue that these two fields should be brought into dialogue rather than treated as separate paradigms. To this end, we introduce a unified formulation in which the representation learning is characterized by two components: a task component, which specifies what information the learned representation is required to preserve, and a constraint component, which specifies what structure is imposed on the latent space. Under this formulation, the benefits run in both directions. CRL provides theoretical tools for understanding when structured latent constraints are useful or necessary, while traditional representation learning offers practical insights on task design and objective choice that can improve the development of CRL methods. To illustrate this interaction, we experimentally study how different task components affect the behavior of CRL methods under different structured constraints. Results on CausalVerse show that the effectiveness of causal constraints depends strongly on the tasks with which they are paired.

</details>


### [257] [Divide et Calibra: Multiclass Local Calibration via Vector Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21060)
*Cesare Barbera,Lorenzo Perini,Giovanni De Toni,Andrea Passerini,Andrea Pugnana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于向量量化的组合校准方法，通过结构化划分潜在空间和跨区域参数共享，解决多分类模型校准中异质性误差捕获与信息保留的难题，实现局部校准性能提升而不牺牲全局性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多类校准方法存在局限性：全局方法假设校准误差在潜在空间中均匀分布，而局部方法通常依赖潜在空间降维，导致信息丢失。因此需要一种既能捕捉异质性校准误差又能避免信息损失的方法。

Method: 通过向量量化(VQ)诱导表示空间的结构化划分，结合基于码字的Dirichlet浓度参数化实现跨区域参数共享，构建区域特定的校准映射。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在局部校准方面显著提升，同时在全局校准和预测性能上保持竞争力，即使在潜在空间稀疏区域也有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: The proposed VQ-based compositional calibration approach achieves significant improvements in local calibration while maintaining competitive global calibration and predictive performance across benchmark datasets.

Abstract: Accurate and well-calibrated Machine Learning (ML) models are mandatory in high-stakes settings, yet effective multiclass calibration remains challenging: global approaches assume calibration errors are homogeneous across the latent space, while local methods often rely on latent-space dimensionality reduction, which leads to information loss. To address these issues, we propose a compositional approach to multiclass calibration, where region-specific calibration maps are constructed from shared codeword-dependent factors. We instantiate this idea via Vector Quantization (VQ), which induces a structured partition of the representation space, and an indexed parameterization of Dirichlet concentrations that enables parameter sharing across regions. Our approach learns heterogeneous calibration maps that generalize well even to sparse regions of the latent space. Experiments on benchmark datasets show significant improvements in local calibration while maintaining competitive global calibration and predictive performance.

</details>


### [258] [Robust Personalized Recommendation under Hidden Confounding in MNAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21066)
*Zongyu Li,Wanting Su,Tianyu Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向隐混杂（hidden confounding）推荐的个性化去偏框架 PUID 及其基准引导变体 BPUID。核心思路是：不再沿用 RD 类方法"全局统一敏感度界"的同质性假设，而是利用基于熵/信息增益的方法，从纯观测数据中为每个 user–item 交互估计个性化敏感度参数 Γ_{u,i}，据此构造个性化逆倾向权重不确定集 𝒲_P，并在 IPS/DR 目标函数中进行最坏情况对抗优化；BPUID 进一步将预训练基线模型作为锚点，以增量风险形式优化，稳定并提升精度。三组公开数据（KuaiRec、Coat、Yahoo!R3）实验表明，PUID/BPUID 在隐混杂与不同掩蔽率设定下整体优于 MF、IPS、DR、RD、BRD、Multi-IPS/Multi-DR 等基线，且无需 RCT 数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统依赖观测到的用户-物品交互数据，存在严重的 MNAR 选择偏差（用户只对喜欢的物品打分）。经典的 EIB、IPS、DR 估计量依赖"所有混杂可观测"假设，仅能校正已观测混杂（observed confounding）；一旦存在同时影响曝光与反馈的未观测混杂（如用户收入、意图、人口属性），基于已观测特征估计的倾向分与真实倾向分偏离，IPS/DR 即使倾向模型与插补模型都正确也仍然有偏。现有应对方案有两类局限：(1) 依赖 RCT/A-B 测试数据融合的方法（如 KDRec、AutoDebias、MetaDebias、balancing 方法）数据采集成本高、有时涉及伦理争议，且均匀/无偏样本量小、教师模型方差大、缺乏理论依据；(2) 基于敏感度分析的方法（代表 RD）只能使用单一全局界 Γ，隐含"所有交互的混杂强度同质"的假设，忽略了混杂强度随用户/物品属性完备度而异的事实——属性稀疏的实体被系统性低估修正，属性丰富的实体被过度修正，从而在"鲁棒性—信息量"权衡上过于保守或过于松散。因此需要一个既不依赖 RCT 数据、又能刻画 user–item 层级混杂异质性的去偏框架。

Method: 1) 个性化敏感度界估计：假设同类变量（观测特征与隐藏混杂）对曝光熵的贡献成比例，据此写出熵差比约束（Ratio_1、Ratio_2 > 0），并以可观测信息增益的加权和作为隐藏混杂影响的代理量：Γ_{u,i} = α[Ĥ(o)-Ĥ(o|x_u)] + β[Ĥ(o|x_u)-Ĥ(o|x_u,x_i)]，α、β≥0 分别控制用户侧/物品侧权重；条件熵用自适应混合分箱（Adaptive Hybrid Binning）离散化估计，多变量特征在联合离散空间上分箱。2) 个性化不确定集：由 Γ_{u,i} 得逆真实倾向的个性化区间 ã=1+(1/p-1)/Γ_{u,i}、b̃=1+(1/p-1)·Γ_{u,i}，构成 𝒲_P（对比 RD 的全局 𝒲）。3) 对抗优化目标：在 𝒲_P 上取最坏情况分别构造 PUID-IPS（max Σ o·e·w̃）、PUID-DR（max Σ [ê + o(e-ê)w̃]）与对抗插补损失 L^Imp（max Σ (ê-e)²·w̃），预测模型 φ 与插补模型 θ 交替优化。4) BPUID：先用基线 DR 模型得到基准参数 φ̂⁽⁰⁾、θ̂⁽⁰⁾，把损失改写为相对基准的增量形式（IPS 用 e(φ)-e(φ̂⁽⁰⁾)，DR 用插补项与残差项的差分），使 L_BPUID(φ̂⁽⁰⁾)=0 且 min L ≤ 0，从而保证不劣于基准；附录给出理论：假设混杂偏差函数 Lipschitz 连续、满足 Rosenbaum 敏感度模型、损失方差有界，推得 BPUID 最坏偏差界 C(Γ-1)‖Δe‖∞ 优于 PUID 的 CΓ‖e‖∞，以及泛化界 R(φ*) ≤ R(φ⁽⁰⁾) + L‖φ*-φ⁽⁰⁾‖ - δ + sqrt(2σ²log(2/η)/n) 与精度改进的充要条件。5) 骨干网络：统一的特征感知 MF-MLPs（用户/物品特征经两层 MLP+ReLU 映射到共享隐空间，点积加用户/物品偏置），所有对比方法共用以保证架构一致。6) 实验协议：KuaiRec 用相关分析（阈值 0.9）去冗余并离散化得到 19 个物品侧、14 个用户侧特征；Coat/Yahoo!R3 无侧信息，用 MF 生成 64/32 维伪特征再 K-Means 离散为 4 类；按估计倾向分对无偏交互做 Bernoulli 抽样构造有偏训练集（KuaiRec 740,271 条），再随机掩蔽 10/20/50/80% 模拟不同程度的隐混杂/稀疏；指标为 UAUC 与 NDCG@5（Coat、Yahoo!R3）/NDCG@50（KuaiRec）。

Result: (RQ1) 在 Coat 上 PUID-IPS 取得组内最佳 UAUC 0.6763 / NDCG@5 0.6182，PUID-DR 0.6843/0.6169；Yahoo!R3 上 PUID-DR 达 UAUC 0.6178、NDCG@5 0.5753（BPUID-DR 0.6177/0.5745 几乎持平）；KuaiRec 上 PUID-DR UAUC 0.7677、BPUID-DR 0.7724、NDCG@50 最高，优于 RD/BRD/Multi 系列。总体上个性化敏感度界优于全局界方法（RD/BRD），单任务设计优于 Multi-IPS/Multi-DR 的多任务方案（后者存在任务冲突与特征稀释，在稀疏数据上退化明显）。(RQ2) 掩蔽率 0.1→0.8 递增时，PUID-IPS/BPUID-IPS、PUID-DR/BPUID-DR 在各掩蔽块内整体优于 RD-IPS/RD-DR/BRD；PUID 在数据充足时凭细粒度个性化占优，BPUID 借基准引导的方差控制在高稀疏（0.8 掩蔽）下更稳健，例如 Coat 掩蔽 0.8 时 BPUID-IPS UAUC 0.6419 vs RD-IPS 0.6270。(RQ3/RQ4) 在 ML-100k 上的合成实验中，16 组 R(x_u)、R(x_i) 组合下 Ratio_1 与 Ratio_2 全部为正（用户侧 0.12–33.42），证实观测与隐藏混杂对曝光熵的削减方向一致、幅度成比例；随隐藏用户/物品特征数量增加，信息增益 ΔH 单调上升，验证以特征基数刻画隐混杂强度的可行性。(RQ5 消融) Coat 上：去掉侧特征反而提升 IPS 表现（稀疏数据中侧信息引入噪声），而 DR 对侧特征不敏感；(α,β) 对 IPS 影响显著（更大的 α、β 在稀疏场景更有利），对 DR 影响微弱；个性化界一致优于 RD 的全局随机界。

Conclusion: PUID 首次在 user–item 层级建模隐藏混杂强度：把隐混杂的影响视为观测特征无法解释的曝光不确定性部分，用离散化信息增益估计个性化敏感度 Γ_{u,i}，从而放松全局敏感度界的同质性假设，在无 RCT 数据的情况下实现稳健去偏；BPUID 通过基准引导的增量目标解决最坏情况优化的"鲁棒性—精度"权衡，理论上给出更紧的偏差界与精度改进的充分条件。局限与后续方向：个性化 Γ 的有效性依赖"同类变量信息贡献成比例"的启发式假设且缺乏严格证明；α、β 需按数据集手工调参（DR 侧不敏感、IPS 侧敏感）；估计精度受分箱粒度与特征离散化质量影响；作者指出未来将改进信息增益估计、扩展到序列/上下文感知推荐、并实现敏感度超参的自动调优。另需注意：稿件文本存在小瑕疵——实验部分写"四个公开数据集"但实际仅列三个（KuaiRec、Coat、Yahoo!R3），且所标期刊“Nuclear Physics B”与本文主题明显不符（应为预印本模板残留）。

Abstract: Recommender systems often rely on observational user--item interaction data, which is prone to selection bias due to users' selective interactions with items. Inverse propensity weighting and doubly robust estimators effectively mitigate selection bias under observed confounding, but are unreliable in the presence of hidden confounders. Existing approaches relying on randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or global sensitivity bounds are constrained in practice: RCTs demand costly experimental data, while global sensitivity bounds presume a uniformly bounded effect of unmeasured confounders on propensities through sensitivity analysis, thereby neglecting heterogeneity across user--item interactions. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel framework, which estimates user--item level sensitivity bounds, thereby substantially relaxing the homogeneity assumption inherent in global sensitivity bounds named Personalized Unobserved-Confounding-aware Interaction Deconfounder (PUID). To ensure both robustness and predictive accuracy, we further develop an adversarial optimization strategy and propose a benchmark-guided variant (BPUID) that incorporates pre-trained models as stabilizing references. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms global methods under hidden confounding, without requiring RCT data.

</details>


### [259] [Towards Understanding Self-Pretraining for Sequence Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21070)
*Omar Coser,Loredana Zollo,Paolo Soda,Antonio Orvieto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究复制并系统消融了Amos等人(2024)的自预训练(SPT)方法，发现SPT的核心改进源于让模型学习位置邻近交互，而非深度或泛化本身；在简化理论设置中进一步证明，标签监督对某些注意力分数方向存在局部盲区，而掩码重建可以检测到这些方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Amos等人(2024)展示了通过自预训练(SPT)可提升Transformer在序列分类任务上的准确率，但未解释其机制。本研究旨在回答两个核心问题：SPT如何驱动优化到更好的解？标准监督训练为何会在Transformer中失败？

Method: 复制Amos等人(2024)的实验并进行系统性消融实验，使用最小化设置来隔离关键因素。

Result: 核心瓶颈不是深度或泛化本身，而是标签监督从随机初始化学习有效的query-key注意力模式的能力。通过最小化设置发现，将绝对位置编码转化为邻近偏差注意力分数是SPP改进的关键来源。

Conclusion: 标签监督对某些注意力分数方向存在局部盲区，而掩码重建可以检测到这些方向，解释了SPT相比标准监督训练的优势。

Abstract: Amos et al. (2024) showed that the accuracy of Transformer models in sequence classification can be significantly improved by first pretraining with a masked token prediction objective without external data or augmentation, a procedure referred to as self-pretraining (SPT). While the primary objective of Amos et al. (2024) was to showcase that Transformers can achieve strong performance on the Long-Range Arena (LRA), their pipeline raises more fundamental questions: How does SPT drive optimization to better solutions? Why can standard supervised training fail in Transformers? To better understand this, we replicate and systematically ablate the findings of Amos et al. (2024). Our ablations suggest that a central bottleneck in the studied settings is not depth or generalization alone, but the ability of label supervision to learn useful query-key Attention patterns from random initialization. With a minimal setup, we identify learning proximity interactions - turning absolute positional encodings into proximity-biased Attention scores - as a key source of the improvements brought by SPT. Finally, in a simplified theoretical setup, we show that label supervision can be locally blind to certain Attention-score directions that are instead detectable through masked reconstruction.

</details>


### [260] [Reviving Error Correction in Modern Deep Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21088)
*Minh Hoang Nguyen,Dai Do,Huu Hiep Nguyen,Dung Nguyen,Kien Do,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对深度时间序列预测中自回归推理的误差累积问题，提出一种架构无关、免重训练的通用误差校正模型UEC-STD，通过季节性-趋势分解分别校正各分量，在多种模型和数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习模型在时间序列预测中面临长期预测性能下降的问题，根本原因在于自回归推理中的误差累积。传统统计方法中的误差校正机制（ECM）难以有效应用于深度学习模型。

Method: 提出UEC-STD方法，通过将预测分解为趋势和季节性分量，分别对各分量进行校正，实现误差修正。

Result: 在4种 backbone 和10个数据集上显著提升了校正精度和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: UEC-STD能够有效提升多种深度预测模型的长期预测精度，同时保持架构无关性和免重训练的特性。

Abstract: Modern deep-learning models have achieved remarkable success in time-series forecasting. Yet, their performance degrades in long-term prediction due to error accumulation in autoregressive inference, where predictions are recursively used as inputs. While classical error correction mechanisms (ECMs) have long been used in statistical methods, their applicability to deep learning models remains limited or ineffective. In this work, we revisit the error accumulation problem in deep time-series forecasting and investigate the role and necessity of ECMs in this new context. We propose a simple, architecture-agnostic error correction model that can be integrated with any existing forecaster without requiring retraining. By explicitly decomposing predictions into trend and seasonal components and training the corrector to adjust each separately, we introduce the Universal Error Corrector with Seasonal-Trend Decomposition (UEC-STD), which significantly improves correction accuracy and robustness across 4 backbones and 10 datasets. Our findings provide a practical tool for enhancing forecasts while offering new insights into mitigating autoregressive errors in deep time-series models. Code is available at https://github.com/DA2I2-SLM/UEC-STD.

</details>


### [261] [UOTIP: Unbalanced Optimal Transport Map for Unpaired Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21094)
*Donggyu Lee,Taekyung Lee,Jaewoong Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UOTIP方法，通过非平衡最优传输学习从噪声测量分布到干净信号分布的映射，用于解决非配对图像逆问题。该方法通过放松边际约束获得对多级噪声的鲁棒性和类别不平衡的自适应性，理论上证明二次代价项可确保传输映射的存在唯一性，实验表明其性能达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决非配对图像逆问题这一具有挑战性的场景，其中训练时只有独立的非配对噪声测量集和干净目标信号集可用。

Method: 通过融入基于似然的代价函数，将重建任务（从噪声测量预测干净信号）表述为学习从噪声测量分布到干净信号分布的UOT映射，并通过放松精确边际约束来处理问题。

Result: UOTIP在非配对图像逆问题基准测试中达到了最优性能，适用于线性和非线性逆问题；UOT框架提供了对多级观测噪声的鲁棒性、对噪声和干净数据集之间类别不平衡的自适应能力，以及对多样化噪声类型场景的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UOTIP在非配对图像逆问题基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，覆盖线性和非线性逆问题场景。

Abstract: We investigate unpaired image inverse problems, a challenging setting where only independent, non-paired sets of noisy measurements and clean target signals are available for training. We propose a novel inverse problem solver based on Unbalanced Optimal Transport, called Unbalanced Optimal Transport Map for Inverse Problems (UOTIP). Our method formulates the reconstruction task, predicting clean target signals from noisy measurements, as learning a UOT Map from noisy measurement distribution to clean signal distribution by incorporating a likelihood-based cost function. By relaxing the exact marginal constraint, the UOT framework provides key advantages to our model: robustness to multi-level observation noise, adaptability to class imbalance between noisy and clean datasets, and generalizability to diverse noise-type scenarios. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that incorporating a quadratic cost term ensures the existence and uniqueness of the transport map by satisfying the twist condition, even for ill-posed inverse problems. Our experiments demonstrate that UOTIP achieves state-of-the-art performance on unpaired image inverse problem benchmarks, across linear and nonlinear inverse problems.

</details>


### [262] [A Typed Tensor Language for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21103)
*Theofilos Mailis,Kalliopi-Christina Despotidou,Konstantinos Filippopolitis,Yannis Foufoulas,Thanasis-Michail Karampatsis,Andreas Ktenidis,Evdokia Mailli,Theodore Papamarkou,Yannis Ioannidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于联邦学习的带类型张量语言，通过区分客户端分区的联邦张量与全局共享张量，形式化了一轮程序的编码-合并-解码结构。核心贡献是共享状态分解理论：所有可分解程序都等价于通过固定维度共享状态进行通信的协议，且维度与客户端数量和记录数无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习和分析协议通常被描述为独立协议集合，缺乏统一的形式化框架。论文旨在为这些协议建立统一的类型化数学基础，解决通信复杂性与表达能力的理论刻画问题。

Method: 引入带类型的张量语言，区分沿记录轴分区的联邦张量（federated tensors）与全局共享张量（shared tensors）；通过虚拟全局张量定义语义；建立共享状态分解理论，论证typed one-round程序可分解为客户端本地张量表达式与跨客户端合并操作的组合。

Result: 证明了typed one-round程序可通过固定维度共享状态进行分解，共享状态维度与客户端数量和记录数无关；建立了逆表示定理，表明满足表达性条件的分解都对应于typed one-round程序；开发了可微分片段，支持服务器端梯度下降和共享线性代数二阶更新。

Conclusion: 该框架为"可经由固定维度共享状态进行通信"的一类广泛联邦学习计算提供了完整的形式化刻画，统一了联邦学习中的多种协议，并揭示了通信结构与表达能力之间的数学联系。

Abstract: Federated learning and analytics are often described as collections of separate protocols, even when they share the same mathematical form: client-local tensor computation, mergeable aggregation into shared state, and shared-only post-processing. We introduce a typed tensor language that formalizes this structure. The language distinguishes federated tensors, whose records are partitioned across clients along a tracked record axis, from shared tensors, which are available globally. Its semantics are defined by comparison with a virtual global tensor, used only as a reference object. The main result is a shared-state factorization theory. We show that typed one-round programs factor through fixed-dimensional shared state whose size is independent of the number of clients and records, computed from client-local tensor expressions and merged across clients. We also prove a converse representability result; factorizations whose encoders and decoders are expressible in the language are realized by typed one-round programs, and the correspondence extends to iterative programs whose cross-round state is shared. This gives a formal account of the computations in the language that can be expressed as encode, merge, and decode procedures. We then develop a differentiable fragment for learning. If a per-record loss and its per-record gradient are represented by client-local tensor expressions, the global gradient is represented by record-axis summation of the federated gradient tensor. This yields typed iterative programs for server-side gradient descent and shared-linear-algebra second-order updates. The framework characterizes a broad class of federated learning computations whose communication passes through fixed-dimensional shared state.

</details>


### [263] [HORST: Composing Optimizer Geometries for Sparse Transformer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21104)
*Tom Jacobs,Rohan Jain,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HORST 把优化器更新规则抽象为可组合的“非交换算子”，发现最速下降（bounded、非线性、L∞隐式偏置、稳定性）与镜像下降（线性、无界、L1稀疏偏置）构成结构性二分；通过“先自适应步、后双曲熵镜像（乘法/指数）步”的顺序组合，二者兼得。所得 HORST-AdamW 在 ImageNet 上配合 AC/DC 流水线做 DeiT 稀疏训练（70/80/90% 稀疏）、在 SlimPajama-6B 上做 GPT-2 Small 稠密预训练后一次性分层剪枝中，均稳定显著优于 AdamW（高稀疏度增益最大），且优于最接近的基线 HAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 的稀疏化（模型压缩）在高稀疏率下性能下降严重，其根源被作者归结为优化几何层面的冲突：卷积网络用 SGD 训练（L2 偏置，稀疏友好），而 Transformer 必须依赖 AdamW 等自适应优化器以保证稳定训练，而 Adam/AdamW 与符号下降（sign descent）密切相关，呈现 L∞ 隐式偏置——权重幅值趋于“均衡化”而非集中，与稀疏所需的“质量集中到少数参数、其余压到零”正好相悖。理论上要直接获得 L1 偏置需做坐标下降（每次只更新最大梯度分量），在大网络中不可行；而镜像下降路线虽可用双曲熵（hyperbolic entropy，∇R(θ)=log θ）诱导 L1 稀疏偏置，却与 Transformer 依赖的 L∞ 稳定性不兼容（现有 HAM 交替方案在卷积网上有效，但在 Transformer 上失效）。作者因此提出：需要一种原则性的方式把自适应的稳定性与镜像的稀疏偏置组合起来。

Method: 1) 算子抽象：把更新规则视为函数算子 A(θ,g)，定义复合 AB(θ,g)=A(θ,B(θ,g))，并刻画线性、有界性、可交换性（Lie bracket）等结构性质；最速下降算子 S_{||·||}（如 sign descent、coordinate descent）与镜像算子 M_R(θ,g)=∇²R(θ)^{-1}g(θ)（梯度下降= L2 偏置；双曲熵= L1 偏置；cosh-熵= L∞ 偏置但失去逆强制性、收敛极慢）。2) 二分定理（Lemma 4.1/4.2）：最速算子有界但非线性（尺度不变，丢弃梯度幅值）；镜像算子线性但一般无界；cosh-熵之所以无法兼得 L∞ 稳定性，正是因为其逆 Hessian 需衰减以“均衡化”，从而丧失逆 μ-强制性与线性收敛。3) 非交换性与顺序（Lemma 4.3、Corollary 4.4）：S_∞M_R = S_∞（先做镜像再取符号会抹掉镜像作用），故两算子不对易，顺序决定继承哪种几何；采用 M_R S_||·|| 顺序时，由 Corollary 4.5 复合算子重新有界。4) 隐式偏置刻画（Theorem 4.7 / C.3）：用 steepest-mirror flow 与齐次重参数化 θ=Π_i w_i 的连接，结合 Lp 陡峭流的最大间隔结果，证明对 Lp 范数（p≥2）与熵镜像映射 ∇R=log θ，迭代方向收敛到 min ||θ||_1 s.t. y_i⟨θ,x_i⟩≥1 的 KKT 点，即镜像映射可“覆写”陡峭下降的隐式偏置（p→∞、γ→0 的极限仍待严格证明）。5) 算法（Algorithm 2，HORST）：交替两半步——先做 Adam 更新 + 解耦权重衰减 θ_{k+1/2}=θ_k−Adam(g)−ληθ_k，再做乘法/指数镜像步 θ_{k+1}=θ_{k+1/2}exp(−α·sign(θ_{k+1/2})·Adam(g)−ηβ)；与 HAM 的区别是指数步中使用 Adam 的更新方向而非原始梯度；α=0 退化为 AdamW，α 越大稀疏偏置越强（α=200 会崩溃，故取 α=5，β=0）；无需额外梯度计算，仅增加逐参数指数运算开销。

Result: 理论：给出算子复合的一般框架、二分结构性质、非交换性证明与 L1 隐式偏置定理。玩具实验：稀疏线性分类中 Exp-Adam（镜像在 Adam 之后）能恢复稀疏教师解，而 Adam-Exp（顺序相反）过拟合，验证 Lemma 4.3；cosh-熵因失去强制性收敛极慢。视觉：ImageNet 上 DeiT-base/small + AC/DC，验证精度全面优于 AdamW——DeiT-base 70%/80%/90%：76.15→78.89、74.18→78.63、68.86→76.83；DeiT-small：71.59→78.42、67.07→75.83、59.64→69.41；600 epoch 长跑 70% 时 73.76→78.96。语言：GPT-2 Small 在 SlimPajama-6B 训练 25K 步后一次性逐层非结构化幅值剪枝（无微调），验证困惑度在各非零稀疏度均最低：50% 时 AdamW 237.17、HAM 105.76、HORST 69.58；60% 时三者分别 237.17/105.76/69.58 区间内继续扩大差距，权重分布显示 HORST 更集中于零附近（隐式 L1 偏置）。与 HAM 对比：DeiT-small 90% 稀疏下基线 59.23、HAM 60.06、HORST 70.5，说明把指数镜像步与 AdamW 更新本身复合至关重要。

Conclusion: 本文提出以“算子复合”视角理解并设计优化器：优化器的隐式正则（偏置）由其几何结构决定，且可由算子组合主动控制——只要按正确顺序（非交换算子中镜像是外层）组合，即可同时获得最速下降的稳定性与镜像下降的 L1 稀疏偏置，HORST 作为该原则的模块化实现，显著改善 Transformer 稀疏训练与剪枝鲁棒性，揭示 AdamW 的 L∞ 隐式偏置本身就是稀疏化 Transformer 的瓶颈之一。开放问题：p→∞（L∞ 极限）与镜像更新的严格刻画仍未解决；谱方法（如 Muon 类）与陡峭-镜像复合的交互值得研究；将 HORST 与 SparseGPT 等训练后剪枝规则结合亦有前景。局限：理论基于凸/指数损失与可分二分类的流式设定，对 p→∞ 极限未给严格证明；实验主要在 DeiT/GPT-2 Small 与 AC/DC、幅值剪枝流水线上验证，尚未覆盖更大模型与更多稀疏策略。

Abstract: Sparsifying transformers remains a fundamental challenge, as standard optimizers fail to simultaneously encourage sparsity and maintain training stability. Effective adaptive optimizers exhibit an implicit $L_{\infty}$ bias favoring stability, yet, sparsity requires an $L_1$ bias. To integrate sparsity, we propose a composition of optimizer steps, which we cast as non-commutative operators to analyze and combine their optimization geometry in a principled way. This yields HORST (Hyperbolic Operator for Robust Sparse Training), a modular optimizer that inherits stability from adaptive methods while inducing $L_1$ sparsity bias through a hyperbolic mirror map. Our experiments demonstrate its utility for sparse training of transformers on both vision and language tasks. HORST consistently and significantly outperforms AdamW baselines across all sparsity levels, with large gains at higher sparsity.

</details>


### [264] [Efficient Learning of Deep State Space Models via Importance Smoothing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21108)
*John-Joseph Brady,Nikolas Nusken,Yunpeng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并行变分蒙特卡洛（PVMC）：一种面向深度状态空间模型（DSSM）的新训练范式，通过把重要性加权轨迹平滑的权重计算改写为结合矩阵半群的结合前缀/后缀扫描（associative scan），在 O(log N × log T) 的跨度复杂度下完全并行地求解每个时间步的平滑边缘后验，从而避免了粒子滤波重采样带来的串行依赖。与 VAE 型 DSSM 相比它给出更紧的变分下界（PVMC ELBO），与可微 SMC（DSMC）相比它保留对完整观测序列条件下的平滑后验（而非在线滤波后验）建模能力，且梯度无偏。该方法在三类基准上达到或超越最优精度，并在 RTX 4090 上比最快的 SMC 基线快约 10×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度状态空间模型（DSSM）的训练长期存在两条彼此割裂的路线：(1) 自编码（VAE 型）路线，将 SSM 视为变分自编码器，用与潜在动力学无关的编码器网络生成轨迹，训练完全可并行，但变分下界较松，且难以支持监督/半监督目标，无法在每个时间步给出可用于状态估计的边缘后验；(2) 可微序列蒙特卡洛（DSMC）路线，通过对粒子滤波输出反传梯度，天然支持监督损失、可给出更紧的边界，但重采样步骤引入粒子间的全局依赖与离散采样，破坏可重参数化并导致前向过程强串行，在现代 GPU 上扩展性差、训练代价高昂。此外，现有可微粒子平滑器（如 MDPS）的边缘不保证等于底层 DSSM 的平滑分布且继承有偏梯度，而 d-SMC 虽实现并行但需反复重采样、无法端到端可微。因此需要一个既可完全并行、又统计一致（无偏梯度、逼近平滑后验）且能统一生成式与判别式训练目标的 DSSM 训练方法。

Method: 1) 变分提议：使用跨时间全因子化的轨迹提议 V_{0:T}=∏_t V_t(x_t|y_{0:T})，每个时间步独立采 N 个粒子，从而彻底避免粒子滤波的序贯重采样；提议网络用时间维 1D 卷积实现，可读入完整观测序列（双向、全局信息）。2) 重要性平滑：定义 K_0 = P(x_0)H_0(y_0|x_0)/V_0(x_0|y)，K_t = M_t(x_t|x_{t-1})H_t(y_t|x_t)/V_t(x_t|y)，联合平滑分布可展开为 N^{T+1} 条轨迹的加权和；边缘权重 w_t^{n_t} = Σ_{n_{-t}} ∏_u K_u。3) 硬件感知的并行递归（核心贡献）：将 K_t 组织成 N×N 转移矩阵，构造半群 ((C1,C2)⊕(D1,D2))=(C1, C2D1D2)，用结合前缀/后缀扫描一次算出全部时间步的权重，跨度复杂度 O(log N × log T)，反向传播同样 O(log N × log T)（矩阵乘法跨度 O(log N)）。偶数 T 时通过前置单位矩阵降为奇数情形。4) 目标函数：定义 PVMC ELBO L_PVMC^N = E[log L̂^N]，L̂^N 为似然的无偏估计；并证明层级不等式 log p(y) ≥ L_PVMC^N ≥ L_IWAE^N ≥ L_IWAE^{Ñ} ≥ L_P-VAE^N = L_VAE^N，且 L_PVMC 对粒子数 N 单调不减（利用轨迹集合的可分解性、粒子置换不变性、Jensen 不等式与相对熵单调性）。5) 理论保证：L̂^N 对 p(y_{0:T}) 无偏，收敛率 O_P(N^{-1/2})（并几乎必然收敛），边缘平滑估计对任意有界检验函数同样以 O_P(N^{-1/2}) 收敛——这是首个端到端可微、带无偏梯度更新且后验近似统计一致的粒子平滑器。6) 扩展：给出乘性泛函的直接并行归约（用于仅需似然估计的场景，显著降低工作与显存开销）；附录 E.2 讨论非因子化/状态因果提议，通过将提议替换为上一时刻粒子均匀混合的 Markov 提议恢复对所有轨迹的支配性。

Result: （1）线性高斯实验（d_x=d_y=5，501 步，64 粒子，400 条轨迹）：PVMC（Kalman 提议）平均 L2 误差 0.054、KSD 0.200、1.88 s；PVMC（学习提议）误差 0.052、KSD 0.199、1.50 s，均优于 TFS（0.501 / 0.410 / 25.9 s）、d-SMC（0.44 / 2.21 / 4.00 s）与 Kalman 滤波（0.132）；2-Wasserstein 距离 0.13–0.14，同样最佳。（2）捕食者-被捕食者（Lotka-Volterra 随机变体，T=256）监督状态估计（20 次重复）：PVMC 的 MSE 0.32±0.04、过滤 MSE 0.40±0.03、2-SWD 2.96±0.74、训练耗时 1:49、0 次失败；均优于 P-VAE（0.43/1.21/20.9）、Diffusion DPF（0.52/0.56/10.2，267 分钟）、Soft DPF（0.62，7 次失败）、Stop-grad（0.83，2 次失败）与 MDPS（1.20，14 次失败）。即 PVMC 在精度、稳定性（无失败）上同时占优，且相对最快基线约 10× 加速、相对 Diffusion DPF 约 100× 加速。（3）SPX 日收益生成式建模（120 天滚动窗口，2014-2024，4 维潜状态）：PVMC 最一致地捕捉绝对值/平方收益的波动聚集自相关结构，偏度与峰度的分布也最接近真实 SPX；DMM 与 Soft-DPF 无法捕捉相关结构（似陷于只拟合边缘分布的局部极小），TC-VAE 与 P-VAE 则系统性低估偏度/峰度的幅度与离散度。

Conclusion: PVMC 通过把重要性加权的轨迹级平滑重写为结合前缀/后缀扫描，在不依赖任何重采样的前提下实现了完全并行的、统计一致的 DSSM 训练：既保留 VAE 路线可扩展的并行执行，又具备 DSMC 路线对完整观测条件下平滑后验的建模能力与无偏梯度，且给出比 VAE/IWAE 更紧的 PVMC ELBO。实验证明其在模拟与真实任务上达到当前最优精度（并显著降低失败率），同时相对最快的 SMC 基线取得约 10× 加速。局限与展望：权重计算涉及 N×N 矩阵乘法，显存与算力开销高于简单 VAE 型方法（实验中批量需更小）；非因子化提议的收敛性未作证明；对更一般提议（如粒子滤波式提议）需额外假设以保证支配性；工作与梯度误差估计器在更复杂模型与更长时域上的表现仍待验证。代码已开源（github.com/John-JoB/parallel-variational-sequential-monte-carlo）。

Abstract: Latent state space systems are ubiquitous in statistical modelling, arising naturally when a time series is observed through a noisy measurement function, however training deep state space models (DSSM) at scale remains difficult. Two largely distinct strategies and literatures have developed around the training of DSSMs. Firstly, auto-encoding DSSMs train generative DSSMs by optimising a variational lower bound. Secondly, DSSMs trained by back-propagating the outputs of a classical sequential Monte Carlo algorithm (SMC). Such approaches can train DSSMs for discriminative as well as generative tasks, however, due to the sequentiality of their forward pass, scale poorly on modern hardware. We propose a new training method \emph{parallel variational Monte Carlo} (PVMC) that bridges the gap between the paradigms, and can be used robustly to train DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art or better results on a set of baseline experiments and trains $10\times$ faster than the fastest competing SMC approach.

</details>


### [265] [Improved Guarantees for Constrained Online Convex Optimization via Self-Contraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21107)
*Dhruv Sarkar,Abhishek Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了约束在线凸优化(COCO)问题，针对强凸和凸损失函数分别提出了新的投影算法，在保持最优regret的同时，将约束违反(CCV)从$O(\sqrt{T \log T})$和$O(\sqrt{T} \log T)$分别大幅降低至$O(\log T)$和$O(\sqrt{T})$，其中对强凸损失函数实现了指数级改进。核心创新在于利用了自收缩曲线的几何性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有COCO算法在regret和CCV之间存在权衡瓶颈：强凸损失下CCV为$O(\sqrt{T \log T})$，凸损失下CCV为$O(\sqrt{T} \log T)$。论文旨在打破这一限制，同时获得最优regret和更小的CCV。

Method: 提出一种简单的基于投影的算法。关键创新是引入自收缩曲线(self-contracted curves)的几何结果，用于分析和设计算法。

Result: 强凸损失：$O(\log T)$ regret + $O(\log T)$ CCV（CCV指数级改进）；凸损失：$O(\sqrt{T})$ regret + $O(\sqrt{T})$ CCV（去除对数因子）。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在对强凸损失函数实现指数级CCV改进，核心贡献——自收缩曲线的几何结果——可能具有独立的理论价值。

Abstract: We consider Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO) with adversarially chosen constraints. At each round, the learner chooses an action before observing the loss and constraint function for that round. The goal is to achieve small static regret against the best point satisfying all constraints while also controlling cumulative constraint violation ($\mathsf{CCV}$). For strongly convex losses, state-of-the-art algorithms achieve $O(\log T)$ regret and $O(\sqrt{T \log T})$ $\mathsf{CCV}.$ The corresponding best-known bounds for convex losses is $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret and $O(\sqrt{T} \log T)$ $\mathsf{CCV}$. In this paper, we give a simple projection-based algorithm that simultaneously achieves $O(\log T)$ regret and $O(\log T)$ $\mathsf{CCV}$ for strongly-convex losses, yielding an exponential improvement in the $\mathsf{CCV}$. For the convex losses, our algorithm improves the $\mathsf{CCV}$ to $O(\sqrt{T})$ while maintaining the optimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret. The key to our improvement is a recent geometric result for self-contracted curves, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [266] [A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21114)
*Yinsong Chen,Samson S. Yu,Zhong Li,Chee Peng Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper formalizes "explanation distribution" for Bayesian neural networks and proposes UA-RAO, a family of uncertainty-aware attribution operators. The framework transforms BNN posterior through Lipschitz attribution operators, enabling principled uncertainty quantification in explainable AI. Evaluated on power quality disturbance classification, results show that deep ensembles with mean UA-RAO enhance localization, while other summaries expose uncertainty patterns invisible to deterministic methods.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Post-hoc XAI methods produce deterministic attribution maps, but Bayesian neural networks induce a distribution over explanations. Capturing variability of this distribution is crucial for uncertainty-aware decision-making, yet this aspect remains underexplored in existing literature.

Method: Formalizes explanation distribution as push-forward measure of BNN posterior through Lipschitz-continuous attribution operators; proposes UA-RAO family (mean, variance, coefficient of variation, quantiles, set-theoretic aggregation); provides Monte Carlo accessibility and Wasserstein approximation bounds; evaluates on 15-class PQD classification benchmark comparing 3 BNN approximations × 3 attribution operators using relevance mass accuracy and IoU metrics.

Result: Deep ensembles with mean UA-RAO improve localization over deterministic baselines; other UA-RAO summaries reveal uncertainty patterns absent from point-estimate attributions; qualitative results on measured signals suggest generalization beyond synthetic training distribution.

Conclusion: Deep ensembles with mean UA-RAO improves localization over deterministic baselines; other UA-RAO summaries reveal uncertainty patterns not visible in point-estimate attributions; framework is domain-agnostic and applicable to any BNN with Lipschitz-continuous attribution operators.

Abstract: Post-hoc explainable AI (XAI) methods typically produce deterministic attribution maps, whereas Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) induce a distribution over explanations. Capturing the variability of this distribution is important for uncertainty-aware decision-making. This paper formalises the \emph{explanation distribution} as the push-forward measure of the BNN posterior through any Lipschitz-continuous attribution operator. It further proposes the uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operator (UA-RAO), a general family of operators that summarises the explanation distribution using the mean, variance, coefficient of variation, quantiles, and set-theoretic aggregation measures. Theoretical support is provided through Monte Carlo accessibility and Wasserstein approximation bounds. The framework is evaluated on a 15-class power quality disturbance (PQD) classification benchmark, comparing three BNN approximations paired with three attribution operators using relevance mass accuracy and intersection-over-union as localisation metrics. Results show that deep ensembles with the mean UA-RAO improve localisation over the deterministic baseline, while other UA-RAO summaries reveal uncertainty patterns absent from point-estimate attributions. Qualitative results on measured signals further suggest that these patterns generalise beyond the synthetic training distribution. The framework is domain-agnostic and can be applied to any BNN paired with a Lipschitz-continuous attribution operator.

</details>


### [267] [Behavior-Consistent Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21214)
*Marcel Hussing,Liv G. d'Aliberti,Claas Voelcker,Benjamin Eysenbach,Eric Eaton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"行为一致性强化学习"（behavior-consistent RL, BRL）这一新问题设定：目标是让不同随机种子独立训练得到的策略不仅性能高，而且在分布上高度相似。核心机制是最大熵RL——通过将策略正则化到共同的均匀先验来锚定各次运行。作者证明：若Boltzmann策略的温度与两个Q函数的分歧成正比，则两条策略之间的成对KL散度可被上界2κ控制（Theorem 4.1），且此时软Bellman更新仍收敛到无正则最优解邻域（Theorem 4.2）。为在单次运行中落地该原理，作者提出QED（Q-value Expectile Disagreement）：用双critic分歧作为跨运行分歧的单次运行代理，以策略采样动作上的expectile高分位数近似max算子，得到状态依赖的温度调度 α_QED(s)=clip(Δ̃(s)/(kd), α_min, α_max)。在18个dm_control连续控制任务、10个种子上，QED使跨运行策略KL下降约两个数量级，MAD-SAC上回报方差降低约50%，性能基本不损失（固定α基线在同等KL下低约7%）；代价是一定的样本效率损失，且维度更高任务上性能-一致性权衡更明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度RL对随机种子、初始化、数据顺序、环境随机性极度敏感，导致同一算法不同次独立运行得到性能与行为都截然不同的策略（Colas et al. 2018; Henderson et al. 2018）。已有研究多关注回报方差等统计量，跨运行"行为分歧"在算法层面几乎无人处理；而在奖励设计、调试、安全验证乃至LLM微调等迭代流程中，行为不一致会让改进难以归因，形成科学进展与实际部署的双重障碍。作者因此提出：行为一致性本身应当作为RL的一级目标，与性能最大化并列——即"行为一致性RL"（BRL）框架，用跨运行策略的分布相似度（而非仅期望回报）刻画RL的稳定性与可复现性。

Method: **1. 问题形式化（Definition 3.1）**：定义行为参考分布 μ_π = E_{π∼𝒜}[d^π]（算法多次运行所诱导状态占据分布的期望），并定义行为一致性度量 𝒱(𝒜) = E_{π⁽ⁱ⁾,π⁽ʲ⁾∼𝒜}[E_{s∼μ_π}[D(π⁽ⁱ⁾(·|s), π⁽ʲ⁾(·|s))]]。强调该度量只关心策略实际访问的状态空间，且必须与次级目标（回报）联合使用，否则常数策略即为平凡解。

**2. 理论保证**：
- Theorem 4.1（成对KL控制）：对有限动作集，令 α(s)=max{α_min, ‖Q⁽¹⁾(s,·)−Q⁽²⁾(s,·)‖_∞/κ}，则两个Boltzmann策略满足 D_KL(π⁽¹⁾‖π⁽²⁾) ≤ 2κ；对称KL同样成立。证明将KL分解为"逐点Q差异/α"与"归一化常数之比"两项分别界定。
- Theorem 4.2（收敛性）：使用分歧缩放温度的耦合软值迭代，其与无正则最优Q*的误差被三部分界定：γ^t 初始误差、由温度下界 α_min 引起的持久熵正则化偏置、以及随 t 衰减的分歧项 (Δ_0 log|A|/κ)·t·γ^t。即分歧项随收敛消失，仅剩 α_min 的正则偏置。

**3. QED算法（Section 5）**：利用double-Q技巧，用同一运行内两个critic Q_θ1、Q_θ2 的分歧作为跨运行分歧的代理（附录D验证：早期双critic分歧与跨种子Q分歧的R²=0.77）。为避免直接优化 max 引发对抗性动作搜索与外推误差，改用从当前策略采样 N=8 个动作上的绝对分歧的 τ=0.9 expectile 作为 max 的近似：Δ̃(s)=Expectile_τ({|Q_θ1(s,a_i)−Q_θ2(s,a_i)|})。温度设为 α_QED(s)=clip(Δ̃(s)/(kd), α_min, α_max)，其中 d 为动作维度、k 控制约束强度；下界 α_min 取标准目标熵温度 α_TE 以避免稀疏奖励下熵崩塌，上界 α_max=0.2；分歧项消失时QED退化为SAC的目标熵自动调温。

**4. 离策略不稳定性分析（Section 5.2）**：设计玩具MDP（单状态、连续动作、双峰高斯奖励、预填部分动作的回放缓冲）证明高熵会拓宽策略支撑集、迫使critic在OOD动作上外推，形成"Q值发散螺旋"并导致功能性策略崩溃；α=0.1时策略仍能锁定正确模态，α=0.15时则漂离真实奖励结构。据此选择两个能抗动作分布偏移的基座算法：带LayerNorm的SAC（SAC-LN）与模型增强数据版本MAD-SAC（MAD-TD的MaxEnt变体，含HL-Gauss、自预测损失，去掉MPC）。

Result: **主实验（18个dm_control任务，10种子，2M步，frame skip 2，γ=0.99，20次评估rollout，IQM+95% bootstrap CI）**：
- 行为相似性：QED使SAC-LN与MAD-SAC的成对对称KL（pre-tanh高斯）下降约两个数量级；在k取值合适时归一化回报保持可比。MAD-SAC在最低KL水平仅损失约5%性能，PAC而SAC-LN损失超过10%（因需更多探索来降低Q不确定性）。
- 方差-相似性关系：MAD-SAC上k减小（约束增强）时回报方差最多下降约50%，验证行为相似性可作为回报方差的代理；SAC无此效应，因其性能损失来自个别运行不稳定而非一致性下降。
- k的消融：k增大则趋势回到基座算法性能，k减小则KL下降，形成性能-相似性Pareto前沿；MAD-SAC稳定区间 k∈[0.1,0.4]，SAC在该区间已开始缓慢退化。
- Rollout行为分析：100步rollout中累计成对ℓ2动作距离显著下降，说明KL降低来自分布均值更接近而非方差膨胀；cheetah_run可视化显示目标熵调温下三个种子行为定性各异（跳跃/行走/中等跳后大跳），QED下三者均表现为一致的大跳开局。
- 固定α消融：固定α虽能降低成对KL但平均回报显著下滑，QED的Pareto前沿严格支配固定α；在最低对称KL处固定α的平均性能比QED低约7%。
- 高方差任务hopper_hop：基座MAD-SAC训练期方差很大，QED提升性能并压缩种子间离散度；k=0.2时所有种子收敛到完全一致的性能水平，提示QED通过更高熵塑造探索并对齐策略空间。
- 计算开销：QED每次actor更新仅采样8个动作并评估两个critic，相对基座开销极小；整套实验约4000 GPU小时。

Conclusion: 行为一致性RL是一个可行且有价值的新目标：把跨运行的策略分布相似度作为一等目标，通过"值分歧→温度"这一机制可在不牺牲（甚至有时提升）性能的前提下，把跨运行行为分歧压低两个数量级，并显著降低回报方差。核心洞见是：熵应当在价值估计不确定时高、在收敛时低；MaxEnt RL提供的共同均匀先验是跨运行对齐的天然锚点。方法层面，QED表明"用单次运行内的critic分歧估计跨运行分歧"这一代理思路可行，且配合能抑制OOD过估计的基座算法（层归一化、模型增强数据）才稳定。局限与开放问题包括：依赖逐点Q估计且其消失时机难以判断；高维任务上性能-一致性权衡加剧、KL常高于1这一多步相似性阈值；任务可能存在多个合乎行为策略，如何区分"应保留的多样性"与"应消除的随机性"仍是开放问题；行为一致性、样本复杂度与不确定性之间的深层联系有待进一步研究。作者认为行为一致性可能是可扩展、可靠RL所缺失的关键要素。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) often exhibits high variance across training runs, leading to unreliable performance and posing a major challenge to deployment in real-world domains. In this work, we address the challenge of cross-run policy divergence by formalizing the problem of behavior-consistent RL, where the objective is to obtain policies that are both high-performing and distributionally similar across training runs. Our key observation is that maximum-entropy RL provides a direct mechanism for controlling behavioral divergence by anchoring runs to a common (uniform) prior. We prove that, for Boltzmann policies, choosing the temperature proportional to $Q$-function disagreement bounds the pairwise KL divergence between the induced policies. However, we also show that naïvely increasing entropy might impair policy optimization while amplifying off-policy error. Building upon these observations, we propose $Q$-value Expectile Disagreement (QED), a state-dependent temperature schedule that uses double-critic disagreement as a single-run proxy for cross-run disagreement. Empirically, we demonstrate that across 18 continuous-control tasks, QED reduces across-run divergence by two orders of magnitude without sacrificing performance, resulting in a considerable reduction in return variance at modest sample-efficiency costs.

</details>


### [268] [Advantage Collapse in Group Relative Policy Optimization: Diagnosis and Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21125)
*Xixiang He,Qiyao Sun,Ao Cheng,Xingming Li,Xuanyu Ji,Hailun Lu,Runke Huang,Qingyong Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GRPO算法存在优势崩塌问题（同类奖励组导致梯度消失），本文提出ACR指标量化这一问题，并设计AVSPO方法通过注入虚拟奖励样本解决优势崩塌，在0.5B-14B模型上均取得4-6%的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO suffers from advantage collapse where homogeneous rewards within a group produce near-zero advantages and vanishing gradients, leading to training stagnation.

Method: AVSPO injects virtual reward samples guided by real-time ACR monitoring to enable learning from homogeneous groups without additional model rollouts.

Result: ACR strongly predicts training stagnation and final performance. AVSPO reduces advantage collapse by 58-63% relative to GRPO and yields consistent accuracy gains of 4-6 percentage points.

Conclusion: AVSPO significantly reduces advantage collapse by 58-63% and improves accuracy by 4-6 percentage points across all model scales (0.5B-14B), while maintaining generalization to out-of-domain tasks.

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a prominent algorithm within the Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) framework, has achieved strong results in improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, GRPO is prone to advantage collapse, a failure mode where homogeneous rewards within a group (e.g., all correct or all incorrect answers) yield near-zero advantages and vanishing gradients. To address this, we introduce the Advantage Collapse Rate (ACR), the first diagnostic metric quantifying the proportion of training batches with ineffective gradients. Across models from 0.5B to 14B parameters on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we show that ACR strongly predicts training stagnation and final performance. We then propose Adaptive Virtual Sample Policy Optimization (AVSPO), a lightweight extension of GRPO that injects virtual reward samples, guided by real-time ACR monitoring, to enable learning from homogeneous groups without additional model rollouts. AVSPO reduces advantage collapse by 58-63% relative to GRPO and yields consistent accuracy gains of 4-6 percentage points across all model scales, while maintaining generalization on the evaluated out-of-domain task. Code and datasets are available at https://qingyonghu.github.io/AVSPO.

</details>


### [269] [PREFINE: Preference-Based Implicit Reward and Cost Fine-Tuning for Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21225)
*Richa Verma,Bavish Kulur,Sanjay Chawla,Balaraman Ravindran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PREFINE enables safety alignment of pre-trained RL policies using preference feedback without retraining. By adapting DPO from LLM alignment to trajectory-level preferences in continuous control, it achieves 60%+ reduction in constraint violations while preserving reward performance, with superior efficiency over offline RL or imitation learning.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current approaches to making pre-trained RL policies safety-aware typically require full retraining or numerical cost encoding. A more general setting exists where safety constraints are provided as preferences (preferred low-cost vs dispreferred high-cost trajectories) rather than explicit numerical costs. There is a need for methods that can adapt language model alignment techniques like DPO to continuous control domains with trajectory-level preferences.

Method: PREFINE (Preference-based Implicit Reward and Cost Fine-Tuning) adapts Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to sequential decision-making. The method constructs policy-sampled counterfactual trajectories to establish meaningful preference contrasts and jointly optimizes for reward retention and safety alignment. Unlike standard RLHF which operates at response level, this approach handles trajectory-level preferences in continuous control environments.

Result: Empirically validates that PREFINE reduces constraint violations and catastrophic failures by over 60% while maintaining original reward behavior. The method achieves low-cost, high-reward performance with significantly improved data and computational efficiency compared to full offline RL or imitation learning baselines.

Conclusion: PREFINE bridges preference alignment and safe policy adaptation in continuous domains, enabling efficient safety alignment without full retraining. Results show 60%+ reduction in constraint violations while maintaining reward performance, with significant improvements in data and computational efficiency over offline RL or imitation learning approaches.

Abstract: We address the problem of making a pre-trained reinforcement learning (RL) policy safety-aware by incorporating cost constraints without retraining it from scratch. While costs could be numerically encoded, we assume a more general setting is when costs are provided as preferences. Given a reward-optimized policy and a small dataset of preferred (low-cost) and dispreferred (high-cost) trajectories, our goal is to fine-tune the policy to generate low-cost behaviors while retaining high rewards. Unlike standard RLHF in language models, where preferences are defined over responses to the same prompt, our setting involves trajectory-level preferences in continuous control environments. We introduce PREFINE: Preference-based Implicit Reward and Cost Fine-Tuning for Safety Alignment which is a preference-based fine-tuning method that adapts Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), which is now widely used for LLM fine-tuning, to the sequential decision making setting. PREFINE constructs policy-sampled counterfactual trajectories to establish meaningful preference contrasts and jointly optimizes for reward retention and safety alignment. Empirically, PREFINE reduces constraint violations and catastrophic failures by over 60% while maintaining original reward behavior. PREFINE produces policies that achieve low-cost, high-reward performance with significantly improved data and computational efficiency compared to full offline RL or imitation learning, bridging preference alignment and safe policy adaptation in continuous domains.

</details>


### [270] [Reasoning-Trace Collapse: Evaluating the Loss of Explicit Reasoning During Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21127)
*Lukas Twist,Helen Yannakoudakis,Jie M. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，推理模型在微调后可能失去有效的推理过程（推理轨迹崩溃），但答案正确率可能保持不变，导致评估指标掩盖真实问题。通过结构化评估框架发现标准微调会快速抑制有效推理轨迹，但简单的损失掩码策略可有效缓解此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前推理模型的训练与微调存在数据不匹配问题：显式推理模型在包含中间推理步骤的数据上训练，但下游微调常使用普通问答数据（不含推理轨迹）。这种不匹配可能导致推理轨迹崩溃，即模型输出正确答案但失去了结构有效的显式推理能力，而现有答案级指标无法检测此问题。

Method: 提出结构化评估框架，将答案正确性与推理轨迹有效性分离，测量有效、空缺、缺失和截断四类推理轨迹，同时评估基于推理的条件化任务表现。研究对四种开源推理模型进行实验分析，并探索损失掩码策略作为缓解方案。

Result: 标准监督微调会快速抑制有效推理轨迹的产生；在多种设置下，基于有效推理的条件性能保持较高，但有效推理率急剧下降，说明答案指标可能掩盖推理失败；简单的损失掩码策略可显著缓解推理轨迹崩溃问题。

Conclusion: 微调推理模型的评估应报告结构化推理可靠性指标，而非仅关注最终答案性能，尤其当适应数据不含显式推理轨迹时。损失掩码等简单策略可有效维持推理能力，无需依赖教师生成的推理轨迹。

Abstract: Explicit reasoning models are trained to produce intermediate reasoning traces before final answers, but downstream fine-tuning is often performed on ordinary instruction-response data that contains no such traces. We show that this mismatch can induce reasoning-trace collapse: a fine-tuned model continues to produce plausible final answers while losing the structurally valid explicit reasoning traces that made it a reasoning model in the first place. We introduce a structural evaluation framework that separates answer correctness from reasoning-trace validity, measuring valid, empty, missing, and truncated reasoning alongside reasoning-conditioned task performance. Using this framework, we study four open-weight reasoning models and find that standard supervised fine-tuning can rapidly suppress valid reasoning traces, and that answer-only metrics can substantially obscure this failure: in several settings, performance conditional on valid reasoning remains high while the rate of valid reasoning falls sharply. We further show that simple loss-masking strategies can substantially mitigate collapse without requiring teacher-generated reasoning traces. These results suggest that evaluations of fine-tuned reasoning models should report structural reasoning reliability metrics in addition to final-answer performance, especially when adaptation data does not contain explicit reasoning traces.

</details>


### [271] [OCTOPUS: Optimized KV Cache for Transformers via Octahedral Parametrization Under optimal Squared error quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21226)
*Mark Boss,Vikram Voleti,Simon Donné,Shimon Vainer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OCTOPUS是一种针对KV缓存的旋转预条件联合量化编解码器，通过八面体参数化对坐标三元组进行三维联合量化实现非均匀比特分配，在多种模态上达到最优性能，且支持零额外延迟的融合解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文自回归推理中，键值缓存主导了内存带宽和占用空间，需要高效压缩。

Method: 该方法基于旋转预条件框架，对旋转后的三维坐标进行联合量化。每个三元组的方向通过八面体参数化映射到正方形，对两个角度坐标和三元组范数分别进行Lloyd-Max量化，依据优化后的每三元组均方误差分配非均匀比特数。编解码器数据无关、在线且确定性（给定种子）。

Result: 在文本、视频、音频任务中，OCTOPUS在所有报告的比特宽度和指标上匹配或超越所有先前的旋转编解码器，且在极端压缩场景下优势增大。

Conclusion: OCTOPUS通过八面体参数化对旋转后的三维坐标进行联合量化，实现非均匀比特分配，在文本、视频、音频任务上超越所有先前的旋转编解码器。其Triton融合实现可在不解压缩的情况下重构键值，零额外延迟。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory bandwidth and footprint in long-context autoregressive inference. Recent rotation-preconditioned codecs (TurboQuant, PolarQuant) show that a structured random rotation followed by a per-coordinate scalar quantizer matched to an analytically tractable marginal is a near-optimal recipe for KV compression. OCTOPUS advances this paradigm through joint quantization of rotated coordinate triplets. Each triplet's direction is mapped to a square via an octahedral parameterization, and the two resulting coordinates and the triplet norm are Lloyd-Max quantized against implementation-matched marginals. Optimizing the per-triplet squared error gives a strictly non-uniform bit allocation depending only on the total dimensionality of the keys. We find the finite-dimensional quality optimum with sweeps to be constant on every real decoder we test. The codec is data-oblivious, online, and deterministic given a seed. Across text, video, and audio, OCTOPUS matches or beats every prior rotation codec at every reported bit width and metric, with a lead that grows as bits drop for extreme compression. Furthermore, a fused Triton implementation reconstructs keys on the fly without materializing the uncompressed key, so the codec adds no decode-time bandwidth or latency over the existing dequantization. Project Page: https://octopus-quant.github.io/

</details>


### [272] [APEX: Autonomous Policy Exploration for Self-Evolving LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21240)
*Yibo Li,Jiashuo Yang,Zhi Zheng,Zhiyuan Hu,Yuan Sui,Shizun Wang,Yufei He,Bryan Hooi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: APEX（Autonomous Policy EXploration）提出一个显式的“策略地图”——以里程碑（milestone）为节点、先后置依赖为边的有向无环图（DAG），并围绕它构建四个组件：Fork Discovery（基于轨迹证据挖掘未被尝试的方向并扩展地图前沿）、Policy Selection（把探索-利用权衡建模为 DAG 候选集上的 bandit 问题，默认用 Thompson Sampling 逐次选择下一个里程碑）、Map Refinement（LLM 修正节点/边、去重）、Return Propagation（沿 DAG 边做反向拓扑信用分配）。在 9 个 Jericho 文字冒险游戏和 WebArena（812 任务）上，APEX 在所有游戏/所有站点类别上取得最佳 Final-K 成绩，消融实验表明 DAG 结构、Fork Discovery、不确定性感知选择和 DAG 信用分配各自独立贡献，API 成本与基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化（self-evolving）LLM 智能体通过跨 episode 累积记忆与反思实现免权重更新的持续改进，但存在“探索崩塌（exploration collapse）”现象：随着记忆增长，行为收敛到熟悉的高回报常规路径，甚至出现平均分高、最大分反而低于无记忆的 Static 基线的反常情况（5×5 迷宫中 Reflexion 稳定拿到 +40 却始终未发现 +80；Zork3/Deephome/Ztuu 上同样呈现“均值高于 Static、最大值低于 Static”）。论文指出根源在于 LLM 智能体的策略空间是隐式且无限的：没有预定义动作集，智能体天然不知道“自己没试过什么”。已有记忆/反思机制（Reflexion、ReasoningBank、EvoTest、JitRL、ACE）只提供局部指导，不维护一个持久的显式策略空间，因此无法持续探索。作者类比 RL 中的熵崩塌/熵瓶颈现象（RLVR 锐化已有路径分布而非发现新路径），指出经典探索方法（内在动机、UCB/Thompson/最大熵）都假设动作空间固定，只能回答“下一个试哪个已知选项”，无法回答“本应存在哪些选项”。由此提出两个问题：策略空间应如何构造？下一个该探索哪个策略？

Method: 【核心结构】策略地图 G=(V,E,θ)：节点为自然语言描述的离散子目标及关键动作，边表示先后置依赖，节点统计 θ_v=(n(v), r̄(v), Var(v))，根节点 v0 表示初始状态；抽象状态 s⊆V 为已达成里程碑集合，可选集合 A(s)={v∉s : 前驱全部∈s}；由此形式化为 Milestone Abstract MDP M=(S,A,T,R,γ)，奖励用 r̄(v) 近似。

【Policy Selection，episode 级】在 A(s) 上用 bandit 分数 f(n,r̄,Var) 逐次（而非一次性规划）选择下一个里程碑：Thompson Sampling（默认，无需调参、方差感知）为 score=sample(N(r̄, √(Var/n)))；UCB 为 r̄+c√(log(Σn)/n)；ε-Greedy。n(v)=0 的未访问节点得分置为 +∞ 并随机优先选取以保证覆盖。顺序化选择使失败里程碑不满足后继前置条件，从而自然转向其他可达分支（固定序列会强行执行前置未满足的后继）。

【Map Refinement，周期 N=5 episode】LLM 依据最近 N 个 episode 的结构化摘要 h̃=LLM_sum(h)，只编码已观测事实：精修 key_actions、修正依赖边、剪除重复节点（剪枝时丢弃被删节点统计，避免污染）。

【Return Propagation，周期 N】LLM 为每个尝试过的里程碑从得分增量归因标量奖励 r(v)，沿 DAG 边反向拓扑递归计算 G_v = r(v) + γ Σ_{u∈succ(v)∩V_a} G_u（γ=0.6），使“自身无回报但解锁高回报后继”的里程碑（如 obtain key → unlock treasure）获得信用；统计更新 n(v)、r̄(v) 运行均值。相较 Sequential 折扣（按路径序折扣、会混淆并行分支）更准确。

【Fork Discovery，周期 N】LLM 输入地图与摘要，找出“被观察到或可用但从未执行”的动作/方向，提出新里程碑与依赖边（每周期 ≤6 个，新节点 n=0），扩展地图前沿；探索冻结阈值（第 30 episode 后关闭 Fork Discovery）使系统自然从探索转向利用。

【辅助机制】每个里程碑维护最近 5 次尝试笔记；Stuck Node Diagnosis（n≥3 且 r̄≤0 的节点，冷却 2N episode）注入根因与下一步建议；Global Lesson Extraction 蒸馏 PENALTY/NAVIGATION/MECHANIC 三类全局经验（≤5 条/周期）；里程碑自报完成标志 + 耐心阈值（未访问 40 步、已尝试 20 步）自动跳过并加入本 episode 完成集，防止单点卡死。

【实验设置】Jericho 9 个游戏（50 episode/游戏，120 步/episode，Final-5）；WebArena 812 任务×5 episode（Final-3），并通过 LLM 相似度判断动态分组任务以共享策略地图；主指标 Final-K。基线：Static、Memory、Reflexion、EvoTest、ACE，统一使用 Gemini 3 Flash。

Result: 1) 主结果：Jericho 上 APEX 在全部 9 个游戏的 Final-5 均最优（如 Zork1 73.0 vs Reflexion 59.8；Pentari 46.0 vs 19.0；Ludicorp 58.8 vs 48.0；Deephome 103.4 vs 56.8；Detective 322.0 vs 314.0；Ztuu 29.0 vs 25.0；Temple 20.8 vs 10.0），增益集中在需要“发现性质不同策略”的任务。WebArena 上 APEX 在全部 5 个站点类别最优（Shopping 42.9、Reddit 68.2、GitLab 60.2、CMS 55.1、Map 57.6；总体 55.9 vs 次优 Memory 50.5），Reddit/GitLab 提升最明显（多步且中间动作不显然）。跨任务泛化实验中 APEX 仍在多数领域领先，说明策略地图学到的是可迁移结构化知识而非任务答案。
2) 消融：策略表示 DAG 显著优于 Flat List（Zork1 73.0 vs 52.1、Pentari 46.0 vs 27.0、Ztuu 29.0 vs 12.0）；去 Fork Discovery 明显下降（Ztuu 29.0→5.0）；选择策略 Thompson > UCB > ε-Greedy（Ztuu 29.0 / 12.0 / 1.0）；DAG 信用分配优于 Sequential（Ztuu 29.0 vs 17.0）。反映周期 N=2 与 N=5 最佳，N=1（信息不足、地图不稳定）与 N=10（更新滞后）均下降。
3) 案例分析：Pentari 中 Fork Discovery 补入被遇见却未尝试的 “Open Chest”，均分从 28 升至 43（Reflexion 从未达到）；Deephome 中补入依赖 “Dispel Phantom” 与 “Mine Coal→Take Pickaxe” 的 “Restore City Power”，均分从 33 升至 71（Reflexion 长期停滞在 30–40）。
4) 稳健性与成本：跨 Gemini 3 Flash / DeepSeek-V3.2 / GPT-5-mini 三种 backbone 均保持最优；WebArena API 成本 $318，与 Static($278)、Reflexion($306)、EvoTest($306)、ACE($324)、Memory($320) 相当，说明里程碑提示简洁、上下文增长受控。

需要注意的表述问题：正文中 Table 2/Table 3 的编号与标题存在互换（正文将 “Final-3 主结果” 指向 Table 3，而 Table 3 标题为跨任务泛化；Table 6/Table 7 编号在策略选择消融与反射周期敏感性之间同样错位），个别处引用与表格内容不一致；此外多数对比只有单次运行（报告了标准差但未做显著性检验）， Jericho 侧 50 episode 成本与 WebArena 成本口径未细分。

Conclusion: 论文结论是：自进化 LLM 智能体的核心瓶颈在于“不知道自己没试过什么”，解决之道不是更强的反思，而是显式维护一个可持久化、可扩展、可被不确定性驱动的策略空间。APEX 用策略地图把“构造策略空间”与“在策略空间中导航”分离：Fork Discovery 持续打开新边界（地图级探索），Policy Selection 确保这些新边界被真正访问（episode 级探索），Map Refinement 与 Return Propagation 保证地图与统计的准确性，四个组件形成闭环并各自带来独立增益。APEX 在 9 个 Jericho 游戏与 WebArena 上稳定优于所有基线，且不额外增加成本；作者认为其最适用于进度可自然分解为离散里程碑的任务（文字冒险、网页交互），而连续或弱结构化进度信号的任务需重新定义里程碑的构造与评估方式。局限性在于：策略地图质量受限于 LLM 识别里程碑与推断未探索方向的能力，深层隐藏机制易被忽略；Fork Discovery 只能基于已观测轨迹构造方向，无法发现完全落在智能体既有知识之外的策略；探索冻结阈值等超参仍需按环境设定。

Abstract: LLM agents have shown strong performance across a wide range of complex tasks, including interactive environments that require long-horizon decision making. But these agents cannot learn on the fly at test time. Self-evolving agents address this by accumulating memory and reflection across episodes rather than requiring model-weight updates. However, these agents often suffer from exploration collapse: as memory grows, behavior concentrates around familiar high-reward routines, reducing the chance of discovering better alternatives. To address this problem, we propose Autonomous Policy EXploration (APEX), which builds and maintains an explicit strategy space through a strategy map-a directed acyclic graph of milestones with prerequisite dependency edges. In APEX, Fork Discovery expands the map with evidence-grounded unexplored directions, while Policy Selection balances exploration and exploitation during planning. Evaluated on nine Jericho text-adventure games and WebArena, a realistic web interaction benchmark, APEX outperforms all baselines. Extensive ablations validate each component's contribution and demonstrate robustness across diverse settings, demonstrating APEX's effectiveness for sustained exploration in self-evolving agents.

</details>


### [273] [Learning First Integrals via Backward-Generated Data and Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21160)
*Jingfeng Zhong,Zhengxiang Liu,Zhijie Wang,Shuai Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FISolver是一个基于大语言模型的首次积分求解器，通过后向生成算法解决训练数据稀缺问题，并结合监督微调和强化学习优化。在保持低计算成本的同时，显著超越大型数学LLM和商业求解器（如Mathematica），为首次积分的自动化发现提供了新的数据驱动路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首次积分发现对理解动力系统守恒定律具有基础科学意义，但现有符号计算工具和大语言模型受限于高质量训练数据稀缺和数学直觉依赖，难以有效求解此类问题。

Method: 提出三大核心技术：(1) 后向生成算法，从积分出发反向构建微分方程数据集；(2) 监督微调结合基于Levenshtein距离的强化学习塑形奖励；(3) 数据合成与混合策略支持稀疏样本到困难问题族的迁移。

Result: 实验表明FISolver在显著降低计算成本的同时，性能显著优于更大规模的数学LLM和Mathematica等商业求解器。

Conclusion: FISolver 为首次积分的自动化发现提供了一条新的数据驱动路线，证明了小而精的专用模型配合高质量合成数据策略，在特定数学任务上可超越通用大模型和商业软件。

Abstract: The discovery of first integrals is of fundamental scientific importance for understanding conservation laws in dynamical systems. However, existing symbolic computation tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited on this task because high-quality training data are scarce and successful solutions often depend on mathematical intuition. This paper presents FISolver, an LLM-based solver developed to address this challenge. First, we introduce a "Backward Generation" algorithm that systematically builds large-scale datasets of (differential equation, first integral) pairs by deriving differential equations from sampled integrals, thereby alleviating the data scarcity bottleneck. Second, we apply supervised fine-tuning to a compact mathematical model and further improve its performance through reinforcement learning with a Levenshtein Distance-based shaped reward. In addition, we design data synthesis and blending strategies that support effective adaptation to difficult problem families from sparse examples.
